jobs.description:
Sapiens is a global leader in intelligent SaaS-based software solutions for the insurance industry, serving more than 600 insurers worldwide. We are transforming the insurance landscape through innovative technology, cloud-based platforms and AI-powered solutions that help insurers modernize operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Product Director – Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care & Group to lead the strategic direction, development and commercial success of our US Life and Annuity portfolio, while expanding our capabilities across Long-Term Care (LTC) and Group Insurance.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining product strategy, market development and day-to-day product management. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Delivery, Sales, Marketing and executive leadership to shape the product roadmap, drive innovation and position Sapiens as a leading technology partner for US insurance carriers.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap across Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care and Group Insurance.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging industry trends and customer requirements to guide product investment and innovation.
  • Develop business cases and prioritize product initiatives based on commercial value, customer needs, regulatory requirements and platform capabilities.
  • Drive the expansion of Sapiens' product offerings into LTC and Group Insurance markets.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to establish investment priorities and support overall portfolio growth.

Product Development & Execution
  • Lead hands-on product management activities within an Agile development environment.
  • Own and prioritize product backlogs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirements.
  • Partner with Engineering, Domain Modelers and Solution Designers to translate business needs into scalable product solutions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and product acceptance.
  • Prepare product documentation, smartbooks and functional specifications.
  • Work directly with Sapiens' CoreSuite platform, including product configuration, demonstrations and evaluation of platform capabilities.
  • Drive AI-enabled product innovation, leveraging automation and intelligent capabilities across underwriting, new business, policy administration, claims and servicing.

Market & Customer Engagement
  • Develop a deep understanding of the US Life, Annuity, LTC and Group Insurance markets, including customer needs, competitive positioning and emerging product trends.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance carriers, distributors, brokers and strategic partners.
  • Lead customer advisory discussions and engage with executive stakeholders to understand business priorities.
  • Translate customer feedback and market insights into actionable product enhancements and roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities, customer presentations, product demonstrations and RFP responses.

Regulatory & Industry Expertise
  • Monitor US insurance regulatory developments and ensure product capabilities remain aligned with applicable industry requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of relevant NAIC regulations, state insurance requirements, annuity suitability standards and life insurance product regulations.
  • Understand regulatory considerations impacting LTC, including rate increases, claims handling and state partnership programs.
  • Support Group Insurance requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, portability and conversion.
  • Ensure regulatory changes are incorporated into product roadmaps and delivered effectively to customers.

Commercial & Business Leadership
  • Drive portfolio growth through new customer acquisition, existing customer expansion and improved competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop product positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategies.
  • Support pricing, packaging and commercial decisions in partnership with product and commercial leadership.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption, customer satisfaction and revenue contribution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, product quality and overall cost to serve.

Requirements

Required
  • 10+ years of experience within the US Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care and/or Group Insurance industries.
  • Deep domain expertise in at least two of the following areas: Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care or Group Insurance.
  • Proven experience in hands-on product management within an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Strong understanding of insurance products and processes, including policy administration, new business, underwriting, servicing, commissions, billing and claims.
  • Experience owning product portfolios and demonstrating measurable business impact through revenue growth, customer retention or competitive win rates.
  • Strong understanding of US insurance regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, customers and technical teams.

Preferred
  • Experience introducing AI, automation or intelligent capabilities into regulated insurance environments.
  • Exposure to cloud-based SaaS platforms and modernization of legacy insurance administration systems.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and integrations, including ACORD, DTCC, enrollment and billing feeds, and employer or benefits administration platforms.
  • Background in actuarial, underwriting or insurance operations.
  • Professional designations such as FLMI, LOMA or equivalent industry credentials.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager or Business Analyst supporting insurance platform implementations.

Why Join Sapiens?

At Sapiens, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of insurance technology and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered, intelligent insurance platforms.
You'll work alongside talented professionals across Product, Engineering, Delivery and Commercial teams, with the opportunity to influence strategic product decisions, drive innovation and make a meaningful impact across the North American insurance market.

We offer an environment that values collaboration, professional development, innovation and continuous improvement.

Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and evaluate everyone on merit.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Moneycorp powers global payments for corporates, institutions and high net worth individuals, combining worldwide reach with local expertise.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Moneycorp powers global payments for corporates, institutions and high net worth individuals, combining worldwide reach with local expertise. With over 45 years of market experience, two banking licences and offices in 11 countries, our technology delivers 24/7 accessibility, while our people deliver award-winning service. In 2024, we supported $1tn+ of payment volume, reaching 190 countries in 130 currencies. Our 32k+ corporate clients benefit from our regulatory resilience with 63+ permissions globally, access to major payment rails, and our proprietary technology.

Moneycorp is a place where energy, commitment, and collaboration are core to our values of shared success. We’re restless in our drive to surpass the expectations of our customers and unlock opportunities to support them at every stage of their journey. The foundation of our success is our people, and nurturing a culture of belonging for all our colleagues is central to our journey as a global business.

Role Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to join our multifunctional Cloud Platform Team as a senior individual contributor responsible for executing complex technical delivery and providing healthy challenge to architectural and delivery approaches.

As Senior Platform Engineer, you are the "show me the code" voice - the experienced engineer who validates feasibility through execution, challenges designs with implementation reality, and delivers platform capabilities with excellence. You work alongside Cloud Architects and Technical Leads as a peer contributor, bringing deep hands-on expertise and delivery experience that grounds decision-making in practical reality.

This is a senior IC role, not a leadership position - you lead through expertise, execution quality, and constructive challenge. You own complex technical problems, mentor through pairing, and set the standard for what great delivery looks like.

Role Responsibilities:

Hands-On Technical Delivery

  • Own and deliver the most complex, risky, or ambiguous technical challenges
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (Terraform): networking, security, governance, compute, PaaS - modules, stacks, policies
  • Build CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, self-service tooling, and observability infrastructure
  • Write comprehensive tests (unit, integration, validation) and documentation (runbooks, diagrams, implementation notes)
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networking, identity, security, and infrastructure layers
  • Optimize implementations for performance, cost, security, and maintainability - secure-by-design in every delivery
  • Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response for critical platform issues

Healthy Challenge & Technical Validation

  • Challenge architectural designs with implementation reality: "will this actually work?"
  • Provide constructive pushback on approaches that ignore delivery constraints or compromise quality
  • Validate technical feasibility during refinement - flag hidden complexity, dependencies, risks
  • Push back on unrealistic timelines with data and experience - ground planning in delivery reality
  • Propose alternative approaches based on hands-on experience: "I've tried that and here's what happened"
  • Question standards and patterns to ensure they serve real needs - challenge both over-engineering and under-engineering
  • Advocate for technical excellence while remaining pragmatic about business constraints

Collaborative Design & Refinement

  • Participate in design sessions - contribute implementation insights to architectural discussions
  • Review ADRs and design patterns for implement-ability - validate designs can be decomposed into stories
  • Participate in refinement - help decompose features into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Validate story sizing, complexity estimates, and technical feasibility before "Ready" state
  • Identify technical prerequisites, dependencies, missing context, or unclear requirements
  • Conduct thorough code reviews: Terraform modules, Azure Policy definitions, pipeline configurations
  • Provide mentorship through constructive review feedback - balance quality with pragmatic delivery

Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship

  • Pair program with engineers - transfer knowledge hands-on during story implementation
  • Demonstrate best practices through doing, not just telling - build confidence through guided problem-solving
  • Share expertise through workshops, demos, and technical deep-dives
  • Document complex implementations and troubleshooting approaches - contribute to knowledge base and playbooks

What We’re Looking For:

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience:

  • 8+ years hands-on infrastructure engineering in cloud environments
  • Expert-level Terraform at enterprise scale - 50+ production modules/stacks
  • Deep Azure experience across networking, security, governance, compute, PaaS services
  • Proven delivery of complex infrastructure in regulated industries (banking, financial services, healthcare, government)
  • Agile/Kanban multifunctional team experience with architects, engineers, DevOps, security
  • Track record of constructive challenge and proposing feasible alternatives
  • Production troubleshooting experience resolving complex technical issues
  • Mentorship experience through pairing and hands-on collaboration

Skills:

  • Terraform: modules, state management, composable stacks, testing, patterns, anti-patterns
  • Azure: VNets, NSGs, Firewall, private endpoints, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Key Vault, Policy, compute, PaaS (App Service, Functions, ACA, AKS)
  • DevOps: CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), Git workflows, testing frameworks, scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
  • Design patterns: Secure-by-design, IaC best practices, hub-and-spoke networking, observability, resilience, DR
  • Microsoft ecosystem: M365, D365, Fabric, Power Platform integration patterns

Desirable Knowledge, Skills & Experience:

  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400)
  • Azure Enterprise Scale Landing Zones
  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes, ACA, AKS)
  • API Management (APIM, Logic Apps, Event Grid), SRE or DevOps transformation
  • Open-source contributions
  • Multiple IaC tools (Bicep, Ansible)
  • FinOps/cost optimization
  • Security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST)

Education:

  • Relevant degree desirable, or equivalent competencies in college.

Please note: This is a full-time, permanent position working remotely in Romania.

Fostering a culture of belonging and inclusivity

We're committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and included. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we actively cultivate an inclusive culture where diversity thrives, and we empower our colleagues to drive meaningful change within our organization through Employee Engagement initiatives and value champion networks.

Like many of our peers, we recognize that fostering inclusivity is an ongoing journey, and we remain steadfast in our commitment to progress. By measuring our efforts through regular assessments and listening to the feedback of our employees, we strive to ensure that our initiatives are impactful and responsive to the evolving needs of our workforce.

Together, we want to build a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work, as we believe this is the foundation of innovation, creativity, and collective success.

Interested?

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply Now” button to submit your application.

To discover more about Moneycorp and how we’re leading the way in global payments and currency risk management, please visit our News Hub and various social media platforms Facebook, Twitter UK, Twitter Americas, Instagram, LinkedIn.

Autodesk is strengthening its M&A HR capability to support disciplined growth, speed to integrate, and positive employee experience through change. The M&A Total Rewards Partner plays a critical role in supporting Total Rewards activities across the deal lifecycle, from diligence through close and post-close integration, by helping evaluate, advise on, and execute compensation and rewards decisions.

This trusted M&A TR advisor partners closely with Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, People Business Partners (PBPs), and People & Places leadership to assess workforce impacts, identify people related risks, and support informed, market aligned rewards decisions. You translate fast-moving and ambiguous deal inputs into clear, pragmatic recommendations that balance internal equity, external market competitiveness, cost, and employee experience.

Responsibilities

Deal Lifecycle Support

· Support end-to-end Total Rewards activities across M&A transactions, including due diligence, integration planning, deal modeling, close execution, and post-close integration

· Evaluate target company compensation structures, incentive plans, equity programs, and benefits positioning to identify risks, gaps, and integration considerations

· Partner with Finance and Corporate Development to support cost modeling, synergy assumptions, and people related deal risks

· Support communications and enablement related to compensation, benefits, retention programs, and other Total Rewards changes throughout the transaction lifecycle

Total Rewards & Market Analysis

· Conduct job and level mapping using Autodesk job architecture and market data

· Analyze internal and external market positioning to inform pay alignment, equity conversion, and retention recommendations

· Develop compensation, equity, and retention recommendations for executives and key talent populations where retention or leadership continuity is critical

· Assess target company benefits, identify gaps vs. company programs, and execute compliant, cost-effective transition and harmonization plans

· Support the design of transition, retention, and harmonization approaches consistent with Autodesk Total Rewards principles

Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership

· Partner with PBPs, Legal, and business leaders to surface implications, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward

· Prepare clear, decision-ready materials that summarize options, risks, and financial impact for leadership review

· Apply established governance and approval frameworks consistently across transactions

Execution & Integration

· Support or lead execution of approved Total Rewards actions in Workday and downstream systems

· Support cross-functional planning and coordination to ensure Total Rewards deliverables, dependencies, and milestones remain on track throughout the transaction lifecycle

· Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation

· Contribute to continuous improvement of M&A Total Rewards playbooks, tools, and templates based on deal learnings

· Provide project management support for Total Rewards activities across the M&A lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution

Broader Compensation Support

During periods of low M&A activity, this role is expected to flex across other Compensation functions, including:

  • Support Executive Compensation activities, including equity modeling and forecasting, peer group proxy data analysis, and preparation of Compensation Committee materials
  • Contribute to broad-based compensation activities, including benchmarking and retention analysis, and support annual compensation planning cycles

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, and/or M&A related HR work
  • 5+ years of experience supporting M&A transactions, integration, compensation, or workforce-related initiatives
  • Strong analytical capability, including compensation modeling and market data interpretation
  • Working knowledge of job architecture, leveling, and market pricing principles
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with discretion and handle highly confidential information
  • Comfort working in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments with shifting priorities and tight timelines
  • Strong cross-functional communication / presentation skills with business leaders

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to global compensation practices or multi-country integrations
  • Expertise in total rewards programs including employee benefits, with demonstrated experience in M&A integration, gap analysis, and program harmonization
  • Experience partnering with Corporate Development, Finance, or Legal teams

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: About This RoleK1x turns tax documents (K-1s, K-3s, state schedules, 990s, and a growing range of other filings and statements) into filing-grade structured data for CPA firms, family offices, and institutional investors.
jobs.description:
About This Role

K1x turns tax documents (K-1s, K-3s, state schedules, 990s, and a growing range of other filings and

statements) into filing-grade structured data for CPA firms, family offices, and institutional investors.

Accuracy and rework are the first thing our buyers ask about, and the models, prompts, and rules that

produce each extracted value are the product surface that answers them. That surface needs a

product manager fluent in how ML systems behave: how they are evaluated, where they fail, what

they cost, and when to replace a component rather than tune it. This role is the product manager for

the AI team: how its models and services are supplied to every K1x product line, partnering with the

Head of AI on delivery and with the other product managers on where those capabilities land.

What You'll Do

The AI roadmap. A rolling six-to-twelve-month roadmap for extraction coverage, accuracy, and the

platform underneath them, sized against real team capacity, sequenced with dependencies made

explicit, and re-planned when the evidence changes. You represent it in portfolio planning alongside

the other product roadmaps.

The demand queue. Intake and prioritization of new document types, forms, and fields requested by

Product, Tax Content, Sales, and Client Success. You rank the queue with a defensible framework

(RICE, WSJF, Kano, opportunity scoring, voice-of-customer synthesis), make sure each item arrives

with the definition and test data needed to validate it, and explain the ranking to those who did not get

their item first.

Accuracy as a product metric. Own how accuracy is defined and reported for each audience:

executive, customer, product, engineering. Translate model-level measures (per-field precision,

coverage, straight-through rate) into what a user experiences: what we missed, what they had to

touch, how many touches it took to reach a filing-ready result. Own the recurring accuracy report.

Product requirements for model and vendor decisions. Engineering evaluates and recommends

what serves each stage of the pipeline: a frontier model, one of our own models, or a vendor service.

You supply the product side of that decision: which accuracy, cost, and latency thresholds actually

matter to customers, the business case and budget for a change, and the acceptance criteria a

release must clear. You keep the decision record so the reasoning survives.

Capacity and the tax calendar. Filing peaks in September, October, and November drive usage; a

tax-year release lands every January. You plan engineering reserve around the peaks, own scope and

dates for the tax-year release, set the defect-intake service level with Client Success and QA, and

keep proof-of-concept work time-boxed.

The correction loop. Users correct extraction output inside our products. You partner with those

product managers and UX so corrections become a usable signal with field-level provenance, and over time a confidence-driven review experience.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of product management on shipped B2B software, ideally fintech or regtech where a wrong number costs more than a slow one, with at least 2 years owning an AI/ML-powered product surface: document AI or extraction, search and ranking, LLM features, or an ML platform.
  • Fluent in the mechanics: capacity planning against a real team, prioritization frameworks (RICE, WSJF, Kano, voice-of-customer synthesis), roadmap sizing, release management, and PRDs an engineer would actually read.
  • Understand how ML products fail differently from software: precision and recall trade-offs, evaluation sets, drift, cost per inference, and why "the model got it wrong" is a product question first.
  • Have made or shaped build, buy, or replace calls on model or vendor components, and can walk through one that went badly.
  • Write clearly and run a tight meeting. Half this job is turning engineers' conviction into a decision document Product, Tax, and Finance can act on.
  • Tax-domain knowledge is not required; Tax Content owns the rules and CPAs adjudicate. Curiosity is; the interesting failure modes live in the footnotes.

WHO WE ARE

Seagull Software, LLC, is a global leader in real-time, item-level visibility and label management solutions, dedicated to powering the world’s most complex supply chains with innovative tools for traceability, authentication, and automated inventory management. Our BarTender™️ platform enables businesses across all industries to design, manage, print, and automate the production of labels, barcodes, and RFID tags, ensuring seamless tracking and compliance for over 100 billion unique identifiers each year. Leveraging the Mojix™️ high-security, scalable SaaS traceability platform, Seagull delivers end-to-end intelligence, harmonizing data to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and reduce risk. Learn more at

We’re a growing, profitable, mid-size business with a nearly 40-year history of leading in our field. Headquartered in Redmond, Washington, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia, Seagull empowers businesses worldwide to keep their products moving, traceable, and safe.  You’ll work with global, talented, and diverse teams, passionate about what they do and its impact on everyone, everywhere.  Join us and help shape the way the world works.

LOCATION

This direct contractor position is remote from LATAM, working for a US company.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a detail-oriented, analytical problem solver who enjoys building practical processes, improving data quality, and turning sales data into clear insights. You work well with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations partners, communicate findings clearly, and are comfortable learning new systems in a fast-paced global SaaS environment.

JOB SUMMARY

The Sales Analyst supports the day-to-day operating rhythm of Seagull’s sales organization. The role builds and maintains reporting, performs recurring and ad hoc analysis, improves sales processes and data quality, and provides reliable insights that help sales teams make informed decisions across the customer lifecycle for our subscription and license customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Key responsibilities of the Sales Analyst include:
  • Sales Planning and Forecasting Support
    • Forecasting Support: Maintain forecast templates, consolidate pipeline inputs, analyze historical trends, and highlight changes, risks, and data gaps for review by Sales and Finance leaders.
    • Target and Territory Analysis: Prepare data and analysis used to support sales targets, quotas, territories, and capacity planning.
    • Planning Models: Build and maintain practical models for pipeline coverage, bookings, revenue, renewals, and sales productivity.
    • Revenue Risk Analysis: Identify potential contraction, churn, or forecast risks and support root-cause analysis with clear, actionable data.
  • Sales Operating Rhythm and Collaboration
    • Operating Cadence: Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, meeting materials, and follow-up trackers.
    • Cross-Functional Support: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations to gather requirements, validate data, and deliver analysis and process improvements.
    • Documentation and Follow-Through: Document definitions, workflows, decisions, and action items to improve consistency and accountability.
  • Data Management and Analytics
    • Data Quality: Monitor CRM and related data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency; investigate issues and coordinate corrections with process owners.
    • Data Analysis: Analyze pipeline, bookings, revenue, retention, and customer data to identify trends, variances, and business drivers.
    • Reporting and Dashboards: Provide the BI team with business requirements to build, maintain, and improve recurring reports and dashboards that provide clear visibility into sales performance and key SaaS metrics.
    • Business Insights: Summarize findings in concise presentations and written updates tailored to business stakeholders.
  • Performance Management
    • KPI Monitoring: Track funnel conversion, pipeline coverage, sales velocity, win rates, productivity, customer acquisition cost, churn, and retention metrics.
    • Variance Analysis: Compare actual performance with targets, forecasts, prior periods, and relevant benchmarks; explain key drivers.
    • Continuous Improvement: Recommend practical improvements to reports, metrics, and workflows based on recurring analysis and stakeholder feedback.
  • Process Optimization
    • Workflow Improvement: Map current sales and customer-success workflows, identify manual steps or control gaps, and help implement simpler, more scalable processes.
    • Process Standardization: Create and maintain process documentation, templates, definitions, and standard operating procedures.
    • Sales Enablement Support: Build simple tools, reference materials, and reporting views that help sales teams use processes and systems effectively.
  • Sales Technology and Automation
    • CRM and Tools: Support day-to-day use of Salesforce and related sales tools by testing reports, documenting requirements, and helping troubleshoot data or workflow issues. Partner with the BI team so the single source of truth is clear and well-defined.
    • System Support: Work with Operations and BI teams to validate integrations and ensure data moves accurately across platforms.
    • Automation: Build or support lightweight automation for recurring reports, data preparation, quality checks, and routine workflows.
  • Customer Lifecycle Management
    • Customer Lifecycle Analysis: Analyze customer acquisition, onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, and retention data.
    • Renewal and Expansion Support: Maintain tracking and reporting that helps account teams prioritize upcoming renewals and expansion opportunities.
    • Churn Analysis: Support analysis of churn and contraction drivers, including recurring root-cause reporting and data validation.
  • Compliance and Risk Management
    • Data and Process Compliance: Follow established controls and data handling practices.
    • Risk Identification: Flag material data issues, process gaps, and revenue risks to the appropriate business owners.

WHAT WE REQUIRE
  • 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, FP&A, or a related analytical role; Subscription software experience is required.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience working with sales, pipelines, bookings, revenue, or customer data.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; experience building repeatable models and analyses.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or another CRM, including reports, dashboards, and core data structures.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) is highly desired
  • Ability to translate business questions into structured analysis and communicate findings clearly.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency and productivity, including the practical use of AI tools.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ownership of recurring deliverables.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, learning new tools, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative working style and willingness to perform hands-on data, reporting, documentation, and process-building work.
  • Be adaptable, take ownership of deliverables, and build practical, scalable solutions that get results.

EDUCATION
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, analytics, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

TERMS OF CONTRACT
  • This is a direct contractor position and therefore not eligible for benefits.
  • Prior to the start of your contract, you must provide documentation proving authorization to work as an independent contractor (self-employed) as well as a Police Clearance Certificate.
OUR CULTURE

We offer a dynamic, culturally diverse, and fun environment where people with energy, creativity, and passion work together to deliver amazing product experiences for our customers. Join a team where your background is valued and respected, and your unique insights and ideas contribute to building a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

Who we need

At SymPro, an Aquila company and part of Constellation Software, we provide treasury management software that supports investment, debt, and cash management operations for public sector organizations across North America. With more than 400 customers, we help government agencies and public institutions improve financial accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency in complex treasury environments. Backed by the stability of Constellation Software and the long-term ownership model of Aquila, SymPro combines the strength of an established business with the agility of a focused, product-led software company.

Reporting to the Sales and Marketing Manager, we are hiring a Business Development Representative to help expand our presence in the public sector market across North America. As our new Business Development Representative, you will connect with finance and treasury decision-makers at government agencies and public institutions, introducing our investment, debt, and cash management software solutions and creating opportunities for our sales team. Through targeted outbound prospecting, research, and personalized outreach, you will build relationships with prospective customers, identify opportunities to introduce additional solutions to existing organizations, and book meetings that move sales conversations forward.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States or Canada.

What’s in it for you

A proven product with a compelling story to take to market. We have built a strong reputation and established presence in the public sector treasury management market. You will have the opportunity to introduce our broader suite of investment, debt, and cash management solutions to organizations that may already know and trust us, while opening doors with new customers. You will build your sales skills around technology that addresses real financial challenges, supported by the credibility of an established business and the opportunity to help expand our market reach.

Learn from experienced sales professionals. You will have the opportunity to learn from an experienced business development colleague and gain exposure to the broader sales process, including sales conversations and product demonstrations. You will develop an understanding of how initial outreach turns into meaningful customer relationships while building the confidence, communication skills, and commercial knowledge to take on greater responsibility.

Build a career with room to grow. Whether you are looking to break into technology sales or build on your existing experience, you will join us as we strengthen our sales and marketing capabilities. As your skills and interests evolve, you may have opportunities to move into inside sales, account management, customer success, or other commercial roles across SymPro and the broader Aquila organization. You will have the chance to explore different paths and discover where your strengths can take you.

As our new Business Development Representative, you will

  • Create targeted sales opportunities. You will research public sector organizations and identify finance, treasury, investment, accounting, and operational contacts who may benefit from SymPro’s solutions. Using CRM data, online research, sales tools, and thoughtful prospecting, you will build targeted outreach lists and focus your efforts on the accounts and contacts most likely to generate meaningful conversations.

  • Open conversations that lead to meetings. You will reach out to prospective customers and existing contacts through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels. You will tailor your message to the audience, communicate professionally, navigate gatekeepers, handle objections, and maintain momentum through follow-up with the goal of booking qualified meetings and demos for the sales team.

  • Support a healthy early-stage funnel. You will help increase activity, demos, and early-stage pipeline by qualifying inbound interest, following up on marketing and event leads, and handing off opportunities with clear context. Because SymPro works in a defined market, you will balance quality and volume, ensuring meetings are with the right contacts in the right organizations.

  • Strengthen outreach through market insight. You will learn SymPro’s product suite, including investment, debt, and cash management solutions, as well as the broader public sector treasury management landscape. You will use that knowledge to understand customer challenges, refine messaging, and share prospect feedback with Sales and Marketing to improve target lists, outreach cadences, and early-stage opportunity quality.

  • Use tools and technology to work smarter. You will maintain accurate records of activity, contacts, follow-up, and meeting outcomes in the CRM. You will use research tools, AI-enabled tools, and available sales technology to improve account research, personalize outreach, and work efficiently while applying judgment before anything reaches a prospect.

You bring

  • The sales drive. You are goal-focused, persistent, and motivated by the opportunity to create conversations from the ground up. You can handle unanswered calls, rejection, and objections without losing momentum, and you understand that consistent, thoughtful outreach is part of building a strong sales career.

  • The prospecting mindset. You can identify, research, and qualify potential customers using account information, online research, CRM data, and sales tools. You are curious about organizations, buyers, competitors, and customer challenges, and you know that effective outreach starts with understanding who you are contacting and why it matters.

  • The communication and professionalism. You can speak and write clearly, tailor your message to the audience, and represent SymPro with credibility from the first interaction. You are comfortable contacting finance and treasury stakeholders, asking thoughtful questions, handling objections, and creating enough trust and interest to move a conversation forward.

  • The follow-through. You take ownership of your work, manage follow-up carefully, and keep accurate records. You understand that booking a meeting is only part of the job. The details, notes, timing, and handoff all contribute to the customer experience and the sales team’s success.

  • The learning agility. You are interested in learning SymPro’s products, the public sector market, and the treasury management space, including investment, debt, and cash management workflows. Previous experience in technology, SaaS, sales development, business development, customer service, banking, financial services, public sector, or another customer-facing environment is an asset.

  • The technology mindset. You are comfortable learning CRM systems, sales tools, and AI-enabled research or outreach tools. You can use technology to improve your work while applying good judgment, reviewing content carefully, and making sure outreach feels human, relevant, and professional.

Why join?

SymPro and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At Sympro and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is $60,000 to $70,000 plus bonus and commission.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining SymPro and Aquila and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with the General Manager focused on your communication style, motivation, professionalism, persistence, and interest in building a career in sales.

  • A final virtual interview with the General Manager and the Portfolio Manager focused on your approach to outreach, follow-up, learning, and customer communication.

Company Overview
Glint Tech Solutions is a women-owned, global IT staffing and recruiting firm supporting enterprise clients across the USA and Canada.

A leading enterprise client, a multinational telecommunications technology company, is seeking a Data / Context Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping how knowledge flows across a massive, multi-region operation. jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the Role

We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. This is an analytics-driven, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in Google Search Console, GA4, and the browser dev tools as in a keyword report. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. In practice, the role covers part of what product marketing would otherwise do.

What You Will Do

Technical SEO and GEO

  • Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data and schema, rendering, redirects, internal linking, and site architecture.
  • Optimize the site for AI search (generative engine optimization): make Improvado understandable, citable, and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar engines.
  • Monitor visibility in both classic and AI search, and turn the findings into prioritized fixes.

Website optimization and conversion

  • Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages).
  • Plan and run experiments (A/B tests, template and layout changes, messaging tests) and measure their impact on conversions and pipeline.
  • Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking).

Analytics and measurement

  • Build and maintain dashboards that connect organic and on-site behavior to leads, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Own tracking quality: events, attribution, and data accuracy across GA4, Search Console, and related tools.
  • Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form.

Product and messaging input

  • Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy.
  • Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions.

What We Are Looking For

Must have

  • 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion.
  • Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered.
  • Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast.
  • Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, or a clear, demonstrable track record of working on it.
  • Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data.
  • Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team.

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS or marketing technology background.
  • Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript.
  • SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows.
  • Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms.
  • Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging.

You are

  • Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes.
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision.
  • A clear communicator across time zones.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.

We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. We are seeking an Associate Director, Professional Services to lead day-to-day operations across our Professional Services Delivery, Cloud Solutions, and Cloud Solutions Architecture functions. Reporting to the Director, Professional Services, this leader will be responsible for delivery quality, team performance, utilization, capacity, project profitability, and consistent execution across project-based and managed cloud services.

The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership, technical and cloud-services knowledge, operational judgment, and client-facing communication with the ability to scale delivery across multiple teams. This role is central to creating sustainable execution within Professional Services while enabling the Director to focus on broader department strategy and service portfolio growth.

jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to #changelivesforgood.

Location: Remote (U.S.) | Preferred: New York/New Jersey-based talent

Responsibilities

What You'll Actually Do

The role

The Head of Client Success, Wellbeing is the senior-most Customer Success leader within the Wellbeing division at Personify Health. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, Wellbeing, you will lead a global organization of managers and their teams serving about 1,000 large direct employer, channel, and health plan clients, and you will be accountable for the renewal, retention, and expansion results that drive our growth. This is a remote role.

Your organization owns client satisfaction, renewals, retention, and growth within our existing client base, along with the health and engagement outcomes our clients expect from us. As a member of the Personify Wellbeing Commercial Leadership Team (CLT), you will help the executive team and board shape strategy and cross-functional plans, set the vision and operating model for Customer Success, advise on client strategy and program design, and serve as the executive escalation point across our global book of business.

Who you are

You are a senior executive who has led customer success or account management at scale, ideally in digital health, health plans, or health systems. You care about health and wellbeing, you keep a close eye on the industry, the competition, and the regulatory environment that affect our clients, and you work with client executives as a trusted advisor, not just a point of contact.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities/Duties

This is a broad executive role. These are the areas where you will make the biggest difference:

  • Lead and develop a global organization, building a strong leadership bench of managers with a range of experience and tenure
  • Lead transformative change: set the vision for Customer Success and realign team structures and ways of working to optimize results as our business and clients evolve
  • Be accountable for client satisfaction, annual renewals, and net growth targets across a complex, demanding client base
  • Own client health scoring and retention forecasting, and hold the organization accountable for spotting and acting on risk early
  • Drive “Land and Expand” within existing clients, cross-selling and upselling our growing set of technology and services, and driving adoption of product expansions
  • Help clients see the value they are getting by reporting on outcomes and ROI, and turn successful clients into references
  • Act as a strategic advisor and executive sponsor to senior client decision makers, step into select quarterly and annual reviews, and set the standard for how Customer Success Managers (CSMs) build strategic recommendations and action plans tied to each client’s goals
  • Stay close to your clients’ business models and their employee health, wellbeing, and engagement priorities, and make that the standard for your team
  • Own the Customer Success P&L, including workforce planning, forecasting, and cost-to-serve, using automation and AI where they help
  • Share the product roadmap with clients clearly and with energy, and be the voice of the client at the executive table, partnering with internal leaders to meet client needs and improve our offering
  • Represent Customer Success in the mid and late stages of strategic sales pursuits
  • Partner with fellow executives to break down silos and drive continuous improvement across the organization
  • Stay on top of the health technology market and serve as a key influencer of strategy and execution as it changes

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education and Experience

To represent the best of what we have to offer, you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred
  • 10+ years in progressively senior leadership roles in customer success, account management, or professional services, preferably in technology or tech-enabled services, including leading managers and large teams
  • Domain experience in digital health, wellbeing, total rewards, health plans, or benefits administration preferred
  • Proven success in a consultative account executive environment, building relationships with senior client decision makers
  • Experience leading a global organization in a complex, matrixed, cross-functional environment, including P&L accountability
  • Experience driving transformative change
  • Experience leading a Customer Success function with a commercial mindset, with a strong focus on being a strategic advisor to clients and driving adoption of product expansions
  • A track record of building leadership teams that deliver profitable results, and of holding them accountable for analyzing client health metrics and catching retention risks early
  • Strategic thinker with experience realigning team structures to optimize success, and the skill to turn vision into a working plan
  • Executive presence, emotional intelligence, an innovative spirit, and a data-driven mindset
  • Excellent communicator who can brief executives and boards, with diplomacy, confidence as a public speaker, and attention to detail
  • Passion for client success, health, and wellbeing, and energy for a fast-paced, innovative environment

Physical Requirements

  • Must be willing to travel 25 - 50% of the time.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other productivity equipment.
  • Must communicate information and ideas so others understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • Must be able to observe details at close range.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $265,000 - $295,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . Supporting our members and vast network of providers is a team of professionals known for innovation, collaboration, and teamwork. If you would like to contribute to this leading-edge work, we invite you to bring your experience and skills to BPN.

As a Behavioral Health Utilization Care Manager, you will be assigned to various hospitals where you will authorize initial admitting and do concurrent reviews for medical necessity. You will be working with facilities and out-patient providers and will collaborate with other reviewers if there is a change to patients continuum of care. You will utilize your clinical experience, excellent collaboration skills, strong time management, and your ability to be a strong communicator to meet requirements for compliancy and member care.

Your work schedule will be Monday-Friday primarily 8:00 a.m.- 5:00 p.m. Arizona Time Zone. Your work location will be entirely remote. This position does require Arizona residency for compliance. If this role sounds like the one for you, apply today!

Banner Plans & Networks (BPN) is an accountable care organization that joins Arizona's largest health care provider, Banner Health, and an extensive network of primary care and specialty physicians to provide the most comprehensive healthcare solutions for Maricopa County and parts of Pinal County. Through BPN, known nationally as an innovative leader in new health care models, insurance plans and physicians are coming together to work collaboratively to keep members in optimal health, while reducing costs.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is the point person for all utilization activities for assigned members. As part of an interdisciplinary team, this position reviews and authorizes behavioral health and substance abuse services in inpatient, residential and outpatient settings using approved medical necessity criteria. Monitors care to ensure treatment is appropriate and effective. This position assesses the member’s plan of care and develops, implements, monitors and documents the utilization of resources and progress of the member through their care, facilitating options and services to meet the member’s health care needs. This position provides telephonic or electronic document review. This position engages internal and external resources to ensure members receive appropriate care plan and discharge planning services. This position monitors for quality of care concerns. Will staff regularly with medical directors. Within the scope of their position and licensure, this position will provide education and recommend alternative care plans for treatment not meeting medical necessity criteria. This position is accountable for the quality of clinical services delivered by both them and others and identifies/resolves barriers which may hinder effective care delivery to members. May conduct prior authorization, concurrent, retrospective, and appeal reviews.


CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Manages individual members across the health care continuum to achieve the optimal clinical, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.


2. Acts in a leadership function with process improvement activities for populations of patients to achieve the optimal clinical, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.


3. Evaluates the medical necessity and appropriateness of care, optimizing patient outcomes.


4. Establishes and promotes a collaborative relationship with physicians, other payers, and other members of the health care team. Collects and communicates pertinent, timely information to fulfill utilization and regulatory requirements.


5. Acts in a leadership function to collaboratively develop and manage the interdisciplinary patient discharge plan. Effectively communicates the plan across the continuum of care.


6. Educates internal members of the health care team on case management and managed care concepts. Facilitates integration of concepts into daily practice.


7. Has the freedom to determine how to best accomplish functions within established procedures. Confers with supervisor on any unusual situations. Positions are facility based with potential for remote work, with no budgetary responsibility. Internal customers: All levels of health plan staff, medical staff, and all other members of the interdisciplinary health care team. External Customers: Hospitals, physicians and their office staff, payers, community agencies, provider networks, and regulatory agencies.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Requires master’s degree in social work, counseling or related field or with independent or associate licensure. Licensure in at least one of the following categories as required by state law: Social work, professional counseling or marriage and family. Appropriate licenses include: LCSW, LMSW, LPC, LAC, or Licensed Psychologist. Requires a proficiency level typically achieved with three years clinical experience (i.e. counseling, care management, case management, care coordination in inpatient or outpatient levels of care).

Must have a working knowledge of care management, case management, hospital and community resources. Must demonstrate critical thinking skills, problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and time management skills. Must demonstrate ability to work effectively independently and in an interdisciplinary team format.

Previous experience with behavioral health utilization management.


Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Director (P&C Insurance)
jobs.excerpt: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.
jobs.description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.

This role owns Nearmap's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.

The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.

You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.

You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.

You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap:

  • Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.
  • Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.
  • Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.
  • Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.
  • Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.
  • Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

  • Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.
  • Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.
  • Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.
  • Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.
  • Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

  • Track NAIC, NAMIC, and NCOIL activity on insurance AI and imagery, including the NAIC AI Systems Evaluation Tool, and represent Nearmap's perspective in those venues.
  • Advise product and data science on filing implications before new attributes and scores ship, so regulatory risk is designed out and new products are released in a “filing-ready” state.

You'll make the field credible:

  • Equip Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success with accurate positioning on what our filing history does and does not transfer to a given state.
  • Build the filing schedules, metrics, and playbooks the whole insurance vertical works from.

Experience

  • 8 to 12 years in property and casualty rate filings, regulatory affairs, or state product management. Personal lines property especially.
  • Hands-on experience managing complete filing lifecycles and interacting directly with state insurance regulators. California experience is a significant advantage.
  • Experience preparing regulator-ready materials: filing narratives, methodology summaries, actuarial exhibits, statistical plans, forms, and rate pages.
  • Bachelor's degree in insurance, actuarial science, public policy, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills

  • You know SERFF and multi-state prior-approval processes cold, and you know which states behave differently and why.
  • You can translate model documentation and validation output into language a regulator will accept the first time.
  • You work towards many parallel deadlines you do not control, and you do not drop them.
  • You hold your own in a room with carrier actuarial and regulatory teams.
  • You write clearly, and you can explain a technical method to a reviewer without losing the substance.

What makes you stand out

  • Actuarial credentials such as ASA or ACAS, or relevant regulatory training or certification.
  • Prior regulator-side experience inside a department of insurance.
  • Experience with AI, predictive model, or catastrophe model filings, and familiarity with model governance frameworks.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining advisory or rating organization status.

You’ll be successful if you are:

  • Comfortable being the first person in a function and writing the playbook while the work is live.
  • Calm under deadlines set by other people, which is most of them.
  • Commercially aware. You understand that filing approval is a revenue event, and a delay is not just an inconvenience.
  • A strong communicator in writing, in conversation, and on a call with a regulator.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers:

  • 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked!
  • Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back.
  • Generous parental leave policies for growing families.
  • Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work!
  • Discounted Private Health Insurance plans.
  • A Nearmap subscription (naturally!).

Learn More About The Work We Do:

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.
