jobs.title: Credentialing Coordinator (FT, Days - Remote)
jobs.excerpt: We’re not just behavioral health people—we’re crisis people.
jobs.description:
We’re not just behavioral health people—we’re crisis people.
Connections Health Solutions is a leading provider of immediate-access behavioral health crisis care. Our team combines medical and recovery-oriented treatment to stabilize individuals in crisis and connect them to community-based resources for ongoing recovery.
Founded by emergency room psychiatrists Dr. Chris Carson and Dr. Robert Williamson, our model is physician-led and data-driven, drawing upon more than 15 years of crisis care expertise. Recognized by SAMHSA and the National Council for Mental Wellbeing as a national best practice, we’ve delivered invaluable treatment to hundreds of thousands of individuals facing crises. Our commitment remains consistent, to improve access, inspire hope, and provide the right support.
Our values shape our decisions, define our culture, and foster continuous learning and growth.
We accept people as they are, creating safe spaces where they feel valued and respected. We inspire hope by walking with people side-by-side, showing them grace and compassion. We act with intention, holding ourselves and each other accountable, and doing the right thing. We work as one team, trusting and supporting each other. We embrace change and innovation, striving to find better ways to fulfill our mission.
We are on a mission to change the face of behavioral health. Help us save lives and make a difference.

What You'll Do:

Under the direction of the Director, RCM Implementation, the Credentialing Coordinator manages the end-to-end credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment process for behavioral health providers, behavioral health support (BHS) staff, and facilities across Connections Health Solutions (CHS). This role serves as the subject matter expert for credentialing requirements across licensed clinical providers and non-licensed behavioral health support staff, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant credentialing files that support billing, payer enrollment, and delegation of authority obligations.

  • Provider Onboarding & Data Entry
    • Manages new provider onboarding from initial HR/Talent Acquisition notification through completion of the provider’s Medallion profile. Enters and maintains provider information, including NPI, licensure, practice locations, and payer information, using the provider’s CV and supporting documentation.
  • Provider Communication
    • Initiates and tracks onboarding communications with providers to request required documentation, including CAQH, PECOS, state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, diplomas, and other required credentials. Conducts timely follow-up to ensure provider profiles reach 100% completion.
  • Verbal Provider Support
    • Initiates and responds to phone calls and text messages with physicians and other providers to explain credentialing and enrollment requirements, resolve outstanding items, and answer questions when direct communication is needed to keep the credentialing process moving forward.
  • Provider Licensing Research
    • Researches and interprets state licensing board requirements across provider types, including MDs, DOs, NPs, and PAs, to determine applicable licensure, supervision or collaborative agreement, and scope-of-practice requirements by market. Maintains current knowledge of regulatory and licensing board changes that may impact credentialing.
  • Primary Source Verification (PSV)
    • Monitors and completes required primary source verifications within the credentialing platform, including NPI, NPDB, Medicare/Medicaid opt-out, state licensure, DEA, OIG, and SAM checks. Escalates adverse findings through the appropriate credentialing committee review process prior to the provider’s start date.
  • Malpractice & Insurance Coordination
    • Coordinates with the organization’s insurance broker to add new providers to the applicable malpractice policy. Uploads resulting facesheets, certificates, and other required documentation to the credentialing platform and CAQH.
  • Payer Enrollment & Maintenance
    • Manages provider enrollment with applicable commercial and government payers by market. Monitors applications through completion, escalates stalled or non-compliant applications, and verifies effective dates, payer IDs, and recredentialing dates are accurately documented following approval.
  • CAQH & Attestation Management
    • Maintains and re-attests provider CAQH profiles, ensuring practice locations, liability coverage, and other required information remain current and accurate for payer enrollment.
  • Multi-State & Telehealth Licensing
    • Supports cross-state licensure and payer enrollment for telehealth providers, including updates to practice location and licensure information and coordination of additional malpractice insurance coverage for new markets.
  • State-Specific Registration Processes
    • Facilitates state and program-specific registration requirements, including prescriptive authority and collaborative agreement registration for advanced practice providers, state Medicaid portal enrollment, domain transfers, surrogacy requests, and Medicare enrollment through CMS/PECOS.
  • BHS Staff Credentialing
    • Manages NPI acquisition and state Medicaid enrollment for applicable behavioral health support staff. Tracks enrollment status through supplemental tracking tools and distributes recurring compliance reports, including missing NPI and Medicaid enrollment information, to HR and operational leadership for follow-up.
  • Facility Credentialing
    • Manages facility-level enrollment and maintenance within applicable state Medicaid systems, including linking servicing providers to facility records and maintainingaccurate facility enrollment information.
  • Offboarding
    • Processes provider and BHS staff terminations by deactivating credentialing platform profiles and notifying applicable payers of provider departures in accordance with market-specific requirements.
  • Ongoing Maintenance & Recredentialing
    • Performs routine monitoring of OIG/SAM and NPDB databases and tracks provider recredentialing cycles, typically every three years. Monitors license and board certification renewal requirements and completes necessary updates to prevent credentialing or enrollment lapses.
  • Delegation of Authority
    • Completes credentialing documentation under applicable delegation of authority requirements and ensures activities remain compliant with delegated credentialing agreements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partners with Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Medical Leadership, and operational leadership to facilitatetimely provider onboarding, resolve credentialing or compliance issues, and support new-hire orientation timelines.
  • Committee Participation & Reporting
    • Participates in quarterly Credentialing Committee meetings and prepares regular reporting on provider, BHS staff, and facility credentialing and enrollment status for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and operational leadership.
  • Process Documentation
    • Supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of standardized credentialing workflows, reference guides, process documentation, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational and departmental objectives.

This is a fully remote position in these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI

What You'll Bring:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 2 years of experience in provider and/or facility credentialing, payer enrollment, or related managed care administrative work
  • General knowledge of regulatory requirements related to credentialing and payer enrollment, including a solid understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care processes and rules
  • Ability to research and interpret state licensing board requirements across provider types (MD, DO, NP, PA) and apply them accurately to credentialing decisions
  • Experience working within a credentialing software platform (e.g., Medallion) or comparable credentialing management system
  • Working knowledge of provider enrollment systems such as PECOS, CAQH, and state Medicaid provider portals
  • Strong customer service orientation and soft skills, with comfort communicating by phone or text with physicians and providers to resolve credentialing questions and outstanding items, in addition to email-based correspondence.
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel.
  • The Company has a mandatory vaccination policy. All successful applicants must be fully vaccinated, including showing proper documentation, or otherwise be exempt pursuant to the Company’s exemption process prior to their start date as a condition of employment.

It would be great if you had:

  • Bachelor's degree in health care administration or a related field
  • 3+ years of credentialing or payer enrollment experience within a behavioral health environment
  • Familiarity with CAQH attestation processes and delegated credentialing requirements
  • Experience supporting multi-market or multi-state credentialing and enrollment operations

What We Offer:

Full-time only:

  • Employees (and their families) are offered comprehensive health insurance, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • CHS pays for Basic Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Life insurance option for employees and their families

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (health care and dependent care)

  • Company‑paid parental leave available to eligible employees

All employees (Pool, Part-time and Full-time):

  • Employee Assistance Program to help with confidential emotional support, work life solutions, financial solutions, legal assistance, or online support
  • After 90 days, you are auto enrolled in the 401k Plan

We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants.

jobs.title: Amazon Operations Manager - This is Unicorn
jobs.excerpt: The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for This is Unicorn's clients.
jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for This is Unicorn's clients. This includes managing inventory, coordinating shipments, setting up promotions, supporting product launches, uploading content, preparing reports, and resolving operational challenges to help clients improve their performance and grow their businesses on Amazon.

As an Amazon Operations Manager, you will work across multiple client brands and Amazon marketplaces, primarily in the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing sales and inventory data, identifying operational issues and growth opportunities, making recommendations based on your findings, and executing tasks that support each client's goals. You will need to understand how different aspects of Amazon operations affect a brand's performance, from inventory availability and product listings to promotions and new product launches.

A significant part of this role involves problem-solving. Amazon is a constantly evolving platform, and you will regularly encounter situations that require you to investigate unfamiliar issues, evaluate available information, and find practical solutions. You will work closely with the wider This is Unicorn team, receive training on the agency's processes and ways of working, and participate in regular training and feedback sessions to continuously develop your expertise.


About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Amazon Operations Manager is to ensure that the operational activities of our clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts are managed accurately and effectively, while supporting their business growth through data-driven decisions, consistent execution, and proactive problem-solving.

As our Amazon Operations Manager, this will include monitoring and managing inventory, identifying replenishment priorities, supporting product launches and promotional activities, analyzing sales and operational performance, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions. You will be expected to approach challenges logically, take initiative in finding solutions, improve existing processes, and maintain a high standard of accuracy across your work.


General Responsibilities:

  • Managing and supporting the day-to-day operations of assigned clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts across different marketplaces
  • Setting up, monitoring, and managing inventory to support product availability and meet client requirements
  • Analyzing inventory levels, historical sales, and product performance to identify products that require replenishment or are at risk of running out of stock
  • Identifying products with excess inventory and recommending appropriate actions based on sales performance and available stock
  • Setting up and coordinating shipments to Amazon warehouses, ensuring that inventory-related activities are executed accurately
  • Supporting new product launches by completing the necessary operational setup
  • Uploading and updating product content within Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central
  • Monitoring product and listing performance, investigating potential issues, and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Interacting with Amazon Support to investigate operational issues, resolve problems, and follow up on outstanding matters
  • Creating and maintaining reports that provide insights into sales performance, inventory levels, and other relevant business metrics
  • Analyzing product performance across different product lines, variations, and categories to identify potential growth opportunities
  • Supporting strategic decisions by identifying which products or product lines should be prioritized based on sales performance, available inventory, and other relevant data
  • Identifying products or activities that may need to be deprioritized and explaining the reasoning behind those recommendations
  • Recognizing limitations in available data and identifying additional information needed to make more accurate operational and business decisions
  • Preparing clear, structured explanations of findings, recommendations, and proposed next steps for clients and internal team members
  • Identifying operational problems, investigating their causes, and developing practical solutions to resolve them
  • Taking initiative to research and resolve unfamiliar Amazon-related challenges, with support from the wider team when required
  • Ensuring that assigned operational tasks and recommended actions are implemented effectively and in line with client objectives
  • Participating in regular training, feedback, and professional development sessions to strengthen Amazon platform knowledge and operational capabilities
  • Continuously developing knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, and related tools to improve the quality and effectiveness of work
  • Contributing to the overall success of assigned clients by improving operational execution, identifying opportunities, and supporting business growth


Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

You will work daily with Engineering, Support, and Security, in Terraform, GitHub Actions, Grafana Cloud, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, CloudWatch, incident.io, Jira, and Confluence. Reporting to the Director of SaaSOps, you will shape how the platform is built, changed, and monitored.

If you want whole-platform ownership, hold a high bar on every change, and are ready to carry on-call for the systems you run, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Build and change Azure and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
  • Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Provision, upgrade, and tear down customer environments.
  • Operate Windows Server (Remote Desktop Services, IIS, Active Directory, Group Policy) and SQL Server / Azure SQL: patching, backups, restores, and performance.
  • Automate repeat operational work in PowerShell.
  • Carry on-call: keep alerts paging on customer impact, respond to incidents, fix the cause, and write the RCA.
  • Enforce least-privilege access, collect SOC 2 evidence, and keep runbooks current.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a cloud engineer running production workloads (compute, managed databases, identity, networking) on Azure or AWS.
  • You have deployed and changed production infrastructure with Terraform through CI/CD pipelines you built or maintained.
  • You write PowerShell automation used in production.
  • You have run SQL Server or Azure SQL in production: backups, restores, and performance troubleshooting.
  • You have carried production on-call and taken incidents from evidence to a single root cause and a written RCA a teammate can act on without follow-up questions.
  • You work 08:00–17:00 ET, Monday to Friday, and join the after-hours on-call rotation.
  • Professional English at C1 level or above, spoken and written.
  • You can be engaged as an independent contractor and can start within one month of an offer and no later than December 31, 2026.

Nice to have

*Production experience on Azure.

  • Windows Server administration in production (Remote Desktop Services, IIS, Active Directory, Group Policy).
  • AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-400, or AWS Solutions Architect Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate.
  • Experience preparing SOC 2 audit evidence.
  • Uses AI-assisted coding and operations tools at work.

Benefits

More than just perks, they're the essential components of a rewarding career at CXT Software.

  • 100% Remote and Global: Enjoy the freedom to live your best life from anywhere in the world.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work at times that suit you best. We prioritize results and customer satisfaction over rigid schedules.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. Change Management: Ability to support implementation efforts, user adoption, training initiatives, and operational transitions.

The Leave of Absence Manager is responsible for administering the Company’s leave of absence programs and ensuring compliant, compassionate, and consistent support for employees and managers. You will also contribute to preclinical, CMC, and clinical development plans with the goal of ensuring Spyre performs the necessary studies to gain and maintain product approval(s) that are consistent with our target product profile(s).
  • You will act as the overall lead of global regulatory applications for one or more drug candidates and will lead the submission of original investigational new drug and clinical trial applications. You will lead efforts to plan and prepare for meetings with global health authorities (Type C & EOP2 meetings with FDA, EMA scientific advice, etc.) and support live discussions. You will also support the team by contributing to the development of other assets for which you are not the overall lead, and by contributing to the development of processes for the Regulatory Department.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regulatory Strategy: Develop and implement regulatory strategies that enable the company’s clinical trials and marketing applications. Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements and industry trends and advise the company on regulatory expectations.
  • Regulatory Submissions: Prepare, review, and submit regulatory applications and dossiers to health authorities, such as the FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other global regulatory agencies, ensuring timely and successful approvals.
  • Health Authority Meetings: Plan meeting strategy, lead the development of briefing materials, capture action items, and support the team in implementation and strategy.
  • Communication: Represent the company in regulatory interactions and maintain effective communication with regulatory agencies, responding to inquiries and requests in a professional and efficient manner. Communicate regulatory agency interactions and guidance to Regulatory Affairs leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential regulatory risks and proactively develop strategies to mitigate them. Monitor changes in regulatory landscapes and assess their impact on the company's products.
  • Regulatory Intelligence: Keep abreast of new and evolving regulations, guidelines, and best practices in the pharmaceutical industry and adapt company strategies accordingly.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments, including Pre-clinical Research & Development, Clinical Development, Technical Operations, Legal, and Quality and Compliance to ensure regulatory considerations are integrated into the product development process.
  • Budget Management: Contribute to development and management of the regulatory affairs budget for assigned projects, ensuring cost-effective use of resources while maintaining high-quality regulatory activities.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs and/or related disciplines, or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and experience.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex regulatory submissions
  • Proven experience managing clinical trial applications in the US and globally
  • Strong knowledge of global pharmaceutical regulations and guidelines, including FDA, EMA, and ICH requirements
  • Proficient in medical and/or technical writing, including the ability to author or contribute to documents such as Module 2 and 3 summaries, DSURs, safety reports, investigational brochures, clinical trial protocols, clinical trial reports, and/or IMPDs
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities
  • Ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities
  • Proficiency in regulatory affairs software and document management systems.
  • Experience with CMC regulatory, device (e.g., pre-filled syringe and/or auto-injector) and/or diagnostic (e.g., companion diagnostics)

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you help shape the culture of our young company, contribute broadly to advance meaningful medicines, and learn quickly.
  • Market competitive compensation and benefits package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity grant opportunities, health, welfare & retirement benefits.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Two, one-week company-wide shutdowns each
  • Commitment to provide professional development opportunities.
  • Remote working environment with frequent in-person meetings to address complex problems and build relationships.

The expected salary range offer for this role is $220,000 to $245,000. Actual pay offered may vary depending on job related knowledge, experience, education, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager, Partnerships & Supply
jobs.excerpt: About EngineEngine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel.
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission:

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Partnership & Supply, you'll be the dedicated enablement partner for the teams that build and grow Engine's relationships with hotel and lodging partners. Our supply is a core part of what makes Engine work, and these teams keep it strong. New-hire onboarding is owned by a partner team. You own everything after it: ongoing enablement and everboarding that help partner and supply teams sign, activate, and grow partners. You'll report to the Manager, Revenue Enablement once that role is filled, and to the Director of Revenue Enablement until then. Here's what you'll take charge of:

Own Partnership & Supply Enablement

  • Everboarding Programs: Plan, build, and deliver training after onboarding for partner and supply teams, including skill-building paths, refreshers, and certifications on Engine's partner value proposition, programs, and processes.
  • Partner Sales Motion: Build and maintain the certification programs, training, job aids, and playbooks behind our partner sales motion, covering areas such as partner acquisition, negotiation, activation, and growing existing partner relationships.
  • Content & Knowledge Management: Keep partner and supply documentation, playbooks, and knowledge resources current and easy to find.
  • Onboarding Alignment: Partner with the onboarding team so what's learned in onboarding carries through once reps are ramped.
  • AI-First Enablement: Build AI first. Use AI to create partner certifications, job aids, playbooks, and knowledge resources at scale, and keep them current as programs and processes change.

Partner with the Partnership & Supply Business

  • Know the Supply Business: Build a deep understanding of how the partner and supply teams work, what partners need, what the teams are measured on, and what's changing in the lodging market.
  • Embedded Partnership: Spend regular time with partner and supply leaders, front-line managers, and reps. Join team meetings and pipeline reviews to understand needs and turn them into enablement that improves performance.
  • Rollout Support: Partner with Product, Growth, Revenue Operations, and the broader Revenue Enablement team to communicate and train on launches, process changes, and tool updates, freeing leaders to coach and sell.

Programs & Measurement

  • Measure What Matters: Track and report enablement impact for partner and supply teams, such as certification and program adoption, partner acquisition and activation, pipeline and conversion, and partner growth [TBD: confirm Partnership & Supply KPIs].
  • Performance Inspection: Drive results through inspection, evaluation, and accountability on the skills and playbooks you design.
  • Enablement Tech Stack: Make sure partner and supply teams get full value from our tools, including partner tools [TBD: confirm, e.g., PRM, Crossbeam]. Work with our tools and systems team so new tools actually get adopted.

Why This Role: AI-First at Engine
At Engine, AI isn't a side project. It's how we work. Our access to create with AI is incredibly unique, and this role is a rare chance to get exposure to a ton of AI tools and learn from the best. The expectation is simple: AI first, to create scale, so our partner and supply teams always have what they need to win. Building this way grows Engine, and it grows your skill set too. If you're growth-minded and excited to build what's next, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Bring to Engine:

We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

  • Experience: 4+ years in revenue enablement, sales enablement, sales training, or a customer-facing revenue role, including 2+ years designing and delivering enablement or training programs. [TBD: confirm years]
  • Partner & Supply Familiarity: Experience enabling or working on partnerships, supplier or channel teams, or account management, ideally in travel, hospitality, or a two-sided marketplace.
  • Facilitation: You can lead a room, in person or virtually, and you can turn complex programs and processes into training people actually use.
  • Business Acumen: You learn new business models quickly and can turn pipeline and performance data into a focused training or coaching response.
  • Skills: Strong project management, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, and you can influence across Sales, Product, Growth, and Revenue Operations.
  • Tech-Savvy: Bonus points if you're fluent in Salesforce, conversation intelligence tools (e.g., Momentum), enablement/LMS platforms (e.g., GTMBuddy, LetterAI), and partner tools such as PRM platforms or Crossbeam.
  • AI-First Mindset: You reach for AI first to create scale, and you're excited to get hands-on with a wide range of AI tools. You're growth-minded and eager to keep building your skill set.
  • Mindset: You're ready to roll up your sleeves, work independently, and deliver results that matter.

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on experience in hotel or lodging partnerships, supplier relations, revenue management, or OTA market management.
  • Background in B2B travel, hospitality, or marketplace businesses.
  • Experience building enablement for a new sales motion from scratch.
  • Examples of enablement content, job aids, or knowledge resources you've built with AI.

Location & Travel:This role is preferably based in or near one of our hubs in Denver, CO; Tempe, AZ; or Chicago, IL, and we're open to remote candidates elsewhere in the US. Expect to travel about one week per month to work with teams in person, plus major company events.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$115,600—$160,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

Overview

Dole Foods of Canada Company, part of the global Dole Packaged Foods organization, is a purpose-led company committed to championing accessible fruit nutrition and building a brighter future through the goodness of fruit.

At Dole, our culture is uniquely driven by core Values. Our commitment to these Values transforms our work into a meaningful journey toward a brighter future together. Here, you'll be part of a respectful, inclusive culture that deeply values our colleagues, customers, and global communities. We strive for excellence, empowering each other to confidently overcome challenges, continuously learn, and achieve world-class results. Guided by unwavering integrity, our actions consistently reflect our commitment to always doing what's right, fostering lasting trust and strong relationships. Through a spirit of collaboration, we cultivate positivity, generosity, and genuine teamwork, enabling collective success toward our One Dole Purpose. Our innovative spirit leads directly to meaningful outcomes and business success.

We are looking for an ambitious, results-oriented sales leader who combines strategic thinking with relentless execution. This individual will be a true business builder, leveraging Dole’s trusted brand equity, fact based selling capabilities, and category leadership approach to accelerate growth across Canada’s foodservice channel. This leader should thrive on finding creative solutions to challenges, to achieve the long-term vision for Dole Canada.

The National Sales Manager, Foodservice will play a critical leadership role in developing and accelerating Dole Canada's Foodservice business. Reporting to the Head of Sales, Retail & Foodservice, this position is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, cultivating strategic customer relationships, and managing key national and regional accounts.

This role requires a highly commercial leader who can successfully balance business development, account management, forecasting accuracy, profitability management, and strategic planning. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to think long-term while delivering immediate results, working cross-functionally to drive profitable growth and strengthen Dole's leadership position within the Canadian marketplace.

This is based remotely in the Toronto area with flexibility to work in our Markham, Ontario office when needed.

Responsibilities

Grow and penetrate accounts in the non-commercial & commercial channels to leverage and scale Dole as a tier one supplier both regional and national basis. Implement a strategic account management focus incorporating fact-based selling, category approach, insights and culinary to key stakeholders that influence GPOs (Group Purchasing Organizations) in the local markets and nationally.

  • Develop and present a sales strategy (by promotional activities, innovation, menu planning) to achieve or exceed the objectives of the Food Service business plan.
  • Identify opportunities for new business, channels and accounts, then define strategies to penetrate and increase sales. Monitor the negotiated business plans, analyse the results, and recommend any corrective strategies.

  • Manage trade spend and optimise profitability for new and existing client/distributor agreements, tenders, and contracts. Negotiate with your client portfolio in accordance with the budget and profitability plan to ensure all business deals are profitable on both sides.
  • Develop and lead the Brokers to achieve targets and develop pipeline to ensure strategies are in line to achieve or surpass the Food Service sales objectives and business plan.
  • Develop long-term partnerships with targeted accounts that result in increased sales and margins.
  • Develop headquarter relationships with key distribution customers including GFS and Sysco.
  • Adept at relationship building beyond the buyer and the seller by establishing relationships with stakeholders who have decision making influence.
  • Understand forecasting principles to ensure excellence in contract execution to inventory management by communicating to supply chain and customer service.
  • Communicate and advise on market information and identifying emerging business opportunities.
  • Develop and manage pricing strategies long term / month to month to achieve targeted profit and volumes.
  • Work closely with the supply chain, production, and customer service teams to ensure superior customer service levels are maintained.
  • Work with the team to prepare budgets, period reviews and forecasting reports.
  • Liaise and collaborate with internal stakeholders (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Quality Control and Finance) to assist in growing the non-commercial channel.
  • Other related duties as reasonably assigned, consistent with the scope of the role

Qualifications

Experience, Knowledge, & Skills You Bring:

  • 7-10 years of progressive successful Food Service Sales experience having a renowned track record in national account management, including non-commercial foodservice account or commercial foodservice multi-unit accounts.
  • CPG account management is required.
  • Experience leading a broker network in Canada, past experience managing Affinity is a plus.
  • Exceptional time management, prioritizing and organisational skills to meet deadlines with a strong sense of urgency and a drive for results
  • Strong financial and analytical skills with a comprehension of trade, profitability, and forecasting.
  • Ability to communicate with senior leadership within Dole and externally with customers.
  • Fact based selling approach and exudes confidence in negotiations.
  • Strong project management skills
  • Proficient in MS office applications

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Passionate about a purpose driven career
  • Demonstrates commitment to inclusion that support employee development and well-being
  • Establishes clear expectations and feedback loops, encourages innovation, and drives continuous improvement

jobs.title: Division Finance Director, Great Plains
jobs.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together: The Division Finance Director, Great Plains oversees the strategy, analysis, and management of financial activities and contracts services for the Great Plains Division, which covers 10 states: Arkansas, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, and Texas.
jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Division Finance Director, Great Plains oversees the strategy, analysis, and management of financial activities and contracts services for the Great Plains Division, which covers 10 states: Arkansas, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, and Texas. They serve as a thought partner to the Great Plains Division Director and Division Leadership Team in decision making, budgeting, and resource allocation. The position works across the Great Plains Division to strengthen financial strategy, stewardship, alignment, and decision support. They also collaborate with Division leadership and Legal to ensure that the Contracts team is providing timely, effective support to Great Plains Business Units.


The DFD provides broad oversight of Great Plains Division finances, including planning, reporting, and analysis of current finance and operations activities. They identify gaps in alignment and opportunities for efficiency and ensure financial management standards and compliance requirements are met. The DFD represents the Great Plains Division in regional and organization-wide initiatives and tailors implementation for the Division. This includes effectively addressing challenging situations that could affect the Division’s long-term financial or operational position. As needed, the DFD works across the organization to resolve high-priority issues, such as process gaps that impact business processes.


The DFD is responsible for synthesizing financial information for senior leaders and developing creative financial strategies that direct resources toward critical work. They drive improved financial performance and reduce financial and operational risk by identifying trends, anticipating challenges, and translating insights into actions that strengthen the Division’s financial position.They provide subject matter expertise, serve as a resource to the Great Plains Management Team, and drive alignment across the Division. The DFD manages the newly formed Great Plains Division Finance team, an organization of 18 staff members that includes six direct reports, and is accountable for setting direction, building team capability, and ensuring coordinated delivery of finance and contracts support services across the Division. This position reports to the North America Region Finance Director with a dotted line to the Great Plains Division Director.


RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Develops and implements financial strategy for the Great Plains Division, including resource deployment, risk management, and financial health.
  • Leads and manages the newly formed Great Plains Division Finance team of 18 staff members, including six direct reports; establishes team priorities, develops staff capabilities, manages performance, and ensures coordinated, high-quality finance and contracts support across the Division.
  • Delivers financial expertise, thought partnership, and decision-making support to the Great Plains Division Director, Great Plains Division Leadership Team, and Business Unit Finance staff.
  • Provides divisional leadership and influence by shaping cross-functional priorities, strengthening alignment among Pods and business units, and advancing finance-informed decisions across the Great Plains Division.
  • Leads long-range financial planning and sustainability efforts, including scenario analysis and strategic resource allocation to balance near-term priorities with long-term conservation and organizational needs.
  • Translates complex financial information into clear, decision-oriented insights and recommendations for executive leaders.
  • Partners with philanthropy and fundraising leaders to align financial strategy with revenue goals, assess funding opportunities, and develop sustainable funding approaches for divisional priorities.
  • Collaborates with Great Plains stakeholders on organization-wide initiatives, including Workday stabilization, and the operations and funding model, and tailors implementation for the Great Plains Division.
  • Leads planning, reporting, and analysis for Great Plains Division finances, including development of the Division budget.
  • Provides broad oversight of Great Plains Division Finance and Contracts activities to ensure financial management standards and compliance requirements are met.
  • Responsible for overseeing the Contracts Manager, who leads a team supporting contracts, procurement, purchasing, agreement workflows, documentation, and compliance across the Great Plains Division.
  • Manages and directs the implementation of multiple projects in a strategic, integrated and collaborative approach.
  • Decisions may have program-wide impact and may bind the organization or organizational unit financially and legally.
  • Ensures programmatic commitments, TNC policies and procedures, financial standards and legal requirements are met and managed for ethical compliance.
  • Reports to senior leadership on functional activities.

We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with strong experience in leading a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. The ideal candidate should have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience designing, organizing, and directing complex projects. jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

jobs.description:
​​​​​Role Summary

The Director of Product leads Greenshades' product organization — owning roadmap strategy, delivery execution, and product experience quality across our payroll, HR, and tax compliance solutions. This role carries a specific mandate to reorient product strategy for the AI era: identifying where AI can reshape workflows, unlock new efficiencies, and differentiate the platform. This role manages a team of Product Managers and a Product Experience/UX designer, and partners closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, and Product Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects real market and customer signal. As part of an integrated Product and Marketing organization, this role is central to tightening the loop between what customers need and what gets built.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and the Product Experience/UX function; set clear priorities, coach on craft, and manage performance and growth.
  • Own and maintain a groomed, prioritized product roadmap that reflects the highest-value initiatives across Greenshades' product lines, grounded in customer and market signal.
  • Drive Greenshades' product strategy into the AI era — evaluating where AI/ML can create step-change efficiency and experience improvements across the product line, and ensuring roadmap prioritization reflects that lens going forward rather than treating AI as a bolt-on feature.
  • Own Product Experience: ensure usability, design consistency, and overall product quality are considered alongside feature delivery, not treated as an afterthought.
  • Drive day-to-day product delivery in close partnership with Engineering, ensuring features ship on time, within scope, and aligned with roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to strengthen how customer and market signal flows into intake, triage, and prioritization — bringing structure and clarity to how requests become roadmap decisions.
  • Serve as a key product escalation point for significant customer and internal issues, working with Support, TPE, and Engineering to resolve or route issues appropriately.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to ensure roadmap priorities, positioning, and launch timing are aligned and well-sequenced.
  • Build and maintain deep working knowledge of payroll, HR, and tax business processes, including how AI is reshaping those domains, through customer research, competitive analysis, and ongoing industry engagement.
  • Partner with the CMO on Product team budget, resourcing, and prioritization tradeoffs; report on progress against roadmap and team capacity.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • 5-7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, including 5+ years leading a team of Product Managers or equivalent ICs.
  • Experience managing a complex domain (payroll, HR, tax, compliance, or similar), or a track record of quickly mastering a new business domain, with a specific example you can describe.
  • Have shipped AI or ML-enabled capabilities in a B2B product, or led a roadmap shift toward AI.
  • Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product talent, including managing performance and supporting career growth.
  • Experience balancing roadmap strategy with hands-on delivery, including keeping features on schedule and in scope alongside Engineering.
  • Experience working day to day with Engineering, Customer Success/CX, and Marketing to align product decisions with business priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining product strategy and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience presenting product strategy, roadmap progress, and resourcing tradeoffs to executive leadership, with the judgment to tailor depth and framing for an ELT audience.

Travel Required: Up to 15%

Location: This is a remote position.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Role: Sr Manager/ AD- Product Management, Bangalore
Experience: 6+ years
Salary: 20- 28 LPA

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the strategy and development of technology-enabled learning products. The role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping product experiences, defining roadmaps and validating innovations through research and data. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the individual will translate insights into scalable, user-centric products that improve learning experiences and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy, Discovery & Problem Framing

  • Lead product discovery and problem definition, drawing on user research, programme insights and field realities.
  • Identify user needs, pain points, constraints and opportunities across learners, educators and other stakeholders.
  • Conduct user interviews, stakeholder consultations and field immersions to validate problem statements.
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear product opportunities and solution directions.
  • Ensure product strategy is aligned with organisational priorities, user needs and intended learning outcomes.

2. Product Experience & Journey Ownership

  • Own end-to-end user journeys, from exploration and decision-making to learning and career transitions.
  • Define experience principles, product flows and interaction requirements across digital platforms and supporting touchpoints.
  • Work closely with UX and Learning Experience Design teams to create intuitive, engaging and accessible experiences.
  • Identify friction points affecting user engagement, retention, completion and learning outcomes.
  • Champion learner- and educator-centric design, particularly for users in low-resource and diverse learning environments.

3. Product Definition & Execution

  • Translate product opportunities into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Define feature scope, expected outcomes, dependencies and success measures.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Design teams to assess feasibility and ensure effective product delivery.
  • Guide teams through product trade-offs while maintaining focus on user value and strategic priorities.
  • Ensure alignment between product requirements, content experiences, technology and programme implementation.

4. Product Roadmap & Prioritisation

  • Develop and manage the product roadmap in alignment with strategic objectives and user needs.
  • Prioritise initiatives based on user value, learning outcomes, organisational priorities and evidence from research and experimentation.
  • Balance immediate product improvements with long-term product vision and scalability.
  • Continuously review and refine priorities based on user behaviour, performance data and emerging insights.
  • Build stakeholder alignment around product direction, timelines, priorities and trade-offs.

5. Product Analytics, Experimentation & Validation

  • Partner with Analytics and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) teams to define product success metrics, behavioural indicators and learning outcomes.
  • Drive data-informed product decisions through user behaviour analysis, feedback and performance insights.
  • Design and oversee A/B testing, usability studies, pilots and other product experiments.
  • Establish hypotheses, validation criteria and measurement frameworks for new features and initiatives.
  • Interpret experiment findings and translate them into actionable product recommendations.
  • Identify whether challenges are related to product design, content quality or implementation, and use evidence to determine appropriate interventions.

6. Innovation & Product Governance

  • Lead product-related contributions to innovation frameworks, validation processes and stage-gate reviews.
  • Define MVP assumptions, learning questions and validation criteria for new product opportunities.
  • Work with Programme, Product Operations, Analytics and Knowledge Management teams to assess and validate innovations.
  • Use evidence from pilots and experiments to determine whether initiatives should be scaled, refined, redesigned or discontinued.
  • Contribute to portfolio reviews, innovation assessments and strategic product decisions.
  • Ensure that product innovations are supported by clear adoption, engagement, learning and impact measures.

7. Experience Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain standards for usability, accessibility, consistency and overall product experience.
  • Monitor product health indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Work with Design, Engineering and Learning Experience Design teams to improve product quality and user satisfaction.
  • Ensure product experiences remain simple, relevant and effective across different user groups and operating contexts.

8. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Provide strategic direction and functional leadership across product experience initiatives.
  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders and external partners.
  • Facilitate collaboration between Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Programme teams.
  • Drive clarity, accountability and alignment in complex and evolving product environments.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to building a culture of user-centricity, experimentation and evidence-based decision-making.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in product management or product development, preferably within learning applications, EdTech or digital learning platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience in product discovery, product strategy, UX-driven development and end-to-end product ownership.
  • Strong understanding of user research methodologies, journey mapping, problem framing and experience design.
  • Experience designing, conducting and interpreting A/B tests, usability studies, pilots and product validation experiments.
  • Proven ability to take products, features or innovations from concept through validation, iteration and scale.
  • Experience developing product roadmaps, defining requirements, writing PRDs and prioritising product initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use behavioural, engagement and learning data to inform product decisions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across Design, Learning Experience Design, Analytics, Engineering and Programme functions.
  • Ability to distinguish between product, content and implementation challenges through research and evidence.
  • Familiarity with MVP development, innovation frameworks, experimentation methodologies and stage-gate processes.
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes in dynamic environments.
  • Prior experience in education, skilling, employability, youth development or social impact is preferred.

jobs.description:
Your Dream. Our Team.

About Rise8

Rise8 builds custom, secure software for government organizations, measuring success by impact: lives saved, time returned, and missions advanced.

We think big, start small, and scale fast with elite teams across product, design, and engineering to drive continuous delivery for critical missions.

We believe customer experience starts with employee experience, so we take care of our employees. Rise8 is where you’ll do the best work of your career—supported by a culture you won’t find anywhere else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, but what sets us apart is our commitment to autonomy, growth, and a culture rooted in kindness, candor, and continuous learning.

Certified as a Great Place to Work®, with 100% of employees saying they love working here, Rise8 is where bold ideas become real capabilities. Where mission meets meaning. And where fewer bad things happen because of bad software.

About You

  • You’re mission-driven and measure success by impact (lives saved, time returned, missions advanced), not activity.
  • You think big, start small, and scale fast. You treat time as the biggest vulnerability and security as something that enables speed.
  • You lead with kindness and candor: you give honest feedback, take it well, and raise the bar for everyone around you.
  • You’re an owner. You thrive with autonomy, act decisively, and stay steady when things are uncertain.
  • You're building with AI and see it as a force multiplier not a shortcut.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Rise8, you will:

  • Work with clients who may be new to modern software practices such as design thinking, AI-assisted and agentic engineering, continuous-release deployment, backlog management, or even interacting directly with the users they provide software to.
  • Decompose business problems into clear, actionable instructions and specifications for agentic development.
  • Be responsible for learning how your client likes to learn, how they like to receive feedback, and what ubiquitous language they use so you can speak in terms that resonate with them.
  • Learn, teach, and refine your approach constantly to best collaborate towards a new way of thinking about engineering.
  • On enablement engagements, pair with client developers, engineers, and military service members. Accelerate how they develop and deliver user stories that provide business value, technical feasibility, and user-driven functionality.
  • Ensure that development is delivered week over week and continuously gauge feedback from real users in real time.
  • Work with a balanced team in mind while building software that fits the user needs, business objectives, and stakeholder vision so the team can quickly make informed engineering decisions based on validated assumptions.
  • Plan for and build delivery and user metrics into the software systems you create, so the team can measure real outcomes.
  • Lead within your Rise8 product team by tracking and managing tech debt, facilitating engineering discussions, and leveling up less experienced engineers.

Qualifications

  • Must have an active DoD security clearance.
  • Must have working proficiency to advanced Palantir Foundry / Warp Core experience
  • 6-10 years of Software Development experience in a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills and interest in a pair-programming environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI in software development.
  • Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD) and agile methodologies, including using AI tools to write and maintain tests.
  • You have a strong understanding of algorithms, programming language theory, software architecture, networks, databases, and design patterns, and understand how to apply them.
  • Experience with both frontend and backend.
  • Experience using container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps tools and processes such as Git, Ansible, GitLabCI, SonarQube, Fortify, and ThreadFix.
  • Demonstrated experience with API Development.
  • You are comfortable running your software in Linux environments.
  • You have strong facilitation skills.
  • BA/BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in training, mentoring and/or up-skilling engineers.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications.
  • Experience leading a product or development team.
  • Experience building and deploying in a continuous delivery environment.
  • Experience working directly with clients.
  • Experience with DoD, especially at a DoD "Software Factory".
  • Preferred, not a requirement: located within a commutable distance into Colorado Springs, CO or El Segundo, CA

Travel

Position may require up to 25% travel in support of contract performance, customer site visits, and program activities.

Salary

The annual salary range for this role as it is posted is $143,824 to $179,780 regardless of final candidate location within the United States. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule in a 100% distributed workforce
  • Premium Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the employee premium and up to 80% of the combined dependent premium on our base health plan depending on pay band. We also cover 100% of the premium for employee and dependent Dental and Vision as well as employee premiums for Life and Disability coverage.
  • Retirement: 401k match at 10% gross pay.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 4 weeks combined accrued vacation and sick leave, 11 Federal holidays, your birthday, jury duty, and bereavement.
  • Education & Training: Accrued budget of up to $4,000 per year for classes, travel, events, and materials.
  • Wellness Budget: To encourage and support a well-rounded healthy lifestyle, we cover 50% reimbursement on a variety of wellness activities and products, up to $500 per calendar year.
  • Equipment: We offer a MacBook Pro and multi-port adapter.

All of Rise8’s work in this area is with Federal Government customers that require our employees involved with their projects be U.S. citizens. As such, this role requires U.S. citizenship. If hired, you would also be required to go through a background investigation.

Rise8 is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider you for this role regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Who We Are

LanguageBird® is an accredited online language school providing personalized language learning experiences to learners around the world. Through one-to-one instruction and partnerships with schools and organizations, we help learners build language skills through meaningful human connection, flexibility, and learning experiences designed around their goals.
As LanguageBird continues to grow, we’re expanding our reach and building partnerships that help more schools and learners experience what LanguageBird has to offer.

Our company core values are Growth Mindset, Relationships, Ownership & Outcomes, Work with Intention & Momentum, Team Energy & Positivity, and Human Connection. They guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for our learners, partners, and one another. We look for team members who embrace these values and bring them to life in their work each day.

LanguageBird is seeking a Business Development Manager to develop and grow referral and outbound channels that connect prospective learners and parents/guardians with LanguageBird's personalized language learning programs.

This role is responsible for leading our Independent Educational Consultant (IEC) recognition program and affiliate partner program, building meaningful relationships with advisors and organizations that influence enrollment decisions, and developing outbound opportunities that generate new learner interest and enrollments.

Working closely with the Chief Revenue Officer and cross-functional teams, the Business Development Manager will help expand LanguageBird's reach through strategic partnerships, relationship development, and new market opportunities. This position offers significant ownership of referral programs and the opportunity to shape how these channels grow over time.

  • Own and develop LanguageBird's IEC recognition and affiliate partner programs, including program structure, partner engagement, and ongoing improvements

  • Ability to represent an organization professionally and credibly at conferences, events, and partner meetings
