jobs.excerpt: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop.
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a Principal Engineer, Agentic AI to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

  • True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.
  • Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space
  • Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.
  • AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.
  • Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.
  • Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.
  • Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.
  • Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.
  • The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.
  • AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.
  • AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).
  • Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screen — 30 min with Lead Recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 60 min with the Head of Engineering & Product
  3. Technical Interview — 60 min with a Principal Engineer
  4. Collaborative Interview — 30 min with Lead Product Manager

What We Offer

  • Equity Options: Own a piece of the company's success.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance.
  • Flexible PTO: With a 15-day minimum.
  • FSA, HSA, and 401k options.
  • Learning Stipend & WFH Equipment: Everything you need for a world-class home office.
  • Innovative Culture: A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic-first environment.

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

Overview

Interface Engineer (Implementation) - EMR (Electronic Medical Records) supports the delivery of innovative products that allow patients to make life-changing decisions. Myriad Genetics, Inc. is a genetic screening and testing company that provides actionable information to empower people to make critical and timely healthcare decisions. As a technical resource for the Interface Engineering team, the Interface Engineer works on complex technical problems of diverse scope. While focused directly on EMR-related work, they remain aware of broader technical and workflow needs, and how they relate to EMR-based solutions.

Responsibility

    • Manage onboarding and continuing technical support for multiple projects with high levels of complexity to automate receiving electronic orders and sending electronic results.
    • Perform preliminary assessment of new data sources. Assist clients and project managers with estimating our level of effort and refining the project scope to identify requirements and tasks.
    • Lead development, testing and support for networking and interoperability solutions between Myriad and external clinics and providers.
    • Familiarity with core programming concepts and tools, including source control, dev environment management, code merges and deploys.
    • Be technical lead and advocate for best practices and improvements to interface implementations and data transformations.
    • Provide training and ongoing technical support to non-technical teammates.
    • Use effective written and verbal communication to navigate difficult client conversations with a professional demeanor.
    • Create detailed documentation for projects, to allow for a clean hand-off to our support teams.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree required.
  2. Expert knowledge in HL7 (V2.x), ability to read specifications for other industry standards like HL7 v3 (C-CDA), FHIR (r4), IHE ITI, or EDI X12 (Claims).
  3. Expert in Mirth, including JavaScript or other common interface engines, and able to lead efforts to administer, setup, maintain and automate interfaces.
  4. Understand network protocols, connectivity types and how to design interoperability solutions securely.
  5. Intermediate level in SQL and must be comfortable writing queries with complex joins, limited to querying and reporting.
  6. Software engineering fundamentals for web based and cloud-based applications.
  7. Ability to investigate and troubleshoot production issues on multiple platforms.
  8. Python and/or software development knowledge is a bonus.
  9. Exposure to Extract, Transform and Load (ETL) concepts and processes.
  10. Active Advanced Mirth Certification preferred.

Additional Requirements:

  • U.S. citizen or Green Card holder
  • Living full-time in the United States

jobs.title: Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs
jobs.excerpt: THE POSITION: At EVERSANA, our Global Medical Affairs & Medical Information teams play a pivotal role in supporting some of the most scientifically advanced and emerging biopharmaceutical organizations around the world to deliver innovative therapies across all therapeutic areas, including oncology, hematology, rare disease, immunology, neurology, cardiology, etc.
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

At EVERSANA, our Global Medical Affairs & Medical Information teams play a pivotal role in supporting some of the most scientifically advanced and emerging biopharmaceutical organizations around the world to deliver innovative therapies across all therapeutic areas, including oncology, hematology, rare disease, immunology, neurology, cardiology, etc. Through our fully integrated commercialization and medical support model, we partner with clients across the product lifecycle to deliver meaningful, patient- and healthcare professional-centered solutions.

The Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs is a high-impact senior leader reporting to the EVP, Global Medical Affairs & Information. This individual will play a critical role in shaping and advancing EVERSANA’s position as a forward-looking thought leader and trusted partner in Global Medical Affairs strategy, innovation, and operational excellence / execution across a diverse and growing client portfolio.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, driving the development and delivery of scalable, high-impact, and technology-enabled Medical Affairs solutions that address evolving client needs. The Executive Director will be responsible contributing to overall Global Medical Affairs strategy regarding our services and thought leadership; will lead Global Medical Affairs strategic operations and be responsible for operational efficiency and results driven execution of services; manage, lead and develop the Global Medical Affairs team; and be responsible managing Global Medical Affairs P&L.

We are seeking a highly experienced, high-functioning Medical Affairs leader with a proven ability to drive operational excellence, lead complex transformations, and deliver measurable results through cross-functional teams. This individual will bring broad functional expertise, a strong digital and innovation mindset, and the ability to operate autonomously while influencing and executing through others.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, matrixed environment and is passionate about building scalable, forward-thinking solutions that enhance Medical Affairs impact and redefine how value is delivered to clients, healthcare professionals, and patients / caregivers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Strategic Execution & Program Leadership

  • Lead and support the execution of Global Medical Affairs Excellence & Strategy initiatives across multiple clients and engagements
  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, structured programs, and measurable outcomes
  • Drive enterprise-level and cross-functional initiatives with strong project management rigor and accountability for results
  • Contribute to the evolution of innovative and scalable Medical Affairs operating models

Operational Excellence

  • Drive operational excellence, efficiency, and scalability across Medical Affairs programs and delivery models
  • Identify and implement opportunities to modernize workflows, tools, and processes, including digital and data-driven enhancements
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics to ensure consistent, high-quality execution and continuous improvement
  • Establish and own development and maintenance of applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Working Instructions, Training, etc.

Client Management, Leadership & Delivery

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to clients, including Global Medical Affairs leadership
  • A applicable, function as Overseeing Director and / or Client Manager for assigned projects
  • Deliver strategic and operational guidance across the full spectrum of Medical Affairs functions
  • Ensure client delight and that service are both value- and quality-driven

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partners across EVERSANA business units (Medical Information, Value & Evidence, Medical Communications, Agency, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory, Quality, Field Medical, Patient Services, etc.) to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions
  • Contribute to holistic commercialization and medical strategies spanning the product lifecycle
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, modeling inclusive leadership and behaviors
  • Be able to work within a matrix environment and drive results through others

Thought Leadership

  • Develop and execute thought leadership strategy for Global Medical Affairs
  • Develop the annual plan and collaborate with the team to develop and execute on the deliverables that drive new business opportunities
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices, trends, applicable laws / regulations, etc. that have an impact on Global Medical Affairs and our service offerings
  • Represent EVERSANA and the Medical Affairs team at professional meetings and associations

Financial Performance

  • Support business development through RFPs, proposals, and client presentations, contributing to growth and expansion opportunities
  • Develop and own the Medical Affairs capabilities presentations and technology offerings / demos
  • Ensure the timely review and execution of Global Medical Affairs SOWs and contracts, including follow-up for renewals
  • Develop strategic ways to drive new business opportunities via networking, professional associations, thought leadership
  • Own the P&L for Medical Affairs services, ensuring financial goals are meet and contributing to monthly and quarterly financial planning

Team Leadership / Development

  • Establish, lead, and develop growing Global Medical Affairs team across various services
  • Establish processes, procedures, and training that ensure efficient and effective onboarding of both FTEs and contractor / contingent workers / consultants
  • Build an operationally and cost-efficient global staffing model that ensures effective operational delivery of services based on client requirements and financial goals
  • Establish collaborative relationship with staff agency partners and grow network of independent consultants
  • Identify staffing needs and ensure timely development of applicable job descriptions and job requisitions
  • Ensure results-orientated and results-driven delivery of services via effective management of Global Medical Team, leveraging both FTEs and contractor / contingent workers / consultants as applicable

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale high-performing teams and subject matter experts, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation
  • Drive results through influence, delegation, and cross-functional leadership
  • Mentor and develop talent, supporting career growth and capability building
  • Establish clear performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching and feedback
  • Oversee talent processes including hiring, performance management, promotions, and development planning
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel Up to 20%
  • Hours 40+ Hours per week

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Education PharmD, MD, or PhD required.
  • Experience and/or Training
    • 8–12+ years of pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience, including significant experience within a biopharmaceutical organizations or applicable service provider
    • Strong and diverse experience across multiple Medical Affairs functions, including:
      • Medical Strategy & Planning
      • Medical Communications / Publications
      • Medical Information
      • Medical Affairs Operations
      • Advisory Boards, IIS, and lifecycle management
    • Demonstrated success in leading complex initiatives and driving operational excellence and transformation
    • Strong project and program management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
    • Proven ability to lead people, influence stakeholders, and deliver results through cross-functional teams
    • Experience working in matrixed, fast-paced environments
    • Strategic and structured thinker who connects vision to execution
    • Operational excellence driver focused on scalability, efficiency, and quality
    • Results-oriented leader with accountability for measurable impact
    • Strong program leader capable of executing complex initiatives effectively
    • People leader with experience developing high-performing teams
    • Collaborative influencer across functions and stakeholder groups
    • Self-directed operator who thrives in autonomous, high-ownership roles
  • Technology/Equipment
    • Experience with Medical Affairs technologies, including:
      • Medical Information platforms
      • Content and publication management systems
      • MSL tools and CRM platforms
      • Digital engagement and analytics tools
    • Experience leveraging advanced analytics, automation, and emerging technologies (including AI) to modernize Medical Affairs delivery and enhance impact

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience and/or Training
    • Consulting or multi-client experience
    • Experience supporting U.S. and/or global product launches
    • Exposure to multiple therapeutic areas and organization types (including emerging biopharma)

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

The physical and mental requirements along with the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

Office: While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is frequently required to reach, grasp, stand and/or sit for long periods of time (up to 90% of the shift), walk, talk and hear; occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue
jobs.excerpt: About Feanix BioFeanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.
jobs.description:
About Feanix Bio

Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.

We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions.

That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning.

We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork — just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before.

If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you.

About The Role

Sales at Feanix has been carried this far by founder-led selling, and it works: our CEO closes profit-driven dairies in one to two meetings by finding money the farm is leaving on the table in its own data. What we haven't yet built is a sales organization that closes at that standard without a founder in the room. This role builds it.

You'll be our senior sales leader, reporting directly to the CEO, and you'll operate as a player-coach from day one. The player half: personally running deals against our target market — dairy operations of 8,000+ cows run as businesses, where the owner makes decisions on profit — and proving our sales motion converts repeatably. The coach half: turning the sellers we already have into closers, building the process, capacity, and accountability that make the number happen every month, and hiring the team that scales it.

The bar here is specific, and it is not the industry's bar. Traditional agricultural sales accepts that a deal takes six meetings and a season of relationship-building. We close in one or two, because the meeting itself creates the urgency: we open the farm's own records, show the specific cows and specific dollars being lost, and make the cost of waiting explicit.

Your job is to make that motion teachable — problem first, the prospect's own data second, features last — and to hold every seller to it. You'll also own the commercial system around that motion: how we price, how we package, and how we expand revenue once we're inside a farm. Success means Feanix has a repeatable revenue engine that no longer depends on the CEO to close: the team can win new farms, expand existing ones, and onboard new sellers against a documented playbook.

This is also a leadership role in a company that runs AI-first and largely async. You'll manage a distributed field team — including sellers who came up in traditional genetics sales — and change how they work without needing to stand next to them to do it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the transition from founder-led to team-led sales. Take over the pipeline the founders built, keep momentum on live deals, and drive to a state where the team closes at founder quality without founder involvement — the clearest proof that the revenue engine is becoming repeatable.
  • Own new and expansion revenue. You're accountable for new-logo sales and genuine commercial expansion within existing accounts — added herds, sites, cows, services, or other opportunities that require a new buying decision. You'll also lead commercial terms when a standard renewal becomes a negotiation, including repricing, contract restructuring, or competitive saves. Farm Success owns adoption, customer health, and standard renewals; Revenue owns the commercial negotiation.
  • Close deals yourself. Carry a personal number against our target segment while you build. You sell the way we coach: problem-first discovery, the farm's own data as the proof, ROI in dollars, close in one to two meetings.
  • Own pricing and packaging. Set and evolve how Feanix prices and packages its products based on what we learn in the field, with Product and Finance as inputs. You'll own pricing decisions and discount authority, balancing conversion, expansion, and the value we create for farms.
  • Own the revenue number and forecast. Carry accountability for new ARR and expansion revenue, set quotas for the sales team, and maintain an evidence-based forecast across new and expansion pipeline.
  • Build a sales motion someone else can learn. Within six months, turn what works into a documented, teachable playbook a new seller can be onboarded against: ICP, discovery and meeting structure, technical close, objection handling, pricing learnings, qualification standards, and the signals that move a deal forward. The goal isn't process for process's sake — it's a repeatable motion that produces closers without the CEO in the room.
  • Up-level every seller on the team. Run ride-alongs and deal reviews, grade honestly, and catch the fumbled close in the room — not two weeks later in the forecast. When a seller misses, you name it, diagnose it, and change what happens next time.
  • Keep the pipeline honest. Hold every deal against our ICP — 8,000+ cow, profit-driven operations — and kick out prospects that don't belong. Forecast on evidence, not optimism: a meeting isn't a 9/10 because it felt friendly.
  • Recruit and build the team. Define seller profiles with the CEO, run hiring loops, and grow the org — including technically fluent sales talent who can hold credibility with sophisticated operators.
  • Own revenue operations discipline. Sales owns its whole loop: CRM hygiene, proposals, contracts, and clean handoffs to Finance and Farm Success. Build the operating discipline that makes pipeline, bookings, expansion, and forecasts reliable without other teams chasing Sales for answers.
  • Create capacity, don't consume it. Strip non-selling work off your sellers' plates and push operational load into systems and agents, so selling time goes up every quarter — including yours.
  • Operate AI-first and async. Coach and manage a distributed team through shared context and artifacts rather than constant in-person presence.

What You Bring

  • You've taken over founder-led sales before. You stepped in behind a founder who was the best seller in the company, took the motion off their plate, and built a team that closed without them — and you can show the before and after in revenue the founder didn't touch.
  • You've sold a technical product to a hesitant buyer: skeptical operators in a traditional market who'd been burned by vendors before, where you had to translate deep technology into money terms they trusted enough to act on.
  • Evidence of making other sellers better: reps you coached from stalled to closing, with the specific changes you drove and the numbers that followed.
  • You've owned pricing and packaging decisions before — using what you learned from customers, wins and losses, and willingness to pay to evolve how a product is priced and sold.
  • First-principles conviction about sales cycles — you treat "that's how long it takes in this industry" as a problem to solve, not a norm to accept, and you've compressed a cycle others called fixed.
  • The cultural fluency to walk onto a farm, change the energy in the room, and earn trust — without ever talking down to anyone.
  • Honest deal inspection as a habit: you grade meetings against what moved the deal, spot the fumble in real time, and tell people the hard thing early.
  • Operational follow-through — pipelines, forecasts, contracts, and handoffs that other teams can rely on without chasing you.
  • Daily, load-bearing AI use in your sales craft, and opinions on where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Willingness to travel extensively to farms and our California operations (up to 50% during the build phase).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into dairy, agriculture, or another traditional industry where buying decisions are relationship-driven and skepticism of new technology runs deep.
  • Experience leading or transforming a legacy or acquired sales team — changing culture and behaviors, not just adding process on top.
  • Background in forward-deployed or technical sales models where subject-matter experts are part of the close.
  • Familiarity with ROI-based or land-and-expand enterprise selling with short, high-conviction cycles.

Ultimately, we care far more about demonstrated ability, curiosity, and problem-solving than pedigree or conventional career paths.

Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us

  • The People — we have an amazing group of talented, smart, and fun people on our team.
  • The Company — we're building something novel that hasn't been done before and is already making a meaningful impact on the dairy industry.
  • The Experience — you'll have the opportunity to be part of groundbreaking work that could have an impact for generations to come.

Compensation and Benefits

$200K–$220K base + uncapped commission + equity. OTE is $290K–$320K, with significant upside for exceptional performance. Our commission structure is uncapped, with the potential for total cash compensation to reach $1M+

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.description:
Position Title: Program Associate, Higher Education

Status: Full Time

FLSA: Exempt

Location:Flexible/Remote

JOB SUMMARY & KEY PRIORITIES

The Youth Leadership Team equips and mobilizes youth and young adults to strengthen their leadership, advocate for mental health, and create change in their schools and communities through accessible, high-quality, equity-centered leadership programs and opportunities. The team works directly with students and campus stakeholders to support student-led initiatives that advance mental health change.

The Program Associate, Higher Education supports the Youth Leadership Team by carrying out assigned programs and projects for college students. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Higher Education, this role serves as a core student-facing team member who supports the day-to-day implementation of Active Minds' higher education programming, with a primary focus on the Mental Health Advocacy Institute (MHAI).

The Program Associate helps deliver well-run programs and positive participant experiences. The role combines project coordination, student coaching and facilitation, program operations, content creation, and collaboration across teams. The Associate flags barriers to participation and implementation and works with the Senior Manager to address them.

The position works closely with the Youth Leadership Team and colleagues across Measurement, Chapters, Marketing & Communications, Operations and other relevant departments. The role also works directly with youth and young adults, campus staff and faculty, facilitators, interns, and external partners.

ABOUT ACTIVE MINDS

Active Minds is the largest nonprofit in the United States mobilizing youth and young adults to transform mental health norms across society. For more than 20 years, we have equipped the next generation of peer mental health advocates through a variety of programs, including the Active Minds Chapter Network, A.S.K., and Send Silence Packing. Our advocacy, initiatives, and campaigns foster lasting change in how youth view and discuss mental health, encouraging them to use their voices to influence broader conversations and inform mental health supports within their communities. Together, we are building a diverse movement of champions committed to improving mental health for all.

KEY RESULTS

Initiative Implementation

  • Coordinate day-to-day implementation of the Mental Health Advocacy Institute, including program calendars, participant onboarding, learning management system support, session preparation, and milestone tracking.
  • Support MHAI recruitment and applications, including outreach to colleges, universities, higher education associations, and campus networks, with a focus on reaching BIPOC and LGBTQ+ students and students at varied institution types, including community colleges and HBCUs.
  • Coordinate MHAI alumni engagement, including student panels, project spotlights, and connections to additional Active Minds leadership opportunities (e.g. Chapters, the Youth Mental Health Innovation Fund, policy advocacy).
  • Connect MHAI participants and collegiate advocates to the Youth Mental Health Innovation Fund through outreach, informational sessions, and application support, in coordination with the Senior Manager, Youth Grants and Educator Engagement
  • Support the delivery of higher education resources, webinars, training, and campus partnership initiatives as assigned.
  • Make routine logistical and participant-support decisions within established program guidelines, referring complex participation concerns, policy decisions, and strategic questions to the Senior Manager.

Execution of Functional/Tactical Tasks

  • Serve as a primary contact for routine participant questions about program requirements, deadlines, materials, and support.
  • Monitor participant progress and follow-up promptly when students miss sessions or milestones.
  • Coach college students and give timely feedback on their milestones, using established program criteria and guidance from the Senior Manager, as they develop campus mental health advocacy action plans, identify administrative allies, and implement campus and systemic changes.
  • Facilitate and co-facilitate virtual sessions, office hours, make-up sessions, and small groups across assigned Youth Leadership programs, using interactive activities, discussions, and reflections that strengthen students’ leadership and advocacy skills.
  • Carry out assigned projects from planning through completion, maintaining timelines, coordinating deliverables, and keeping the Senior Manager informed of progress, barriers, and support needs.
  • Use ClickUp and Google Workspace to track project milestones, tasks, session communications, and facilitator and speaker logistics.

Logistical and Tactical Support

  • Maintain the MHAI's online learning platform, including posting materials and assignments, organizing resources, and supporting participant access.
  • Coordinate logistics for MHAI facilitators, guest speakers, and virtual sessions, including scheduling, onboarding materials, attendance, breakout rooms, interactive tools, and participant access needs.
  • Handle administrative tasks across assigned Youth Leadership programs, including mass communications, participant records , required forms, and submitted work.
  • Under the Senior Manager's guidance, process participant stipends, speaker honoraria, facilitator payments, including collecting forms and receipts, submitting payment requests, tracking payment status, and flagging discrepancies.

Content, Document, and Resource Creation

  • Create and update supplemental materials for higher education and other Youth Leadership programs, including videos, worksheets, interactive activities, reflection prompts, action plan templates, and facilitator guides, using established templates and in collaboration with the Senior Manager and relevant colleagues.
  • Prepare facilitator training materials, communications, and implementation guidance.

Individual & Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate across the Youth Leadership Team and other departments to coordinate programming, share resources, and connect participants with additional engagement opportunities.
  • Assist with training and technical assistance for campus partners to support student leadership and mental health advocacy.
  • When assigned an intern, establish expectations, provide guidance and feedback, and monitor progress toward deliverables.

Data Management & Reporting

  • With the Senior Manager and Measurement Team, collect and maintain standardized MHAI data on participation, completion, participant experience (including Net Promoter Score), and intended leadership outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate records of recruitment, participant engagement, campus stakeholder communications, and student project implementation
  • Gather participant feedback, especially from BIPOC and LGBTQ+ students. Share themes with the Senior Manager, suggest improvements, and help carry out approved changes.
  • Support preparation of program summaries, presentations, and reports for internal teams and funders, as assigned.

Organization-Wide Competencies

  • Apply an equity-centered, community- and strengths-based approach to student programming and engagement.
  • Contribute to team and organizational strategic goals by completing assigned deliverables on time.
  • Represent Active Minds at conferences, meetings, trainings, and other events as assigned.
  • Share student engagement learnings, resources, and practices with colleagues.
  • Participate in organization-wide initiatives and other responsibilities as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least one year of relevant experience supporting higher education programs, student leadership, mental health promotion, advocacy, student affairs or related nonprofit initiatives. Relevant experience may include employment, internships, graduate assistantships, service roles, or substantial student leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience engaging college students and collaborating with campus staff, faculty, or community partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating presentations, trainings, or student-facing programming.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, knowing when to check in with a supervisor for guidance.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Experience creating documents, presentations, or educational materials.
  • Experience entering, organizing, and maintaining data accurately (e.g., spreadsheets, forms, surveys).
  • Ability to provide supportive, constructive guidance while maintaining clear program expectations and exercising sound judgment.
  • Proficiency with Google products and project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp).
  • Commitment to equity and inclusion and applying an equity-centered lens to student programming and engagement.
  • Belief in college students' ability to lead meaningful change in mental health and their campus communities.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the United States to conferences, on-site Active Minds events, and staff gatherings, and support evening programming during the academic year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Google Classroom or another learning management system.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another customer relationship management system.
  • Familiarity with campus mental health advocacy, peer education, student leadership development, or collaborative campus change efforts.
  • Experience engaging students across varied institution types, including community colleges, historically Black colleges and universities, and other institutions serving historically underserved students.

OUR CULTURE

Active Minds is a place where every employee matters. We value diverse perspectives, radical authenticity, and a community-driven approach. We dream big, offering flexibility to staff while we work to achieve our mission. As such, we are proud to offer competitive salaries and benefits and an environment that is friendly to remote working and life/work balance.

Active Minds is an equal-opportunity employer that works to advance racial equity and social justice in an increasingly multicultural and globally connected world. We value diverse experiences, including educational background, intersectional identities, and lived experiences. We make a particular effort to recruit people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, and people with other marginalized identities. Active Minds encourages all to apply for our open positions as we depend on a diverse staff to carry out our mission.

COMPENSATION

This position offers an initial salary range of $52,500-$57,750 along with robust benefits. The starting pay for this position is equal to others at the same level throughout the organization. The role sits within Active Minds Level 1 salary band, and as such, has the potential to grow to $68,250 over time. FLSA Status: Exempt.

Active Minds has an industry-leading and competitive benefits package that includes Health, Vision and Dental Insurance, Paid Vacation and Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Company Wide Mental Health Days, 401(k) Matching, HSA and FSA Options, Life Insurance, Short Term, and Long Term Disability, Fully Paid Parental Leave, Wellness Reimbursement Program, and Professional Development Stipends.

Active Minds recruits, hires, trains, compensates, and promotes our staff regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

ACTIVE MINDS RECRUITING PROTOCOLS

  • Active Minds will never ask an applicant to send – and Active Minds will never send an applicant - a check or any payment or item of value (such as a gift card) in connection with the interview process or job onboarding process.
  • Active Minds will never ask for personal information about an applicant (such as their Social Security number or banking information) until the job onboarding process;
  • Active Minds will never extend a job offer without first conducting multiple rounds of video interviews. The Active Minds interview/hiring process will always include at least 3 virtual interviews.
  • All legitimate Active Minds job offers are extended verbally by the HR/People & Culture Team. • If you are expecting an email from Active Minds, please always verify that the sending domain in the email is activeminds.org and NOT any variation of it.

For further information on how to protect yourself from employment scams, please review these “Consumer Advice” guidelines.

jobs.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The Hardware Designer plays a key role in architecting and delivering complex, high-performance electronic systems for Fidus clients. You will work closely with customers and cross-functional teams (FPGA, software, SI/PI) to define system and board-level architectures, design high-speed circuits, and support full product development from concept through bring-up and validation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling challenging, high-speed designs (DDR, PCIe, SerDes), working across the full hardware lifecycle, and collaborating in multidisciplinary environments. You take pride in delivering robust, production-ready designs and mentoring others while maintaining a high standard of engineering quality and documentation.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you’ll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You’ll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects in areas such as space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video, imaging, VR/AR applications, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. You won’t be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop the system and board level architectural design, but working collaboratively with the software and FPGA programmers to analyze requirements
  • Provide schematic design and component selection for high-speed circuits, SerDes to 32Gbps, control circuits, power supply sequencing, inter-board connectors, and memory busses
  • Conduct design simulations using LTSpice and prove circuits using prototype bench tests
  • Work with the Signal Integrity team to ensure a detailed analysis of critical nets
  • Participate in design reviews (Signal Integrity, PCB Layout, FPGA coding, Software) to ensure Fidus quality standards are met
  • Perform parts library creation and schematic capture, including embedded layout constraints, using OrCAD Capture CIS
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test procedures
  • Lab bring-up and in-depth verification of hardware prototypes
  • Actively collaborate with the team to address hardware & software integration issues
  • Lead regulatory certification testing
  • Generate technical and user documentation
  • Provide pre-project technical support to the business and sales teams on project scope, schedule, effort estimates, and deliverables, and post-project technical support to customers
  • Act as a mentor and sounding board to junior and intermediate electronic designers.

Who You Are:

  • Minimum 5 years of direct electronics design experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Ability to lead a design technically and as a mentor
  • Strong fundamental knowledge of high-speed circuit and multi-layer PCB design
  • In depth understanding of all aspects of the hardware product development cycle including requirements, architecture, schematic capture, PCB layout, signal integrity, verification, and manufacturing
  • Background in FPGA designs, including 32Gbps diff pairs, power/thermal design
  • Experience with high-speed devices and protocols including DDR4, PCIe Gen4, MIPI, Gigabit Ethernet, USB-C, HDMI, SerDes and JESD204B.
  • Experience with development tools such as Cadence CIS/Orcad/Cadence Allegro
  • Experience using optical test sets, signal analyzers, and GHz+ oscilloscopes for analysis of eye diagrams, phase noise, and overall signal quality
  • Hands-on debugging experience involving scopes, VNAs, signal generators, electronic loads
  • Familiarity with ESD, EMI, and RF design considerations
  • Ability to use Verilog, RTL, or HLS an asset
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Job Title: Behavioral Health Medical Virtual Assistant – Phone, Insurance & Scheduling

Position Type: Full-time

Working Hours: 8 paid hours/day | 40 hours/week

Pay Rate: $5-$6 USD/hour, depending on experience

Location: Remote – Philippines

About the Client and the Role

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare practice providing mental health and medical services through both telemedicine and in-person appointments. Its mental health services include psychiatric assessments, medication management, and therapy. The practice serves patients across multiple Georgia locations and accepts a range of commercial and government insurance plans

The VA will support both assigned practice locations and work directly with both providers, who will also conduct onboarding and training.

We are looking for a reliable and patient-focused Behavioral Health Medical Virtual Assistant to support daily front-office and patient coordination workflows.

This is a highly patient-facing role, with phone coverage as the primary priority. The client is particularly focused on minimizing missed calls and ensuring patients and referrals receive timely assistance.

Key Responsibilities

1. PRIMARY: Phone Support & Patient Intake

  • Answer inbound patient calls and help minimize missed calls.
  • Make outbound calls as needed for patient and referral follow-up.
  • Assist with patient intake and patient-facing inquiries.
  • Receive and follow up on hospital referrals.
  • Maintain a professional and courteous phone presence.
  • Check incoming faxes through the Ooma VoIP system and follow up on referrals received through Ooma.

2. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorizations

  • Verify patient insurance coverage and eligibility.
  • Assist with insurance-related patient workflows.
  • Handle and follow up on prior authorization requests.
  • Support co-pay collection and account balance management.

3. Schedule Management

  • Schedule new and existing patients.
  • Coordinate scheduling for new patient referrals.
  • Reschedule cancellations and no-shows.
  • Help fill open appointment slots when cancellations occur.
  • Support both practice locations with schedule management.

Additional Administrative Support

  • Process patient letter requests.
  • Provide general administrative support as needed.
  • Attend daily team huddles.
  • Use Tebra (Kareo) for EHR-related workflows.
  • Use Ooma for phone and fax workflows.
  • Use Zoom and/or Google Meet for virtual communication.
  • Later, the role may include outreach to other clinics regarding behavioral health services; however, this is not a current priority.

Requirements

  • Previous healthcare experience, preferably in a patient-facing administrative or virtual assistant role.
  • Experience with insurance verification and prior authorizations.
  • Strong professional phone communication skills.
  • Comfortable handling inbound and outbound patient calls.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with patients and other healthcare offices.
  • Strong reliability and attendance; must be able to consistently attend daily huddles.
  • Honest, trustworthy, and dependable.
  • Hardworking, proactive, and able to think on your feet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous behavioral health or mental health experience is highly preferred for a smoother transition into the role.
  • Experience with Tebra/Kareo.
  • Experience managing patient scheduling, referrals, cancellations, and no-shows.
  • Experience using Ooma or another VoIP phone system.
  • Experience with co-pay collection or patient account balance follow-up.

The practice currently handles approximately 80–90 patients per week. Providers aim to maintain full schedules, with an ideal goal of approximately 50 patients per week. The VA is not responsible for meeting a patient quota, but will help keep schedules filled when cancellations or no-shows occur and when patients call to schedule.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

In a culture built on accountability, trust, and bold thinking, the Principal Architect, Cloud FinOps, plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI-ready connectivity. Working at the intersection of innovation and impact, this leader thrives in an environment where challenging work is embraced, expectations are clear, and meaningful contributions drive lasting value for customers, partners, and the industry.
As the enterprise’s technical authority for FinOps architecture, cloud economics, and financial governance, the Principal Architect leads the design of cost-aware cloud strategies across a complex multi-cloud ecosystem. By combining deep technical expertise with strategic business insight, this individual helps ensure that every cloud investment delivers measurable outcomes while supporting performance, scalability, resiliency, and security.
Partnering closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Cloud Platform teams, Strategic Sourcing, Product organizations, and Executive Leadership, the Principal Architect brings people and ideas together to solve complex challenges. Through collaboration and influence, they champion a shared vision of financial accountability and operational excellence across the cloud landscape.
Their impact extends beyond architecture design. By establishing enterprise standards, cloud consumption guardrails, unit economics frameworks, commitment optimization strategies, and migration blueprints, they create a foundation that empowers teams to innovate with confidence. Every decision is guided by a commitment to delivering business value, enabling sustainable growth, and helping the organization stay ahead in an increasingly connected, AI-driven world.

This is a work from home position within the US.

• Enterprise Architecture

Define and govern multi-cloud architecture standards across Azure, AWS, and GCP. Develop reusable reference architectures, solution patterns, and governance frameworks. • FinOps Leadership

Integrate cost optimization into architecture and engineering practices. Establish cost-aware patterns for compute, storage, networking, AI/ML, Kubernetes, databases, and SaaS platforms. Develop unit economics, chargeback/showback models, cloud costing methodologies, and enterprise FinOps maturity programs.

• Cloud Optimization

Lead application rationalization, cloud migration, and platform modernization efforts. Implement financial guardrails, policy-as-code, and workload placement strategies that improve cost efficiency.

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

Define standards for cloud consumption, tagging, allocation, lifecycle management, and capacity planning. Ensure alignment with security, compliance, operational, and risk management requirements while participating in architecture and FinOps governance forums.

• Automation & Platform Enablement

Partner with engineering teams to automate cost controls, budget management, policy enforcement, optimization recommendations, and reporting. Support FinOps platforms, dashboards, operational tooling, and promote Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and FinOps-as-Code practices.

• Executive Leadership

Present architecture strategies, cloud economics recommendations, and optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. Develop business cases, ROI analyses, TCO assessments, and cloud investment strategies. Mentor architects, engineers, and FinOps practitioners while driving enterprise-wide cloud financial accountability.

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks and governance and cloud economics, financial management. and FinOps operating models and unit economics and allocation methodologies.
  • Cloud migration strategies and kubernetes, container platforms, infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation) and cost management platforms (Flexera, CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability, native CSP tooling) and AI/ML platform architecture and cost optimization.

Financial modeling and forecasting, budget management, executive communications, business capability mapping.and strategic planning

NVIDIA is looking for an experienced Network Solutions Architect Engineer to help bring our next-generation AI networking platforms into production at customer data centers. Do you want to be part of a team that brings new AI hardware and software technologies to production in customer data centers? As part of the NVIDIA SA organization, you will be driving deployment of our end-to-end technology solutions integration at some of NVIDIA's most strategic technology customers, as well as offering recommendations to business and engineering teams on our product roadmap.


What you will be doing:

  • Partner with AI-labs customers on large data center GPU and networking deployments. Guide architecture decisions across network, compute, and storage, including fabric design. Support on-site bring-up of server, network, and cluster infrastructure in customer data centers.
  • Demonstrate expertise on advanced GPU and network systems (Spectrum-X, BlueField DPU, InfiniBand/RoCE, etc.) for key accounts. Run regular technical account reviews covering roadmap alignment, cluster issues, feature discussions, and new technology introductions. Capture customer-specific requirements and translate them into concrete feedback for product, architecture, and engineering teams.
  • Analyze and debug configuration and performance issues in RoCE and InfiniBand environments. Work across NICs, switches, Linux, and system software to deliver performant, reliable AI clusters.
  • Identify and shape new project opportunities for NVIDIA GPUs, networking, and software in AI and data center use cases. Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, Product Management, and Sales to align solutions with customer outcomes. Build targeted POCs that showcase the value of NVIDIA’s networking stack (e.g., Spectrum-X fabrics, BlueField DPUs) in real customer environments.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in data center or cloud environments.
  • Proven, expert-level troubleshooting of data center networks (packet-level, control plane, and fabric behavior).
  • Deep protocol knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and L2/L3 switching in large-scale data center or cloud networks (ECMP, Clos/leaf–spine). Experience with high-density switching at cloud or hyperscale is strongly preferred. Experience with InfiniBand or RoCE is a major plus.
  • Solid understanding of CPU/GPU server architecture, NICs, Linux, system software, and kernel drivers
  • Strong time management and ability to context-switch across multiple customers and projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design docs, customer presentations, and root-cause summaries.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Automation & tooling: Experience in Python, Bash, or C/C++ for automating network workflows, validation, and debug.
  • NVIDIA platform experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA GPUs, NICs, DPUs, or ARM-based CPU platforms.
  • Customer-facing background: Pre-sales, post-sales, field engineering, or consulting experience with external enterprise or cloud customers.
  • Large-scale deployments: Direct experience bringing up and operating large clusters or supercomputing environments.
  • Virtualization / cloud: Familiarity with virtualization, containers, and cloud networking concepts.

We make extensive use of conferencing tools, but occasional (20%) travel is required for on-site visit to customers and industry events. We are open to remote work location and look forward to have you join our team!


NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

About Us

At The Coral Company, we live by a simple rule: "Only promise what you can deliver, and always deliver what you promise."

We are looking for a sharp, proactive Property Accountant to join our ART (Accurate, Reviewed, & Timely) accounting team. If you bring strong financial acumen, a passion for real estate, and a collaborative spirit - we’d love to have you on board!

Why Join The Coral Company?

• Work From Home Freedom: Enjoy the flexibility of a 100% fully remote role (within EST or CST time zones).

  • Health, Dental, Vision, & Supplemental Insurance – eligible 1st of month following hire

What You’ll Do

As our Property Accountant, you will take ownership of the financial reporting of a dedicated portfolio of properties, specifically apartments and condominium/homeowners associations. Working directly with the Senior Director of Property Accounting, you will serve as a key financial partner to our Clients and Property Managers.

• Compliance & Audits: Manage loan covenant compliance at the property level and act as the main point of contact for external accounting and audit firms.

• Data Integrity: Maintain accurate general ledgers, perform bank reconciliations, audit accounting records, and master our property management financial software.

• Client Excellence: Deliver responsive, customer-centric support to both internal teams and external clients.

Qualifications:

• 2+ years of full-cycle accounting experience specifically in property management (e.g., Association and/or Apartment management).

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.

• Experience with property management software (such as AppFolio or Vantaca) is a major plus.

• The ART Standard: Unwavering commitment to Accuracy, Review, and Timeliness.

• Problem Solver & Self-Starter: Ability to self-manage, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines independently in a remote setting.

• Exceptional Communicator: Strong verbal and written skills with a high degree of professionalism, responsiveness, and customer-service mindset.

• Team Player: Coachable, collaborative, accountable, and eager to bring fresh ideas to the team.

Ready to Apply?

If you are an experienced accounting professional looking for a remote culture that values ownership, integrity, and humor, apply today to join The Coral Company!

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our CSP Engagements team as the technical focal point for rack-scale system SW/FW, working with CSP engineering teams to ensure they can deploy, monitor, and operate these systems reliably at fleet scale.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our CSP Engagements team as the technical focal point for rack-scale system SW/FW, working with CSP engineering teams to ensure they can deploy, monitor, and operate these systems reliably at fleet scale. In this role, you will collaborate with NVIDIA's cross-functional rack-scale system SW/FW engineering teams with dedicated CSP-facing technical leadership. Your focus is on the system-level software that manages, monitors, and recovers the rack as a whole — fabric management, GPU/NVSwitch error handling and recovery, health telemetry APIs, firmware update orchestration, and SW-driven serviceability. You will drive work streams with CSP engineering teams to build shared understanding of the architecture, incorporate their operational feedback, and ensure integration readiness.

What you'll be doing:

  • Drive rack-scale SW/FW architecture alignment across CSP engagements — including fabric management software, link health monitoring, GPU/NVSwitch error handling, SW/FW serviceability features (e.g., hot-plug support, component isolation, firmware-driven recovery), and multi-component firmware orchestration

  • Drive technical work streams with CSP engineering teams on rack-scale system software — ensuring they deeply understand fabric management, NVSwitch behavior, error handling and recovery policies, health telemetry APIs, and SW/FW-controlled recovery operation

  • Capture and synthesize CSP engineering feedback on rack-scale system software — health monitoring APIs, SW-driven serviceability workflows, firmware update orchestration, and error recovery behavior — champion that feedback into NVIDIA's architecture decisions

  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to ensure customer operational requirements are reflected in system software and firmware development

  • Identify cross-CSP patterns in rack-scale SW/FW issues, error handling behavior, and system configuration practices — drive documentation, tooling, and test strategy improvements as a result

  • Collaborate with execution teams on left-shift strategy — ensuring customer-side SW/FW integration work is identified early and completed ahead of hardware availability

  • Make critical technical decisions on rack-scale system SW/FW tradeoffs and mitigate execution risks through early engagement with CSP engineering teams

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of experience in system software, platform firmware, or large-scale distributed systems engineering. BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • Deep understanding of rack-scale system software challenges: multi-component coordination, error propagation, health monitoring, and serviceability / reliability

  • Experience with fabric management software, cluster management, or system-level orchestration frameworks. Familiarity with firmware architectures and update lifecycle management (multi-component update sequencing, rollback, recovery)

  • Understanding of error handling and recovery design patterns in distributed systems — fault isolation, retry policies, graceful degradation

  • Experience with health monitoring and telemetry systems: health scoring, event correlation, API design for fleet-level observability

  • Understanding of GPU or accelerator system software (drivers, device management, power management) is a strong plus

  • Customer obsession — genuine passion for understanding how CSPs operate sophisticated systems at fleet scale and simplifying their experience

  • Proven success providing technical leadership across organizational boundaries and influencing system software design without direct authority. Strong communication — ability to translate complex system software architecture into actionable mentorship for customer engineering teams

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with NVIDIA NVSwitch, NVOS, or GPU fabric management software

  • Background in system software for large-scale clusters at a hyperscaler (cluster management, fleet orchestration, health platforms)

  • Experience crafting error handling and recovery frameworks for multi-component systems (hundreds or thousands of coordinating devices)

  • Familiarity with GPU or accelerator fleet operations — driver lifecycle, firmware rollout strategies, health-based scheduling

  • Understanding of how system software decisions impact serviceability, availability, and operational cost at fleet scale

NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. Are you ready to change the next generation of computing? Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

NVIDIA data center systems, such as DGX and HGX, have become core to NVIDIA's rapidly growing enterprise and cloud provider businesses. These platforms bring together the full power of NVIDIA GPUs, NVIDIA NVLink, NVIDIA InfiniBand networking, NVIDIA Grace CPUs, and a fully optimized NVIDIA AI and HPC software stack.

Join us!
