jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to lead Partners Salesforce & Payout in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Partners Salesforce & Payout — two mission-critical product surfaces that together power the commercial and financial backbone of Wellhub's partner ecosystem.

Salesforce is where every commercial condition, contract term, and account relationship for our 120,000+ partners is created and maintained. Payout is the system of record that pays those partners every month — a single miscalculation cascades into financial leakage, contractual breach, and legal exposure.

As Director of Product Management, you will own the multi-year strategy across both product surfaces, lead a team of Senior Product Managers, and set the AI agenda for how Wellhub scales commercial operations and payment integrity. You will report to the VP Program Manager, Partners and sit on the Partners leadership team, partnering directly with Finance, Value Management, Legal, Partnerships, and PD Engineering leadership.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Commercial Growth & Portfolio Strategy: Own the multi-year vision across Salesforce and Payout, elevating them from back-office operational tools into growth-driving commercial platforms. Balance high-touch sales enablement, scalable financial solutions, and settlement speed to maximize partner lifetime value (LTV) and long-term retention.
  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Senior Product Managers owning the Salesforce and Payout squads. Champion product craft standards (discovery, delivery, measurement) and foster a business-impact mindset focused on partner growth and operational excellence.
  • High-Touch Sales Enablement & Commercial Velocity: Empower commercial and partnership teams with seamless sales tooling, automated deal workflows, and frictionless contract-to-payout execution. Streamline complex partner deal structures to reduce cycle times and accelerate revenue generation.
  • Financial Solutions & Monetization Innovation: Drive strategic ownership of partner financial products (e.g., early payouts, growth capital, flexible settlement options). Turn financial operations into a competitive advantage that increases partner engagement, trust, and retention across 120,000+ global locations.
  • AI & Automation Agenda: Set the strategic AI roadmap across the commercial portfolio. Unlock high-leverage opportunities—such as agentic commercial workflows, automated deal routing, intelligent payment reconciliation, and predictive partner retention insights—to drive scale and velocity.
  • Executive Communication & Alignment: Present growth strategies, portfolio trade-offs, and commercial outcomes to C-level executives (CPO, CFO, GC, VP Partnerships). Align cross-functional initiatives around business expansion and strategic partner value.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the connective tissue between Partnerships, Sales Ops, Finance, Value Management, Legal, and PD Engineering, creating alignment across product, growth, and commercial operations.
  • Portfolio Strategy & Roadmap: Own the multi-year product strategy across both Salesforce and Payout. Balance commercial enablement, financial integrity, and platform scalability. Set OKRs at the portfolio level and translate them into squad-level commitments.
  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and grow a team of Senior Product Managers who own the Salesforce and Payout squads. Set the operating model, the hiring bar, and the career development path for the org. Establish product craft standards (discovery, delivery, measurement) that scale across both squads.
  • Financial Integrity Ownership: Own the product accountability for payment accuracy at 120,000+ partner scale. Payment errors translate directly to financial leakage, regulatory exposure, and partner churn. Champion end-to-end observability, control, and auditability across the payout funnel.
  • Commercial Enablement: Own how commercial conditions, contract terms, and account data flow from deal-close through settlement. Close the gap between what is signed (contract) and what is executed (Salesforce ↔ Payout sync).
  • AI Agenda: Set the AI agenda for the portfolio. Decide where AI creates disproportionate leverage — anomaly detection on payments, contract compliance validation, agentic commercial workflows, automated reconciliation — and where it doesn't. Own the risk/ROI tradeoffs and hold teams accountable to outcomes, not experiments.
  • Executive Communication: Present strategy, trade offs, and results to C-level stakeholders (CPO, CFO, GC, VP Partnerships). Turn systemic complexity into decision-grade narratives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align across Finance, Value Management, Legal/Compliance, Partnerships, PD Engineering, and CX/Ops. This role sits at the seam where product, money, and legal exposure meet.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Solid experience in Product Management, with experience directly managing PMs at the Senior or Staff level.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep experience in at least one of: payment systems, financial platforms, revenue/billing engines, CRM/sales-ops platforms, or high-stakes B2B operational platforms where errors have direct financial or legal consequences. Payments or fintech background strongly preferred.
  • Technical Fluency: Able to hold a substantive conversation with tech leads on payment processing, event-driven architectures, data integrity, reconciliation flows, and REST APIs. You bridge business intent and engineering excellence.
  • AI Leadership (mandatory): Ability to set the AI agenda for a product portfolio — decide which AI investments to make, sequence them against risk and ROI, and hold teams accountable to outcomes (not experiments). Practical fluency with LLM/agent tooling in daily workflow is table stakes; the differentiator is judgment on where AI moves the needle vs. where it doesn't.
  • Data-Driven & Analytical: Fluent in using quantitative metrics, funnels, and experimentation to prioritize investments and measure outcome impact. Comfortable running SQL for self-service analysis.
  • Partner-Centric Mindset: Deep passion for understanding external user workflows and translating operational friction into high-value product solutions.
  • Executive Presence: Track record of shaping and defending product strategy in front of C-level audiences (CPO, CFO, GC, or equivalent).
  • Influence: Exceptional communication in English, both synchronous and asynchronous, with a proven ability to align cross-functional leaders and external partners.
  • Global Scale Experience: Comfortable owning platforms that support internationalization, localization, and multi-country operational requirements.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Product Management are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Washington to identify experienced financial leaders who understand the unique responsibilities of rural healthcare.

This Is More Than a CFO Role

In rural healthcare, the Chief Financial Officer is not simply responsible for financial reports and budgets. The CFO helps protect the long-term stability of an organization that may be one of the most essential employers and community resources in the region.

Rural healthcare finance requires strong technical knowledge, sound judgment, adaptability, and the ability to communicate clearly with executive leaders, department managers, boards, employees, and community partners.

The strongest rural CFOs understand that every financial decision connects directly to patient access, workforce stability, community trust, and the organization's ability to continue serving its region.

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for the organization's financial functions
  • Developing budgets, forecasts, financial plans, and long-term sustainability strategies
  • Overseeing accounting, financial reporting, cash flow, audits, and internal controls
  • Supporting revenue cycle performance and reimbursement strategy
  • Monitoring financial performance and communicating results to executive leadership and the governing board
  • Managing relationships with auditors, banks, vendors, government agencies, and external partners
  • Supporting capital planning, grants, funding initiatives, and major organizational projects
  • Partnering with operational and clinical leaders to improve performance and resource stewardship
  • Ensuring compliance with applicable financial, regulatory, and reporting requirements
  • Helping the organization navigate growth, transition, turnaround, or financial uncertainty

Business Systems is shifting from a classic admin/ops setup to a more engineering-led team. We want people who write code, take release process seriously, and use AI to increase your efficiency 10x.

You'll help build and connect the systems behind Engine's go-to-market motion: CRM, engagement, enrichment, automation, and the glue between them. You get the flexibility to do great work from home without a commute. You also get a team that’s only a Slack message or a call away when a shipment gets tricky.

Sentinel Blue is hiring a Client Engineer for our Operations team. This role is a senior, client-facing engineer who serves as a trusted technology advisor across Sentinel Blue’s client portfolio. This role sits within the Operations team and is built for an engineer who can operate at both the strategic and technical level. The perfect candidate is someone who can assess a client’s environment, understand their goals and constraints, and provide clear, actionable direction.

This is not a pure advisory role. You will be reviewing and modifying configurations, evaluating vendor proposals, identifying security and compliance implications, and producing documentation clients can act on. You will also collaborate internally to connect client needs to the right delivery teams or external partners.

This is a full-time position that is fully remote.

This position may require access to technology, technical data, or information that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. Employment in this position is contingent upon either verification of U.S. person status as defined under applicable export control regulations (which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and certain protected individuals such as refugees and asylees) or the ability to obtain any required export authorization. The company reserves the right not to apply for an export license and to decline to proceed with any applicant on that basis. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to citizenship status, national origin, or immigration status.

A day in the Client Engineer role:

You might open a conversation with a client who wants to evaluate a new business intelligence platform. You'll work through what they're trying to accomplish, assess the hosting and infrastructure implications, identify where it touches identity or compliance, and produce a structured recommendation even if Sentinel Blue won't own the full implementation. That same week, you might be standing up the server infrastructure to host it, working through a configuration issue blocking a data connection, or troubleshooting why an integration with their identity provider isn't behaving as expected. Later, you're on a call reviewing a vendor proposal with a client's leadership team, helping them understand what questions to ask and what commitments to require. By end of day, you're translating that conversation into a written brief the client can take into their next board discussion.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the senior technology point of contact for assigned clients, owning the relationship at the strategic level.
  • Lead discovery conversations to understand client business goals, existing technology investments, and emerging needs.
  • Translate complex technical topics into clear guidance appropriate for non-technical stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Represent Sentinel Blue on client calls with credibility, clarity, and a consultative approach.
  • Engage clients on technology requests and questions that fall outside standard managed service scope, including specialized platforms, line-of-business applications, and bespoke infrastructure needs.
  • Assess unfamiliar systems and platforms quickly, understanding hosting requirements, integration dependencies, security posture, and compliance implications even without deep prior experience with the specific tool.
  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure and applications as part of client engagements, including standing up servers, modifying system configurations, and resolving application-level issues.
  • Provide guidance aligned with CMMC, NIST 800-171, and CIS Controls as applicable to client context.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and remediation priorities across client environments and communicate them clearly.
  • Help clients evaluate vendor proposals and technology investments, including RFP support, contract review from a technical lens, and total cost of ownership analysis.
  • Assess vendor security posture, SLA commitments, and integration readiness in the context of the client's environment.
  • Produce clear client-facing deliverables including assessments, roadmaps, briefing documents, and recommendation reports.
  • Collaborate with internal IT Operations, SOC, and GRC teams to route client needs to the right delivery function.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge by documenting patterns, assessments, and guidance for recurring client scenarios.

What We Can Offer:

Sentinel Blue is a young company with a focused mission: We’re bringing enterprise-class cybersecurity to small and medium sized businesses. Frankly, we’re pushing the envelope of how things are done and constantly seeking innovative ways to meet that mission. The pace is fast, and we’re always learning new things. This is a great place if you want to expose yourself to new and emerging technologies, want to be challenged, and want to build your skills. Further, success in this role can quickly transition into a senior engineering, architectural, or technical leadership role. The right person will find themselves in a fun, dynamic environment, working on interesting problems and making a real difference.

You will be required to achieve a Security+ certification in the first 6 months of hire; we’ll cover your certification costs and provide paid time for you to study!

Requirements:

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure, IT consulting, or technology advisory roles with demonstrated client-facing ownership.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, and modern identity and endpoint management.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess unfamiliar technology platforms and produce actionable recommendations without requiring end-to-end ownership of the system.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief executive and non-technical audiences clearly and confidently.
  • Troubleshooting skills and follow-through, including validation and documentation.
  • Experience engaging with compliance frameworks such as CMMC, NIST 800-171, or CIS Controls in a practical engineering or advisory context.
  • CompTIA Security+ required within 6 months of hire if not already held.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with vendor evaluation, RFP processes, and technology procurement advisory.

  • Proficiency in core networking fundamentals and practical exposure to platforms such as Fortinet, Meraki, Ubiquiti UniFi, or Cloudflare Zero Trust.
  • Familiarity with backup, recovery, and data retention concepts in cloud environments.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Benefits:

  • Paid certification and training opportunities.

ON.energyis setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers.

Vice President, Product Management
Miami, Florida; Washington, DC; or Remote (U.S.)

ON.energy is seeking a Vice President of Product Management to lead and own the product roadmap for our medium-voltage UPS systems serving the data center power market. This role is responsible for defining product direction, translating market needs into actionable requirements, and establishing the business case and prioritization framework for what we build next.

Building on ON.energy’s customer-informed product development to date, the VP of Product Management will establish a clear, well-supported roadmap for the next 12–24 months, balancing customer value, competitive differentiation, technical feasibility, regulatory and certification requirements, delivery timing, and financial outcomes. Reporting to the SVP of Engineering and working closely with the CTO and senior leadership, this leader will build and lead a small, focused product management team while staying hands-on in roadmap, requirements, and customer work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Develop and maintain a product roadmap with clear priorities, business cases, milestones, and measurable outcomes, and provide a sound commercial rationale for roadmap decisions.
  • Market & Customer Discovery: Engage with customers, channel partners (as applicable), and industry stakeholders to identify emerging requirements and trends in data center power infrastructure.
  • Product Requirements & Go-to-Market Inputs: Translate market insights into product requirements, including target pricing, certification and compliance needs, and planned launch timing.
  • Technical Direction: Partner with R&D and Engineering to assess technology options and recommend the most effective solutions based on feasibility, risk, and expected customer value.
  • Scope & Customization Strategy: Determine when customer-specific features justify investment versus when they should be standardized and incorporated into the broader product offering.
  • Commercialization: Partner with Sales on pricing and packaging, and with Marketing on positioning, product narratives, and launch planning.
  • Execution Alignment: Provide clear product direction to program management and engineering teams throughout development and delivery, ensuring the released product meets its original intent.
  • Team Leadership: Build, lead, and develop a small, high-performing product management team, setting clear expectations and coaching team members while remaining a hands-on contributor.
  • Operating Model: Establish a durable product management operating model and repeatable processes that can scale as the business grows.
  • External Representation: Serve as a product and strategy representative with customers and at relevant industry events.

First 12–24 Months

  • Validate existing assumptions regarding customer demand, market trajectory, competitive landscape, and product differentiation.
  • Develop a prioritized roadmap with business cases, target outcomes, and delivery timelines.
  • Establish repeatable product management processes that connect customer insight to requirements, investment decisions, and execution alignment.
  • Hire and onboard a small product management team aligned to roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 5 years in a product leadership role managing people and owning a multi-product roadmap.
  • Experience leading small, hands-on product teams, balancing people leadership with individual contribution.
  • Significant experience in product management for complex electrical hardware, systems, or mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring technical products to market, including requirements definition, pricing strategy, and launch planning.
  • Strong understanding of the data center industry and the buyer/user needs that shape critical power infrastructure decisions.
  • Experience in UPS and/or critical power infrastructure (particularly low- or medium-voltage systems) is highly relevant.
  • Sufficient technical depth to collaborate effectively with R&D and engineering teams and to assess technical tradeoffs and risks.
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards and certification pathways (e.g., UL 1778, IEC 62040, IEEE, NFPA 70/NEC) and their impact on product cost, design, and launch timing.
  • Strong commercial judgment regarding demand forecasting, pricing, value proposition, and the economics of customization.
  • Track record of using data, including market sizing, win/loss analysis, customer feedback, and field performance, to drive prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Experience managing the full product lifecycle, including sustaining engineering, cost reduction, and end-of-life decisions.
  • Experience engaging hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data center operators, as well as EPCs, consulting engineers, and other specifiers who influence purchasing decisions.
  • Proven ability to form independent viewpoints and communicate them clearly to customers and executive leadership, including presenting business cases and articulating technical requirements in customer-facing contexts.
  • Proficiency with product management and roadmapping tools (e.g., Jira, Aha!, or equivalent) and experience working within a stage-gate or similar development process.
  • Experience in a high-growth or venture-backed company, with comfort operating amid ambiguity and limited resources.
  • Familiarity with power electronics, energy storage and battery technologies, and utility/grid interconnection considerations is preferred.
  • Prior experience building or scaling a product management function is a plus.
  • MBA not required; prior product leadership impact is the primary criterion.

Tired of working in systems that treat people like cogs instead of humans? At KindWiseRich, we’re reimagining how teams work—rooted in kindness, guided by wisdom, and driven by a mission to empower millions to live better lives.

We’re looking for a People Manager who believes in the power of people-first leadership, who sees talent not just as skill but as soul, and who’s ready to help build a culture where every team member feels seen, supported, and inspired to grow.

About Us

KindWiseRich is an international media company producing meaningful content for YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram. Our work is grounded in practical value, evidence, and studies, designed to educate, inspire, and unite people globally.Our team operates remotely across 12 countries - Ukraine, England, Ireland, Scotland , the USA, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya and India - bringing diverse perspectives to everything we create.

The Role: People Manager

As People Manager at KindWiseRich, you’ll nurture a team of globally-distributed creatives, editors, strategists, and visionaries. Your role is to help our people thrive—by building smart systems, providing emotional and strategic support, and making our culture stronger every day.

What Will You Do?

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with team members across departments

  • Facilitate regular check-ins and performance reflections with honesty and care

  • Identify opportunities for growth, mentorship, and alignment

  • Support recruitment and onboarding of new team members

  • Help resolve conflicts with wisdom, kindness, and clarity

  • Co-create clear team systems for accountability, recognition, and feedback

  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and inclusive remote team culture

  • Maintain alignment with KWR’s values in all people-related decisions

Who Are We Looking For?

We want teammates who embody:

  • Empathy & Listening – You care deeply about people and know how to hold space.

  • Clarity & Structure – You’re organized, proactive, and love designing systems that help humans flourish.

  • Positivity – You see challenges as opportunities and radiate calm energy, even under pressure.

  • Integrity – You model the behaviors you want to see and create safe spaces for others to grow.

  • Cultural Fluency – You're comfortable working across time zones, cultures, and communication styles.

  • Innovation – You’re open to using tools (including AI) to streamline processes and foster deeper connections.

What We Offer

  • A Better You – Unexpected side effects of working with us: increased empathy, wisdom, and financial literacy.

Our Conditions

If you’re not in a position to volunteer, that’s completely okay. This role is best for someone who is financially stable and values meaningful contribution, growth, and purpose over short-term pay.

Why Is This a Volunteer Position?

Because we walk our talk. We’re building this from the ground up, prioritizing people over profit, and proving that impact and integrity can win—even without outside investors. We’re here to inspire a new generation of creators and leaders who act from values, not just ambition.

Ready to Join Us?

Performance is measured against a balanced set of scaled-success metrics. Specific targets are set with Customer Success leadership and evolve as the program matures. Representative measures include:

Director of AI Platforms and Infrastructure

Aimpoint Digital is a market-leading data, AI, analytics, and operations research advisory and solution engineering firm. We help organizations design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade data and AI platforms, decision intelligence solutions, optimization systems, and production AI applications.

We are not a commodity consulting firm. We are a technical and strategic partner to organizations that need to move beyond experimentation and deploy AI into real business workflows with the architecture, governance, reliability, and operating discipline required for production.

As AI adoption accelerates across both our internal business and our client base, Aimpoint Digital is investing in the platforms, governance, and operational capabilities that make enterprise AI secure, scalable, and cost effective. We are seeking a Director of AI Platforms and Infrastructure to lead this effort.

About the Role

As the Director of AI Platforms and Infrastructure, you will own the strategy, administration, and operational excellence of Aimpoint Digital's enterprise AI platforms. This role is responsible for managing our internal ChatGPT, Claude, and related AI environments while helping clients successfully deploy, govern, and operationalize enterprise AI platforms.

This position sits at the intersection of AI platform administration, enterprise architecture, governance, security, enablement, and client delivery. You will partner with internal technology leadership to ensure our consultants have reliable, secure, and well-governed AI tooling while also supporting Anthropic enterprise AI clients with platform standup, configuration, user enablement, and operational best practices.

You will build and continuously improve our AI capabilities. This includes establishing governance standards, managing licenses and costs, defining operational processes, supporting client implementations, developing reusable deployment playbooks, and serving as the technical bridge between platform vendors, internal stakeholders, and delivery teams.

The right candidate is highly organized, technically credible, operationally disciplined, and energized by building scalable systems. You should understand enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, identity and access management, security and governance, and the practical realities of deploying AI responsibly across large organizations.

What You Will Do

  • Own administration and day-to-day management of Aimpoint Digital's enterprise AI platforms, including ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, and future AI platform investments.
  • Develop and maintain governance standards for user provisioning, permissions, workspace configuration, model access, data controls, and security policies.
  • Monitor platform utilization, licensing, adoption, and spend while optimizing costs and maximizing business value.
  • Partner with IT, Security, Legal, and AI leadership to establish scalable operating procedures for enterprise AI usage.
  • Establish and evolve a point of view on critical AI usage topics such as security, cost management, and governance.
  • Serve as the technical lead for client AI platform deployments, including environment setup, configuration, governance workshops, enablement, and administrator training.
  • Develop reusable implementation playbooks, reference architectures, deployment checklists, and operational documentation.
  • Support delivery teams during enterprise AI implementations by providing platform expertise and operational guidance.
  • Evaluate new enterprise AI platform capabilities, administrative features, APIs, integrations, and roadmap enhancements.
  • Develop internal enablement programs that help consultants effectively and responsibly leverage enterprise AI platforms.
  • Establish reporting and operational metrics around adoption, usage, governance, security, platform health, and ROI.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an entrepreneurial technology leader who enjoys building operational excellence around emerging AI platforms. You are equally comfortable administering enterprise AI environments, partnering with security and IT leaders, and working directly with enterprise clients to deploy and operationalize modern AI platforms.

You understand that successful AI adoption requires more than model access, it requires governance, enablement, cost management, thoughtful administration, and repeatable operational processes. You enjoy creating structure where none exists and translating rapidly evolving AI capabilities into reliable enterprise services.

You are credible with technical architects, security teams, executives, consultants, and platform vendors. You can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and are excited to help shape how Aimpoint Digital and our clients operate enterprise AI at scale.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS administration, AI platform operations, enterprise architecture, consulting, or related technical leadership roles.
  • Experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms, identity and access management, governance, licensing, and operational processes.
  • Working knowledge of ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise / Cowork / Code / Design or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
  • Understanding of cost management considerations across GenAI tools and platforms.
  • Understanding of enterprise AI governance, security, compliance, model management, and responsible AI practices, and the ability to align GenAI tools to an organization's security posture.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software implementations and client-facing enablement initiatives.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical platform concepts into practical business guidance.
  • Experience with APIs, integrations, automation, or scripting is preferred.

Location

We are actively seeking candidates for full-time, remote work within the United States, with priority evaluation provided for candidates based in New York City, Chicago, and Houston/Dallas. Atlanta-based applicants will have the opportunity to work in our headquarters in Sandy Springs, GA.

jobs.description:
It’s inspiring to work with a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they’re doing!

When you become part of the Chapters Health Team, you’ll realize it’s more than a job. It’s a mission. We’re committed to providing outstanding patient care and a high level of customer service in our communities every day. Our employees make all the difference in our success!

The RN, Triage provides telephonic support to patients and families. The RN, Triage will establish and maintain positive relationships with team members, patients/families and referral resources.

Qualifications:

  • Licensure requirements for this role may vary based on state or local regulations. Candidates must possess and maintain any licenses or certifications required by the state in which they will perform their duties. Specific licensure requirements will be confirmed during the hiring process and must be met within 30 days of hire.
  • Minimum of one (1) year nursing experience; hospice or hospital experience preferred
  • Previous experience working with an EMR/EHR (Electronic Medical/Health Record) system
  • Ability to effectively communicate in English (verbal and written); bi-lingual in Spanish preferred
  • Excellent critical decision making and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent clinical and assessment skills
  • Ability to use equipment with visual and auditory mechanisms
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize demands to meet patient service standards and deadlines
  • Ability to effectively handle stressful situations professionally and calmly with exceptional customer service
  • Strong patient service skills
    • Information seeking / probing skills
    • Accurate knowledge transfer
    • Listening, understanding, and responding
  • Able to navigate in a fast-paced environment utilizing interpersonal skills to maximize caller reassurance and patient visits
  • Ability to work in a cooperative team environment
  • Able to exhibit a sense of urgency in daily work activities
  • Skilled in computer operations; proficiency in MS Office software applications, on-line research and proven data entry and navigation skills
  • Available to work shifts to accommodate extended hours of operation as scheduled
  • Ability to perform sedentary work with frequent interruptions
  • Ability to manage the emotional stress of working with and caring for terminally ill patients and their families
  • Ability to perform the essential functions and physical requirements (including, but not limited to: lifting patients and/or equipment, bending, pushing/pulling, kneeling) of the job with or without reasonable accommodations

Competencies:

  • Satisfactorily complete competency requirements for this position.

Responsibilities of all employees:

  • Represent the Company professionally at all times through care delivered and/or services provided to all clients.
  • Comply with all state, federal and local government regulations, maintaining a strong position against fraud and abuse.
  • Comply with Company policies, procedures and standard practices.
  • Observe the Company's health, safety and security practices.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of patients, families, colleagues and other sensitive situations within the Company.
  • Use resources in a fiscally responsible manner.
  • Promote the Company through participation in community and professional organizations.
  • Participate proactively in improving performance at the organizational, departmental and individual levels.
  • Improve own professional knowledge and skill level.
  • Advance electronic media skills.
  • Support Company research and educational activities.
  • Share expertise with coworkers both formally and informally.
  • Participate in Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement activities as appropriate for the position.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Triages phone calls and ensures that callers’ needs are met efficiently using excellent customer service skills.
  • Provides telephone advice and education for patient needs.
  • Responsible for the timely, courteous, and effective handling of all telephone inquiries related to Chapters Health System’s services. Positively promotes and clearly explains benefits of Chapters Health System’s services. Clients include current and prospective patients, friends, or family members, Powers of Attorney, care providers, physicians, nursing staff, nursing homes and Assisted Living Facilities (ALFs), hospital staff, and others, as appropriate.
  • Gathers necessary information and required documentation from appropriate sources to ensure complete, current, and accurate documentation of patient information and data.
  • Accurately enters data into information tracking systems, including entering and tracking patient referral file in electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Provides reassurance on the phone to patients and families. Assists in finding solutions to their questions and/or recognizes the need for an in person visit. Coordinates in person visit when needed/or requested.
  • Assists the patient and family to achieve the desired comfort levels.
  • Utilizes appropriate support/expert resources or personnel to resolve complex or difficult situations.
  • Documents patient/family contact information in the EMR and communicates with the Interdisciplinary Group (IDG).
  • Triage RN's who experience technical issues not caused by the company equipment or network (i.e. offsite power outage, personal internet outage) are required to report the situation to leadership immediately, and have 30 minutes to resolve the technical issue. If the issue cannot be resolved in 30 minutes, RN may be required to report to a IPU or Resource Center based on leadership direction.
  • During times of emergencies (i.e. Hurricanes, etc.), the Triage RN may be required to report to work at a location designated by the company, to ensure continuity of services. This may include reporting to work ahead of your scheduled date/time due to planned lock down of unit, and staying overnight(s) based on duration of emergency.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Compensation Pay Range:

$32.69 - $51.08

jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The Finance Transformation team builds scalable, global finance processes by leveraging technology to enable the Finance & Accounting (F&A) team to support CrowdStrike’s rapid growth. Reporting to the Senior Director of Finance Transformation, this role will be responsible for managing F&A’s AI transformation roadmap by partnering with functional leaders and IT and Data stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases, build AI solutions, roll out AI enablement programs, and establish AI governance.

What You'll Do:


F&A AI Transformation Roadmap

  • Define the FA AI operating model, charter, and governance forums.
  • Maintain F&A’s AI transformation roadmap including AI project intake, prioritization, and implementation.
  • Evaluate new AI platforms, embedded ERP / Enterprise systems AI features, and specialist Finance AI tools.
  • Maintain a current view of the Finance AI tooling landscape and recommend investment.

AI Use Case Identification & Value Realization


  • Partner with Finance & Accounting Process Leads (Quote-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, FP&A, Specialized Finance) to surface and shape high-value AI opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of business use cases including expected ROI, feasibility, risk scoring, and change impact.
  • Track benefits realization post-deployment and refine the pipeline based on outcomes

Solution Delivery Oversight


  • Manage AI solution proof of concept delivery through partnership with IT, Data, Security, and Vendors.
  • Ensure AI solutions integrate cleanly with other finance systems and manage transition activities needed to scale successful pilots into Production.
  • Evaluate build-vs.-buy decisions and lead vendor selection where applicable.

AI Enablement Program


  • Design and deliver role-based learning paths for the Finance & Accounting function – from analyst to Controller – covering prompt craft, tool fluency, and judgment in AI-assisted work.
  • Build and run a Finance & Accounting AI Champions network to drive grassroots adoption and feedback.
  • Lead change management and adoption campaigns; measure capability uplift and behavioral adoption.

Establish and Own F&A Governance Framework


  • Establish Finance-specific AI guidelines aligned to enterprise AI policy, covering data handling, model risk, SOX implications, auditability, and human-in-the-loop requirements.
  • Educate the function on acceptable use, escalation paths, and documentation expectations.
  • Monitor compliance and partner with Information Security, Vendor Risk Legal, and Internal Audit on assurance activities.
  • Define and report adoption, productivity, quality, and value-realized KPIs.
  • Provide Executive-ready updates on Finance & Accounting AI portfolio, outcomes, and emerging risks.

What You’ll Need:


  • 12+ years combined experience in Finance or Accounting Transformation, with at least 3+ years delivering AI, automation, or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience standing up and/or scaling AI transformation programs.
  • Strong working knowledge of core Finance and Accounting processes (Close, Consolidation, FP&A, Controls Frameworks).
  • Proven track record influencing senior stakeholders (Sr. Director / VP / CFO-level)
  • Bachelor’s in Finance, Accounting, IS or related discipline; MBA, CPA, or CMA preferred.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Associate (Paid Social)
jobs.excerpt: About UsTNT Growth specializes in skyrocketing businesses of all sizes, industries, and revenue models.
jobs.description:
About Us

TNT Growth specializes in skyrocketing businesses of all sizes, industries, and revenue models. We’ve spent over $200M on ads to pinpoint exactly what drives explosive growth.

Unlike other agencies, contractors, and employees, we’re not just about running marketing campaigns and creating reports in spreadsheets. We embed our data, our rigor, and our A team into our clients’ businesses and impact everything they do. Former and current clients include: Salesforce, Gusto, Formula 1, Synthesis School, and more.

The Opportunity

TNT Growth provides the best value to our clients by pushing the needle on discovering cutting edge tactics and continuously updating our best practices. The Growth Manager will be at the forefront of this creativity as they work on increasing leads and customers for client accounts.

As the Growth Manager, you will be responsible for growing revenue via paid social channels such as Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Scale leads and customers for client accounts, for primarily lead gen clients.

  • Build out playbooks and systems for future employees to follow.

  • Eventually build and lead a team of marketing managers, data analysts, and more.

What You'll Do

  • Execute paid social campaigns with precision. Implement media buying strategies developed in partnership with the Sr. Growth Manager across Meta, TikTok, and other platforms — including campaign setup, audience targeting, budget management, and creative deployment.

  • Manage day-to-day operations of active campaigns. Monitor performance daily, troubleshoot issues, adjust bids/budgets, and ensure delivery is pacing correctly toward KPIs like CPL, ROAS, and CAC.

  • Own reporting and performance analysis. Track campaign results, identify trends, and build performance reports with clear insights and next steps. Present findings internally and to clients.

  • Support client communication. Attend client meetings (typically weekly or bi-weekly), prepare meeting agendas, update stakeholders on progress, and flag risks or opportunities.

  • Collaborate across teams. Work closely with the Paid Search team to align on cross-channel strategy, share learnings, and avoid audience overlap. Partner with Creative Strategists, Designers, Analysts, and Engineers to execute end-to-end growth experiments.

  • Prep for and run client calls. Ensure campaign data and talking points are clear and client-ready. Maintain internal documentation and client-facing decks to reflect the most recent performance insights and priorities.

  • Manage projects and timelines. Keep initiatives on track — whether it’s launching a new creative test, rolling out landing page variants, or coordinating with Analytics to update reporting dashboards.

  • Proactively contribute to playbooks and SOPs when the opportunities arises. Help document best practices, setup workflows, and optimization checklists to improve consistency, speed, and scalability across the team.

  • Stay sharp and informed. Keep up with platform changes, creative trends, and industry benchmarks to bring fresh ideas and optimizations to client accounts.

What Makes You Awesome

  • You're performance-obsessed. You have a strong grasp of paid social KPIs (CPL, CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR) and know how to interpret platform signals to drive scale and efficiency.

  • Hands-on platform experience. You've actively managed campaigns in Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram), and ideally dabbled in TikTok, LinkedIn, or X. You understand bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative rotation, and attribution limitations.

  • You speak the language of creative and data. You know how to translate performance trends into creative insights, and vice versa — working seamlessly with designers and analysts to test new angles, hooks, and formats.

  • You iterate fast. You thrive in an environment where campaigns are launched, learned from, and optimized rapidly. You’re comfortable building hypotheses and A/B testing variables like copy, placement, format, and audience.

  • You think beyond the platform. You understand how landing page experience, CRM, lead quality, and funnel conversion impact paid social performance — and proactively collaborate across teams to improve outcomes.

  • You're curious and coachable. You actively seek feedback, stay on top of industry changes, and regularly engage with content, courses, or communities to sharpen your skillset.

  • You communicate with clarity. You can explain performance to clients or team members in a way that’s both technically accurate and business-relevant.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:Grade Level (for internal use):10Sales Compensation Analyst – Strategic Incentive Programs & Payee Lifecycle The TeamWe are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

10

Sales Compensation Analyst – Strategic Incentive Programs & Payee Lifecycle


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

If you are at your best when problems are complex, the data is messy, and the stakes are real, this role was built for you. As the operational owner of global SPIFF programs and end-to-end payee lifecycle management at S&P Global Market Intelligence, you will work at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, People Operations, and Sales Finance — ensuring that every compensation event, from a seller's first day to their last commission payment, is calculated precisely, governed rigorously, and resolved with integrity. This is the function that handles what the standard monthly process cannot — and if that is where you do your best work, this role will give you the scope and the challenge to match.

  • Own end-to-end SPIFF operations — translate commercial campaign briefs into precise qualification criteria, crediting logic, and system rate tables; build automated tracking engines using SQL, Python, or Alteryx to monitor real-time attainment and prevent duplicate claims, eligibility mismatches, and off-policy spend; execute all calculations; deliver post-campaign ROI analytics and spend assessments in Power BI; and archive all eligibility criteria, budget sign-offs, and documentation for full audit-readiness.
  • Architect and execute active payee lifecycle workflows — manage system setup, prorated quota assignments, draw and guarantee schedules, and ramping accelerators for new hires; model and execute effective-dated target adjustments and split crediting rules for mid-year promotions and role changes; and calculate accurate quota relief, crediting freezes, and temporary account coverage allocations for leaves of absence, in line with regional labour policies and commercial guidelines.
  • Own departure and offboarding precision — compute final commission settlements, accelerated vesting, trailing pipeline revenue, and exit reconciliation packages for terminations; manage post-departure claw back reconciliations; and build automated script-based routines linking HRIS platforms, including Workday, with enterprise compensation engines to detect personnel changes, effective-date discrepancies, and reporting line anomalies ahead of payroll processing.
  • Conduct forensic financial investigations and resolve disputes — lead evidence-based technical investigations into high-value sales disputes, contested crediting splits, and payout grievances; model the exact net financial impact of deal cancellations, de-bookings, retroactive invoicing revisions, and claw back schedules; prepare objective, data-backed recalculation findings with clear step-by-step mathematical explanations for commercial representatives and sales leadership; and partner with Legal and People Partners on sensitive executive escalations requiring precise scenario modelling.
  • Serve as the operational governance and audit liaison — partner with the centralised Governance and Compliance team to operationalize compensation policies; compile audit-ready exception packages for manual overrides, custom draws, departure payouts, and non-standard SPIFF rewards; and supply calculation extracts, system logs, approval documentation, and payee lifecycle audit trails for internal and external SOX testing upon request.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales compensation administration, incentive program management, or sales operations within a multinational organisation.
  • Incentive Program and SPIFF Expertise: Proven track record designing, tracking, and executing tactical commercial incentive programs, SPIFFs, and accelerator campaigns with rigorous budget controls and full audit documentation.
  • Payee Lifecycle: Demonstrated experience managing payee lifecycle mechanics including quota proration, draw and guarantee accounting, effective-dated crediting, leave of absence adjustments, and final offboarding commission calculations.
  • SQL and Automation: Advanced SQL proficiency for querying multi-table databases, HRIS tables, and transaction ledgers, combined with hands-on experience using at least one automation or reconciliation tool — Python/Pandas, Alteryx, or Excel/VBA — to reconcile HR data against compensation engines.
  • Enterprise Platforms: Practical administration experience with at least one enterprise incentive platform — Varicent, Xactly, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions — and at least one HRIS platform, including Workday.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building automated SPIFF tracking engines or reconciliation routines that integrate HRIS data with enterprise compensation systems in real time.
  • Experience conducting post-campaign ROI analytics and spend assessments using Power BI, including presenting commercial velocity and incentive effectiveness insights to sales leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting technical, evidence-based financial investigations into high-value sales disputes, contested crediting splits, and payout grievances — including modelling the net financial impact of deal cancellations, de-bookings, and retroactive adjustments.
  • Experience compiling audit-ready exception packages and SOX documentation — including calculation extracts, system logs, approval records, and payee lifecycle audit trails — in support of internal and external audit testing.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and People Partners on sensitive executive compensation escalations and unique dispute resolution scenarios.
  • Experience translating complex commission calculations, SPIFF qualification criteria, and lifecycle adjustments into clear, non-technical explanations for sales representatives and commercial leadership.
  • Experience supporting compensation continuity during organizational changes — including corporate transactions, spinoffs, or workforce reductions — by mapping affected payee structures and ensuring accurate lifecycle adjustments throughout the transition.

Right to Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.


Return to Work — Restart

Have you taken time out for caring responsibilities and are now looking to return to work? As part of our Return to Work initiative, Restart, we are encouraging enthusiastic and talented returners to apply, and will actively support your return to the workplace.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:
Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Master Data Manager
jobs.excerpt: Salary - 120K - 136KLocation - Onsite or RemotePosition Summary:Nordic Naturals is seeking a strategic, collaborative, and process-oriented Master Data Manager to administer and operationalize the Company's enterprise Master Data operating model.
jobs.description:
Salary - 120K - 136K

Location - Onsite or Remote

Position Summary:

Nordic Naturals is seeking a strategic, collaborative, and process-oriented Master Data Manager to administer and operationalize the Company's enterprise Master Data operating model. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounting Operations, this role is responsible for day-to-day Master Data governance, standards, data quality, lifecycle controls, and continuous improvement across customer, vendor/business partner, material, pricing, hierarchy, and finance data domains.

This position serves as the central link among business data owners, Finance, Information Technology, SAP teams, and other enterprise stakeholders. Business functions remain accountable for the content and business decisions within their domains, while the Master Data Manager owns the governance process, workflow discipline, quality framework, documentation, and execution needed to create trusted, consistent, secure, and scalable Master Data. The role facilitates the Data Governance Council led by the Senior Manager, translates approved decisions into action, and helps ensure Master Data supports SAP S/4HANA, automation, analytics, operational excellence, compliance, and future growth.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement:

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions:

  • Master Data Strategy & Roadmap:Translate the enterprise Master Data design, strategy, vision, and priorities established by the Senior Manager and Data Governance Council into practical standards, procedures, controls, implementation plans, and a measurable roadmap.
  • Data Governance Council Facilitation: Facilitate the Data Governance Council led by the Senior Manager by preparing agendas, decision materials, recommendations, metrics, action registers, and follow-up. Administer approved decision rights, priorities, standards, and escalation paths across data domains.
  • Enterprise Standards & Policies: Develop, document, maintain, and enforce enterprise data definitions, naming conventions, validation rules, ownership requirements, approval standards, retention expectations, and operating procedures in alignment with approved governance policy.
  • Master Data Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end processes and workflows for creating, changing, extending, blocking, and retiring Master Data, including request intake, validation, approval, documentation, segregation of duties, change control, and service-level expectations.
  • Data Domain Governance: Administer governance across customer, vendor/business partner, bank, material, pricing, hierarchy, and finance Master Data, including the chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, internal orders, payment terms, and reason codes.
  • Data Quality Management: Establish data-quality rules, monitoring, dashboards, and remediation processes. Prevent and resolve duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, inaccurate, or noncompliant data and coordinate root-cause corrective actions with business and technical owners.
  • Business Data Owner Partnership: Partner with data owners and stewards across Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, and other functions. Clarify accountability, support timely decisions, and ensure business owners remain responsible for data content within their domains.
  • SAP & Systems Partnership: Partner with Information Technology and SAP teams on configurations, integrations, enhancements, workflow automation, testing, releases, user acceptance testing, cutover, and stabilization activities affecting Master Data.
  • Issue Management & Escalation: Lead cross-functional investigation and resolution of enterprise Master Data issues, manage escalations according to the approved governance model, and identify preventive improvements that reduce rework, delays, and downstream business impact.
  • Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness: Ensure Master Data activities comply with Company policies, authorization requirements, security standards, internal controls, regulatory expectations, and audit requirements while maintaining complete and accurate supporting documentation.
  • Change Management & Enablement: Develop communications, training, process guidance, and adoption support for data owners, stewards, requestors, approvers, and system users. Promote consistent use of standards and build enterprise understanding of Master Data responsibilities.
  • Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Define, analyze, and report KPIs such as data quality, duplicate reduction, request cycle time, first-time-right processing, issue aging, business satisfaction, and compliance or audit results. Use insights to prioritize automation and process improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead through influence across functions and levels, establish shared accountability, support enterprise initiatives, and act as the primary operational point of contact for Master Data governance and process questions.
  • Additional Responsibilities: Complete additional responsibilities, projects, and operational support activities as assigned.

Position Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in Master Data management, data governance, ERP-enabled business processes, business systems, Finance operations, Supply Chain operations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional governance, process-design, data-quality, or enterprise change initiatives through influence and shared accountability.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA or a comparable enterprise ERP system; experience with SAP Business Partner, material, customer, vendor, or finance Master Data is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Master Data governance principles, lifecycle management, data ownership and stewardship models, workflow controls, data quality, metadata, and issue remediation.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, security, change management, compliance, documentation, and audit-readiness requirements.
  • Ability to translate complex business and system requirements into clear policies, procedures, standards, workflows, decision materials, and training.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes, interpret data-quality and process metrics, prioritize risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and reporting or data-analysis tools; experience with workflow, data-quality, or governance tools is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain disciplined follow-through, and operate effectively in a changing environment.
  • Data-management, governance, project-management, or process-improvement certification (such as CDMP, PMP, or Lean Six Sigma) is preferred but not required.

Competency Statements

  • Strategic Leadership - Translates enterprise direction into clear Master Data priorities, standards, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
  • Integrity and Trust - Handles sensitive business data responsibly and builds confidence through transparency, consistency, sound judgment, and ethical decision-making.
  • Accountability - Establishes clear ownership, follows through on commitments, escalates risk appropriately, and drives decisions and actions to completion.
  • Critical Thinking - Evaluates complex business and system information, identifies root causes and downstream impacts, and recommends practical, risk-based solutions.
  • Communication and Facilitation - Communicates complex data and system topics clearly, facilitates productive governance discussions, and documents decisions and expectations.
  • Collaboration and Influence - Builds alignment across functions and levels, respects business ownership, and leads through influence in a shared-accountability environment.
  • Change Leadership - Guides stakeholders through new standards, systems, workflows, and responsibilities with clear communication, training, empathy, and disciplined follow-through.
  • Business Acumen - Understands how Master Data affects customers, vendors, supply chain, finance, reporting, controls, operational performance, and Company growth.
  • Attention to Detail and Data Stewardship - Maintains high standards for accuracy, completeness, documentation, security, and control while balancing enterprise needs and operational practicality.
  • Continuous Improvement - Uses metrics, stakeholder feedback, and root-cause analysis to prevent recurring issues, improve automation, reduce cycle time, and strengthen data quality.
