jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe AWS DevSecOps Engineer builds, secures, and operates the AWS environments and automated delivery pipelines that PhoenixTeam uses for internal and client applications.
jobs.description:
Overview

The AWS DevSecOps Engineer builds, secures, and operates the AWS environments and automated delivery pipelines that PhoenixTeam uses for internal and client applications. This is a hands-on production engineering role spanning infrastructure as code, container deployment, CI/CD, security controls integrated into releases, reliability, and incident recovery. The engineer uses shared Platform patterns to make deployment repeatable rather than relying on one-off application setups.

Agentic orchestration is a primary delivery approach: the engineer designs, supervises, and verifies AI-assisted workflows for testing, hardening, containerization, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment. Success depends on independent AWS, DevSecOps, and security judgment—especially when generated scripts or configurations are wrong. The goal is to improve speed and reliability from prototype through production without bypassing security reviews or release controls.

Key Functions

  • Build and operate AWS infrastructure using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, including VPC networking, IAM, ECS/Fargate or EKS, RDS, load balancing, KMS, Secrets Manager, S3, and CloudWatch.
  • Implement application infrastructure within shared Platform patterns; support multi-account controls using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, service control policies, or comparable guardrails.
  • Own build, test, approval, and deployment pipelines as code using GitHub Actions, Forgejo Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or comparable tools; create reusable, documented workflows.
  • Embed SAST, DAST, software-composition/dependency, container-image, and infrastructure-as-code scanning in release stages; maintain blocking criteria and escalate risk acceptance and exceptions to authorized decision-makers.
  • Apply least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets handling, network isolation, and controlled production access; constrain what automation and AI agents can access or change.
  • Design and verify agent-executable playbooks for hardening, testing, provisioning, and deployment; independently review and test generated code, infrastructure definitions, and security evidence.
  • Support blue/green or canary deployment and tested rollback; use lead time, deployment frequency, failure rate, and recovery metrics to improve reliable release delivery.
  • Implement logs, metrics, tracing, health checks, alerts, and cost visibility; participate in a rotating on-call schedule, respond to incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews and runbooks.
  • Use AWS security and audit tooling such as Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, CloudTrail, Inspector, and IAM Access Analyzer as applicable; remediate findings and support relevant evidence needs.
  • Work with application engineers, Platform, QA/verification, and client security stakeholders to support secure handoffs and explain deployment decisions, controls, and human verification.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps, DevSecOps, site reliability, or platform engineering experience, including production responsibility, infrastructure automation, and deployment or incident recovery.
  • Strong production AWS experience spanning VPC/networking, IAM, ECS or EKS, RDS, KMS, secrets management, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.
  • Experience deploying containerized workloads with Docker and building production infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience owning CI/CD pipelines as code, including automated testing, security gates, release promotion, troubleshooting, and rollback.
  • Hands-on experience integrating SAST, DAST, SCA/dependency, container, and infrastructure-as-code security checks into delivery workflows.
  • Ability to script automation in Python, Bash, or Go and independently validate generated scripts and infrastructure configurations.
  • Practical understanding of least-privilege access, encryption, secure credential handling, and NIST SP 800-53 or a comparable security-control framework.
  • Ability to supervise and verify AI-assisted engineering workflows with independent judgment; clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Experience with LLM-assisted or multi-agent engineering automation, including Amazon Bedrock or comparable orchestration tools.

Doodle Labs builds the connectivity backbone of the autonomous systems revolution — resilient wireless mesh networks that let drones, robots, and unmanned platforms operate reliably in the world's most demanding environments. This role combines deep government procurement expertise with business development acumen. Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other. Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

We are looking for a revenue-focused growth marketing leader to build and scale the inbound pipeline engine for our SMB and Mid-Market sales organizations.

Healthcare is our first and most important vertical, but this role is broader than healthcare. You will build the marketing strategy, operating model, and repeatable playbooks that help us acquire and convert customers across multiple industries, with healthcare serving as the primary area of focus today.

You will work closely with Sales, Demand Generation, RevOps, Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, and executive leadership to turn market intelligence, buyer behavior, sales feedback, and funnel data into measurable pipeline and revenue.This is not a traditional brand-marketing role. You will be measured on qualified pipeline, pipeline velocity, conversion, efficiency, and closed-won revenue—not clicks or campaign volume.

The value you will deliver…

What You’ll Own

1. The SMB & Mid-Market Inbound Pipeline

  • Own the inbound pipeline strategy and lead-generation plan for SMB and Mid-Market.
  • Establish clear pipeline targets, funnel KPIs, channel goals, and operating cadences.
  • Build scalable acquisition and conversion programs across priority markets and verticals.
  • Lead the strategy across paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, content syndication, email, webinars, landing pages, retargeting, and other relevant channels.
  • Continuously improve performance from first touch through qualified opportunity and closed-won business.
  • Identify funnel gaps and turn data into specific actions that improve conversion, velocity, and efficiency.
  • Balance near-term pipeline delivery with building a durable, scalable acquisition engine.

2. Lead With Healthcare, Build for the Broader Market. Healthcare is the first major growth opportunity and will require meaningful depth of understanding.

You will develop differentiated campaigns and messaging for:

  • Independent practices and clinics
  • Practice owners and managers
  • Health systems
  • Administrative and operational leaders
  • IT, security, and compliance leaders
  • Payers and health plans
  • Finance and revenue-cycle stakeholders

At the same time, you will build frameworks that can be extended to additional industries and segments.
The right candidate understands that different markets—and different customer segments within a market—have different economics, buying processes, stakeholders, objections, and triggers.

3. Become a True Partner to Sales

  • Build a close operating relationship with SMB and Mid-Market Sales leadership.
  • Regularly listen to calls, review win/loss patterns, and incorporate frontline feedback into marketing strategy.
  • Turn objections, competitive intelligence, customer language, and field insights into better campaigns and messaging.
  • Partner with Sales and RevOps to define lead qualification, routing, and follow-up SLAs.
  • Equip SDRs and AEs with the campaigns, insights, content, audience intelligence, and competitive information they need to convert demand into revenue.
  • Establish a regular Marketing/Sales pipeline review and own the marketing actions required to improve performance.

4. Own the Data, Targeting & Attribution Strategy

  • Partner with Marketing Operations and RevOps to build a highly targeted, data-driven growth engine.
  • Use account, contact, intent, enrichment, and behavioral data to improve targeting and prioritization.
  • Leverage tools such as Definitive Healthcare, IDC, Clay, ZoomInfo, and similar platforms to identify high-value accounts and relevant buying signals.
  • Partner with MarTech and RevOps on lead enrichment, scoring, routing, workflows, and API-driven integrations.
  • Use HockeyStack or equivalent attribution technology to understand which programs and channels actually create pipeline.
  • Reallocate budget and resources based on measurable performance.
  • Build reporting that connects marketing activity to opportunities, pipeline, velocity, and revenue.

5. Build a Repeatable Growth System. The goal is not a collection of one-off campaigns. You will build a repeatable growth system that can scale.

This includes:

  • Segment and vertical playbooks
  • Repeatable campaign frameworks
  • Audience and account prioritization
  • Testing and experimentation
  • Conversion-rate optimization
  • Lead-management processes
  • Marketing/Sales operating rhythms
  • Performance reporting and attribution
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

Healthcare will be the first major proving ground, with successful approaches expanded into additional markets.

What you will bring to the table…

You are a builder, operator, and commercially minded marketer who knows how to turn marketing into measurable revenue.

You possess the following:

  • 7–10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of demand generation, growth, or pipeline.
  • 3+ years leading inbound or pipeline-generation strategy for SMB, Mid-Market, or similarly complex B2B segments.
  • Proven ability to generate measurable pipeline and revenue through multi-channel marketing.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales, RevOps, Demand Gen, and Marketing Operations.
  • Experience across paid media, programmatic, search, social, content syndication, email, landing-page optimization, and/or related performance channels.
  • Strong understanding of CRM, marketing automation, lead management, attribution, enrichment, and funnel analytics.
  • Think in pipeline, conversion, CAC, velocity, and revenue.
  • Are highly comfortable partnering with Sales and being accountable to business outcomes.
  • Know how to translate buyer insights into compelling campaigns and offers.
  • Are analytical, curious, and willing to challenge assumptions with data.
  • Understand how to market to complex organizations and multiple stakeholders.
  • Can move from executive-level strategy to hands-on campaign and funnel decisions.
  • Know how to use data, technology, automation, and experimentation to scale growth.
  • Move quickly and take ownership when something is not working.
  • Build systems and playbooks rather than relying on one-off tactics.
  • Can go deep in healthcare while maintaining a broader perspective across industries.
  • Are an effective communicator who can influence executives, sales leaders, and marketing operators.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar CRM/MAP platforms.
  • Bachelors degree

You will stand out if you also have…

  • Experience with tools such as ZoomInfo, Clay, HockeyStack, Definitive Healthcare, 6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent platforms.
  • Direct experience in healthcare B2B marketing.
  • Experience with providers, health systems, payors, healthcare technology, healthcare services, or another complex healthcare ecosystem.
  • Experience with healthcare-specific data and intelligence platforms.
  • Experience managing agencies, media partners, and external vendors.
  • Experience scaling marketing during a high-growth phase.
  • Experience with ABM or account-based programs.
  • Strong analytical and financial skills, with the ability to connect marketing investment to business outcomes.

Additional details…

  • Location requirements: Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Travel requirements: Up to 10% travel. You can expect to travel to our LA based office at least once per quarter.
  • Physical requirements: Must be able to sit for long periods, as well as, handle long periods of screen time.
  • Technology requirements: Reliable, high speed internet
  • Eligible for sponsorship: No

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

JOB OBJECTIVES:

The Project Management function is focused on:

  • Ensuring there is accountability for every Digital project from start to finish.

Delivery & Project Leadership

  • Define and maintain a consistent project management methodology (planning, scoping, governance, change control) for the Digital team.

  • Organize the portfolio of projects by region (America, LATAM, Europe, SAMEA, APAC) and balance Project Lead capacity accordingly.

  • Experience leading and developing project managers or project leads.

jobs.description:
Reports to: Chief Medical Officer
Compensation: $200,000+ annually, plus equity
Position: Full-time | Clinical Leadership

About the Role

Midi Health is seeking an exceptional clinical leader to help shape the future of women's healthcare. We're looking for someone intellectually curious, ambitious, entrepreneurial, and energized by the opportunity to build, innovate, and scale care in a rapidly growing healthcare company.

This is not a traditional clinical leadership position. We're looking for a forward-thinking physician who combines deep clinical expertise with an innovative, builder's mindset to challenge existing processes, embrace emerging technologies, and translate medical evidence into innovative, scalable care models.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally bright, learns quickly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to invest their expertise, creativity, and energy into helping Midi grow.

This is a highly influential, non-patient-facing role. Your work will directly shape the care delivered by Midi clinicians and the experience of patients nationwide.

What You'll Do

Lead Clinical Protocol Development & Innovation

  • Own and lead Midi's clinical protocol development, review, and approval processes, ensuring care remains evidence-based, current, and scalable.

  • Lead a multidisciplinary committee of clinical experts, facilitating discussions, building consensus, and translating emerging medical research into actionable clinical protocols.

  • Continuously evaluate new medical literature, emerging treatments, and innovations in women's health to identify opportunities to expand and improve Midi's care.

  • Engage external specialists and subject matter experts when needed to inform clinical decisions.

  • Partner with Clinical Education to ensure new and updated protocols are effectively translated into clinician training.

  • Streamline and modernize protocol development through technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

Partner with Product & Engineering to Transform Care Delivery

  • Serve as a key clinical partner to Midi's Product and Engineering teams, helping design, expand, and optimize our care model.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve clinical workflows, clinician efficiency, and patient experience.

  • Help shape the development and utilization of Midi's proprietary AI tools, including Prism, to ensure clinical protocols can effectively inform scalable care delivery and content generation.

  • Bring creative, practical solutions to complex challenges, balancing clinical excellence with operational efficiency and growth.

  • Anticipate emerging healthcare trends and help translate them into new opportunities for Midi.

Own Clinical Oversight of Marketing & Medical Content

  • Design, implement, and lead a scalable clinical review process to ensure medical accuracy and alignment across Midi's marketing materials, educational content, and external communications.

  • Establish the infrastructure, workflows, and clinical resources necessary to support a high volume of content production, including articles, blogs, campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.

  • Partner directly with Marketing and Engineering leadership to design and implement AI-enabled clinical content review systems, enabling Midi to scale content production while ensuring clinical accuracy, consistency, and alignment with our care protocols.

  • Build and manage an efficient review structure, which may include clinical committees, internal subject matter experts, or contracted clinical reviewers.

  • Ensure Midi's external clinical messaging consistently reflects our protocols, standards of care, and evolving medical expertise.

Who You Are

We're looking for a clinical leader who brings both exceptional medical judgment and a builder's mindset.

  • Clinically exceptional: You have a strong foundation in internal medicine, deep expertise in menopause care, and the ability to critically evaluate research, engage subspecialists, and translate complex evidence into practical clinical guidance.

  • Intellectually curious: You're constantly learning, reading, questioning, and exploring what's next in medicine, particularly in women's health, longevity, and emerging therapies.

  • Entrepreneurial and ambitious: You're excited by growth, move quickly, take ownership, and see opportunities where others see obstacles. You want to help build a company, not simply manage an established function.

  • A natural leader and collaborator: You can bring together diverse clinical perspectives, facilitate productive conversations, build consensus, and confidently drive decisions.

  • Highly organized and solutions-oriented: You know how to create structure, streamline complex processes, and build systems that scale without sacrificing quality.

  • Technologically fluent: You're comfortable adopting new platforms, leveraging AI tools, collaborating with technical teams, and finding innovative ways to make work more efficient.

  • Adaptable and action-oriented: You thrive in a dynamic environment, balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem.

Qualifications

Required

  • Internal Medicine Physician

  • Active, unrestricted, unencumbered MD or DO license

  • Board certification in Internal Medicine

  • Substantial clinical experience and demonstrated medical leadership.

  • Leadership experience within a healthcare organization, ideally in a high-growth healthcare startup, digital health company, or innovative care delivery organization.

  • Significant expertise in menopause management and women's health.

  • Strong working knowledge of medication-assisted weight management, including GLP-1 therapies.

  • Broad clinical knowledge grounded in internal medicine.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate medical literature, develop clinical guidance, and collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical experts.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfort with healthcare technology, digital collaboration tools, and AI-enabled workflows.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital health, telehealth, or a rapidly scaling healthcare organization.

  • Interest or expertise in emerging women's health topics, including longevity medicine, peptide therapies, wearables, at-home diagnostics, genetic testing, and other innovations.

  • Experience building or optimizing clinical protocols, governance processes, or medical content review systems.

  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, or Marketing teams.

  • Public speaking, media, or social media experience.

  • Licensure in multiple states.

About Midi Health

Midi Health is the nation's leading virtual healthcare clinic dedicated to transforming women's healthcare. Founded by women, for women, Midi combines expert, evidence-based medicine with personalized, insurance-covered care to address the unique health needs of women through midlife and beyond.

We're building the future of women's healthcare through clinical excellence, innovation, and AI-powered technology, expanding access to specialized care while empowering clinicians to deliver exceptional patient outcomes.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for ambitious, forward-thinking leaders who want to build, innovate, and help shape the next generation of women's healthcare.

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

Hourly Rates Start at £60+ per hour

At Blue Education, we are recognised for offering the most competitive pay in the industry to attract the most talented tutors in the UK and internationally.

We always like to hear from outstanding candidates who share our commitment to academic excellent and student success. We recognise the unique challenges that international students face, from mastering complex subjects to adapting to new cultures and educational systems. Our commitment is to provide comprehensive, personalised, and culturally sensitive tutoring services that foster confidence, competence, and global-mindedness.

The Role

We offer tuition in the following core areas:

  • Independent & Boarding School Applications: 11+, 13+, 14+, 16+
  • GCSE, A Level, IB, and/or AP tuition
  • Competitions tutoring: essay competitions, Olympiads
  • Undergraduate university admissions preparation: especially for Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, LSE, and UCL
  • Postgraduate university admissions preparation
  • Careers guidance

On your application, please list all relevant teaching competencies. You may be considered for one or multiple core areas - no separate applications are required.

All tuition is delivered online through our teaching platform. Most teaching is 1:1 and expectations remain consistently high across all core areas.

What You'll Do

  • Student-Centric Excellence: Your foremost responsibility is delivering exceptional support and care to our students. To us, this means thorough lesson preparation, consistent attendance, and full reliability for every student you agree to teach.
  • Expert Instruction: You will design and deliver personalised, high-impact lessons across your core areas of expertise - whether that be academic content teaching, admissions test support, personal statement guidance, interview preparation, or broader university/career advisory work. Lessons should be tailored, structured, and supported with appropriate homework tasks and tutors are expected to fill out a 3 question lesson report within 24 hours of each class.
  • Curriculum Development: You may also want to contribute to our expanding curriculum by developing new, high-quality content across subject areas or admissions processes. We offer tutors additional pay for centralised resources projects that can be shared with our whole tutor base.

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Previous teaching, tutoring, or admissions counselling experience is required.
  • Strong knowledge of syllabus content or the application process in your core teaching areas.
  • For UK university admissions preparation, a degree from Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, LSE, or UCL is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to stretch and motivate ambitious students.
  • Empathetic, patient, and able to support students with a variety of needs.
  • Confident working independently in an online teaching environment.
  • Up-to-date awareness of trends in your subject and/or admissions field.
  • A commitment to reliability, professionalism, and student-focussed excellence.

Why Blue Education is Unique

  • Reputation for Excellence & Selectivity: We operate a rigorous, selective recruitment process. Only tutors who meet our standards are invited to join our team of part-time tutors. We require all applicants to complete a pre-interview academic task in their subject area. Candidates who score highly are then invited to interview with our Academic Lead in their subject area (which includes a teaching-demonstration).
  • Fast Onboarding for High-Potential Candidates: We like to move fast. Exceptional applicants will be offered to progress quickly through the application stages and can begin receiving students immediately.
  • Transparent, Performance-Driven Culture:Tutor performance is actively monitored to ensure the highest standards of delivery. Each application cycle, tutors with the best feedback, reliability, impact, and pedagogical excellence are promoted - this prioritises them for longer-term students and also comes with a pay increase.
  • Top Quality Resources:We have built our own online teaching platform, to allow you to smoothly update your availability each week and join classes with a one-click link via our integrated lesson links. Your lessons are tracked for you to make payment simpler. Our chat group with you always contains a subject expert who can answer technical questions or clarify any terminology we've used so that you can prepare the best lessons possible and also get Blue-developed materials to ensure consistency and rigour.
  • Remote Work Flexibility: Deliver online tutoring sessions from anywhere in the world, across any different timezones.

Join Blue Education and help to shape the next generation of high-achieving students, while being part of the most selective, well-supported, and best-paid tutoring team in the sector.

ABOUT SWIMMING CANADA

Swimming Canada serves as the national governing body of competitive swimming. We inspire Canadians through world leading performances to embrace a lifestyle of swimming, sport, fitness and health. Canadians are global leaders in high performance swimming and development for both Olympic Program and Paralympic Program swimmers. Swimming is recognized as one of the most celebrated and successful Canadian Summer Olympic and Paralympic sports.

Swimming Canada strives to foster a workplace in which all individuals maximize their potential, regardless of their differences. We are committed to attracting, developing and celebrating a diverse workforce that reflects the community we serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Communications Lead is responsible for developing and executing the Swimming Canada’s communications strategy, telling the story of our athletes and high-performance program, strengthening the organization’s reputation, increase external engagement, and support organizational priorities. The role provides leadership across media relations, corporate communications, digital and content strategy, crisis management, and communications operations.

The Lead directly supervises the Manager, Communications, the Manager, Translation, and oversees a roster of external communications professionals, including photographers, content creators, writers, and other specialized contractors and consultants.

The Lead will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, ensuring communications activities are proactive, integrated, responsive, and aligned with organizational goals.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy and Leadership

  • Advocate a values-driven, positive culture by championing constructive change, challenging the status quo, and fostering an environment where people feel empowered to grow and contribute.
  • Lead the development and implementation of the annual communications strategy, with targeted initiatives that support organizational priorities, business objectives, and engagement goals across all departments.
  • Provide strategic communications counsel and recommendations to executive leadership on emerging issues, opportunities, and reputational risks.
  • Lead communications planning for major initiatives, programs, announcements, events, and organizational change.
  • Establish communications objectives, key performance indicators, and measurement frameworks to evaluate effectiveness and impact.
  • Ensure communications activities align with organizational values, brand standards, and strategic priorities.
  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and service-oriented communications culture.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor the Communications team.
  • Lead the development and management of communications budgets, work plans, and resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership team, as well as department and/or team leads on their communications needs.

Corporate Communications and Operations

  • Establish and maintain communications processes, practices, standards, and workflows.
  • Ensure management of editorial calendars, requests for content, and content approval processes.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, accessibility standards, language requirements, and communications best practices.
  • Oversee translation services to ensure all communications products meet organizational language standards and legislative requirements.
  • Leverage communications technologies, analytics tools, and content management systems to improve efficiency and effectiveness across the organization.
  • Monitor emerging communications trends, technologies, and best practices.
  • Advise on communications strategies that support Swimming Canada’s mandate, key messaging, and organizational values and culture.
  • Write executive and leadership communications, including speeches, presentations, messages, and briefing materials.

Crisis Communications

  • Lead communications planning and response during issues, incidents, and crises.
  • Develop crisis communications frameworks, protocols, and response plans.
  • Advise leadership on messaging, user communications, and reputation management during sensitive situations.
  • Coordinate rapid response communications and media inquiries.

Media Relations

  • Serve as the organization's lead media contact and spokesperson, as appropriate.
  • Lead the development of media strategies, key messages, media advisories, press/news releases, briefing materials, and speaking points.
  • Coordinate interview requests, media events, and press conferences.
  • Monitor media coverage and identify opportunities to enhance organizational visibility and thought leadership.
  • Lead the development and delivery of media training for senior and development athletes, coaches, staff, Integrated Support Team (IST) members, Board members, and other groups as required.
  • Serve as national team media attaché at major championships and Games.

Content Management

  • Oversee and manage the sourcing and management of external writers, photographers, videographers, and other content providers.
  • Act as lead writer and editor-in-chief for all Swimming Canada content.
  • Ensure timely and accurate organizational content is shared on all channels.
  • Lead the management and operationalization of website content best practices for content owners, in collaboration with the Marketing team.

External Communications

  • Lead the development and execution of external communications plans that enhance organizational reputation and build trust, including Annual Report.
  • Oversee the development of compelling, audience-focused content across digital, print, social media, video, and multimedia channels.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing team on campaigns to ensure consistent messaging.
  • Guide storytelling initiatives that showcase organizational impact, strategic priorities, and success stories.
  • Ensure content is accessible, inclusive, and consistent with brand standards.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in corporate and crisis communications, content management, and media operations.
  • Experience within the national sport sector is considered a strong asset.
  • Post-secondary education in communications, public relations or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple ongoing projects, and work comfortably in a deadline driven environment.
  • Strong people management and leadership skills, with experience managing employees and contractors, including supporting day-to-day needs, managing / mediating conflict, providing performance feedback, and coaching/mentoring.
  • Ability to lead, collaborate with, motivate and influence various groups, and maintain composure in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong creative thinker and problem solver, with a values and results-oriented mindset.
  • Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and writing skills in English are required, with fluency in French being a very strong asset.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications, with strong proficiency utilizing media, communications, and content management platforms and technologies.
  • Currently legally eligible to work in Canada.
  • The ability to travel domestically and internationally on a regular basis is required.
  • A valid driver’s license with eligibility to drive a rental vehicle domestically and internationally would be an asset.

WORK LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position with an ideal start date on Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

Swimming Canada's Ottawa Office is located on the traditional territory of the Algonquin Anishinabek People.

jobs.excerpt: WebCreek is looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong experience in real-time audio technologies, VoIP systems, and full-stack development to help build and enhance a mission-critical public address and communication platform.
jobs.description:
WebCreek is looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong experience in real-time audio technologies, VoIP systems, and full-stack development to help build and enhance a mission-critical public address and communication platform.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience developing and supporting production systems using WebRTC, SIP/VoIP, and real-time audio streaming technologies. This role focuses on delivering live and recorded audio to hundreds of networked endpoints, integrating with SIP-based public address and phone systems, and ensuring reliable audio transmission.

This position is well suited for a senior developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of features from design through production, and can work across backend, frontend, and real-time communication technologies.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain real-time audio streaming capabilities for live and recorded announcements across hundreds of networked endpoints.

  • Build and optimize WebRTC-based audio solutions, including browser-side and server-side communication.

  • Develop and maintain integrations with SIP/VoIP systems, PBX platforms, and commercial public address solutions.

  • Implement and troubleshoot audio transport protocols, codecs, jitter buffering, packet-loss handling, and secure real-time communication.

  • Design scalable one-to-many audio distribution solutions, focusing on synchronized playback, latency, and reliability.

  • Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL, Redis, and message-driven communication technologies.

  • Contribute to frontend development using Vue 3 or React, supporting operator-facing interfaces and audio management workflows.

  • Collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate audio issues, review C/C++ firmware, and troubleshoot communication between software and hardware.

  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot containerized services using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

  • Write automated unit and end-to-end tests, participate in code reviews, and maintain reliable CI workflows using GitHub Actions.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while carefully reviewing and validating generated code.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs and deliver reliable production solutions.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including experience delivering and supporting at least one production software product.

  • Strong experience developing real-time audio, VoIP, paging, intercom, conferencing, or audio broadcasting solutions.

  • Hands-on production experience with WebRTC, including browser-side and server-side implementations using technologies such as Janus, mediasoup, LiveKit, or Pion.

  • Strong knowledge of SIP and VoIP technologies, including PBX integrations, SIP trunks, Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with audio codecs and transport protocols, including Opus, G.711, RTP/RTCP, SRTP, SIP over TLS, and STUN/TURN/ICE.

  • Understanding of audio streaming challenges, including jitter buffers, packet loss, latency measurement, synchronized playback, and one-to-many audio distribution.

  • Strong backend development experience with Node.js and GraphQL APIs; TypeScript is a plus.

  • Working proficiency with Vue 3 or React.

  • Experience with MySQL, Redis, and message-driven or publish/subscribe systems such as MQTT.

  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and troubleshooting services running in containerized environments.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/UDP, TLS, WebSockets, and packet capture analysis.

  • Ability to read C/C++ firmware and collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate audio-related issues.

  • Experience writing automated tests, working with GitHub Actions, and following disciplined Git and pull-request workflows.

  • Experience using AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as part of daily development work, with the ability to review and correct generated code.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to independently deliver features from design through production.

  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.

What You'll Gain:

  • A full-time, fully remote position with a growing international company.

  • The opportunity to work on a mission-critical communication platform with real-world applications.

  • Hands-on experience developing scalable real-time audio and networked communication solutions.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with experienced engineers on complex software, networking, and embedded systems challenges.

  • A collaborative remote working environment with an international engineering team.

Location: Remote LaTam

Anticipated Contract End Date: March 31, 2027
Work set up: Remote

Our client in the Information Technology and Services industry is looking for an experienced Technical Specialist Architect to establish a clear, agreed understanding of the IT Service Continuity (ITSC) requirements for services on its Critical Business Services (CBS) inventory, and to assess whether current technical architectures and service and support arrangements meet those requirements. The successful candidate will engage with business stakeholders and Arm’s Length Bodies (ALBs), carry out gap analyses and produce prioritised recommendations. Candidates must be eligible for BPSS checks, and the role is engaged on a PAYE basis through an umbrella company.

What you will do:

  • Review the existing ITSC tiering assigned to services on the CBS inventory.
  • Engage with internal business stakeholders and Arm’s Length Bodies (ALBs) to confirm business continuity and recovery requirements.
  • Reconcile discrepancies between documented service tiering, Service Operations Guide (SOG) records and ServiceNow (SNoW) data.
  • Complete a structured gap analysis between current recorded ITSC tiering and confirmed business requirements.
  • Document the agreed ITSC tiering requirements for each in-scope CBS service.
  • Review existing technical architectures for in-scope CBS services and assess their alignment with confirmed ITSC requirements.
  • Identify gaps between current technical resilience and required ITSC outcomes.
  • Develop high-level recommendations and target architecture options to address the gaps identified.
  • Review existing service and support arrangements and assess operational and support capability against confirmed ITSC tiering requirements.
  • Identify gaps between current support models and required ITSC service levels, and recommend improved service and support arrangements.
  • Produce documented technical, and service and support, gap assessments for each CBS service reviewed.
  • Deliver a consolidated set of prioritised recommendations identifying the changes required to meet ITSC requirements.
  • Experience in technical architecture, including reviewing existing architectures and developing target architecture options.
  • Knowledge of IT Service Continuity (ITSC), service tiering, and business continuity and recovery requirements.
  • Experience carrying out structured gap analyses and producing prioritised recommendations.
  • Experience assessing service and support models against required service levels.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow.
  • Experience engaging with business stakeholders, including Arm’s Length Bodies.

Candidates must be legally authorized to live and work in the country where the position is based, without requiring employer sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?

About Cambi

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 133 million individuals across more than 29 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

jobs.title: Full-Cycle Recruiter (Marketing Agency | Remote)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDo you love talking to people all day?  Do you get a little thrill when the right person says yes?
jobs.description:
Overview

Do you love talking to people all day? Do you get a little thrill when the right person says yes? Have you spent 3+ years finding great marketers on LinkedIn, then getting them on the phone?

If so, we'd love to meet you. We're looking for a high-energy marketing recruiter to help us find and hire the marketers who'll grow our agency.

You'll be the first voice most candidates hear from ProperExpression. We want that voice to be warm, sharp, and glad to be there.

The Basics

This role is for a people person first. You'll spend most of your day talking: on calls with candidates, in messages on LinkedIn, and with our hiring team about who's great and why.

It's also a craft role. You'll run 3 or more open roles at once: finding people who aren't applying, writing outreach they want to answer, running screening calls that tell good from great, and keeping every candidate in the loop from first hello to offer.

You're a marketing recruiter, and it's what you do today. We hire paid media strategists, designers, project managers, RevOps specialists, and more, and you already know what great looks like in those roles. You've hired marketers in the US, and you know what they expect.

Our team spans several continents, and most of our clients are US based. We require C1/C2 English fluency and at least 6 hours a day of overlap with US East Coast business hours.

About Us

ProperExpression is a boutique growth marketing agency specializing in wealth management. For 7 years, we've been the behind-the-scenes growth engine for some of the most innovative firms in the space.

We're a HubSpot Platinum Partner, recognized by Excellence.com and Clutch. We're growing fast, and every hire matters.

We also laugh a lot, don't take ourselves too seriously, and look for any excuse to eat good food. Sharing food experiences has become an internal culture with a life of its own.

Why ProperExpression?

  • Real impact: the people you find will build our next chapter.
  • Real growth: we're expanding fast, and strong performers rise quickly.
  • A culture that works: fast-paced, collaborative, supportive, and built for people who love winning together.
  • Fully remote: work from Canada, Latin America, or Ukraine, with at least 6 hours of overlap with US East Coast time.

Requirements

The Fundamentals:

  • High energy. You genuinely love talking to people, and it shows on the 8th call of the day.
  • Great judgment. You enjoy leading meetings and know when to pause, set boundaries, or take a different approach.
  • A great listener. You ask the follow-up question, and you notice what people don't say.
  • Organized. You know where every candidate stands, and nobody goes dark on your watch.
  • Honest. You tell candidates the truth about the role, even when it's a no.
  • Driven, self-starting, and always looking to get better.

Direct Experience (The Must-Haves):

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offers.
  • You're a marketing recruiter. Most of your recent hires have been marketers.
  • You've hired marketers based in the US.
  • You use LinkedIn Recruiter (Lite, Pro, or Corporate).
  • You source candidates and run candidate calls yourself, every day.
  • You've run hiring for 3 or more open roles at once.
  • You've worked in an applicant tracking system and kept it up to date.
  • C1/C2 English, written and spoken.

Direct Experience (Preferred but Not Required):

  • Upwork sourcing. We use it every week, so this puts you ahead.
  • You've worked at a marketing agency.
  • AI-curious. Experience with AI tools is a plus. If you're new to them, show us how quickly you learn and adapt.
  • Breezy HR or ClickUp. These are the tools we run hiring in.

You're Probably a Fit If

  • You leave a great call with more energy than you started with.
  • You bring fresh ideas, spot ways to make a process better, and love letting the data show you what's working.
  • You've found a great marketer on LinkedIn that nobody else spotted.
  • You've told a candidate "this isn't the right fit" and they thanked you for it.

You're Probably Not a Fit If

  • You'd rather send emails than pick up the phone.
  • Your recruiting has been mostly posting jobs and waiting.
  • Marketing is one of many areas you've hired for, or you last hired a marketer years ago.

Responsibilities

Find great people

  • Source marketers on LinkedIn Recruiter and Upwork, plus job boards and referrals, for 3 or more open roles at a time.
  • Write and send outreach people want to answer.
  • Write and refresh our job postings, and post them where the right people will see them.
  • Build real relationships with strong candidates, and keep a bench warm for the roles we'll open next.

Run a great process

  • Review applications and move candidates through our pipeline.
  • Run screening calls, score them against our written bar, and guide tricky conversations with confidence.
  • Schedule interviews, case studies, and assessments with the hiring team.
  • Help prepare offers and extend them to candidates.

Keep everyone in the loop

  • Keep candidates updated, fast, at every stage. Nobody waits in the dark.
  • Give hiring managers and the team clear updates on where every role stands.
  • Keep every candidate's card in Breezy and ClickUp current.

Make hiring better

  • Track the numbers for each role (replies, screens, time to hire, where hires come from) and bring one fix each month.
  • Stay current on the US marketing talent market and the countries we hire from: pay, where great marketers are, and what they want.
  • Find ways to make our hiring faster and better, without costing more.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Generous PTO
  • Professional development
  • Annual company retreat
  • Fully remote work environment

Application Instructions

Please read and follow these instructions so your application is considered.

1. This role requires marketing recruiting as your current focus, US marketing hires, and LinkedIn Recruiter. If you don't have all three, your application won't be considered.

2. Submit your resume in PDF format.

3. In the "Additional Comments" field, tell us: what is your favorite food and why?

4. Please don't email or message us on LinkedIn until we've reached out to you.

5. If we schedule an intro call, be sure to ask how a bison became the spirit animal of ProperExpression.

We're looking forward to getting to know you!

jobs.description:
Washington Rural Healthcare Human Resources Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, community health centers, and healthcare organizations throughout Washington to identify experienced human resources leaders who understand the importance of supporting both employees and the communities they serve.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming human resources, talent, workforce, and employee relations leadership opportunities across Washington.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, community hospitals, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

This Is More Than an HR Role

In rural healthcare, human resources plays a central role in whether an organization can recruit, retain, and support the people needed to care for the community.

HR leaders often work across every department and help shape the employee experience from the first conversation through onboarding, development, retention, and long-term engagement.

The strongest rural HR leaders are approachable, thoughtful, and trusted. They understand employment law and policy, but they also understand people. They can support employees, advise leaders, navigate difficult situations, and help build a workplace where people feel respected and valued.

In smaller rural organizations, HR leaders may have broad responsibility across recruitment, employee relations, benefits, compensation, compliance, workforce planning, and culture.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Human Resources Director
  • Human Resources Manager
  • Vice President of Human Resources
  • Chief Human Resources Officer
  • People and Culture Director
  • Employee Relations Director or Manager
  • Talent Acquisition Director or Manager
  • Workforce Development Director
  • Recruitment Manager
  • Benefits and Compensation Manager
  • HR Business Partner leadership
  • Organizational Development leadership
  • Learning and Development leadership
  • Payroll and HR operations leadership
  • Senior HR generalist or supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for human resources
  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, retention, and workforce planning
  • Advising executives, managers, and employees on workplace matters
  • Strengthening employee engagement, communication, and organizational culture
  • Leading employee relations, investigations, and conflict resolution
  • Overseeing compensation, benefits, leave administration, and HR operations
  • Supporting performance management and leadership development
  • Developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and employee handbooks
  • Ensuring compliance with employment laws, regulations, and organizational standards
  • Supporting labor relations or collective bargaining, when applicable
  • Managing credentialing, background checks, or workforce compliance processes
  • Improving HR systems, reporting, and documentation
  • Building recruitment strategies for hard-to-fill rural healthcare roles
  • Supporting organizational change, restructuring, growth, or leadership transitions
  • Helping employees and leaders feel informed, supported, and heard

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive human resources leadership experience
  • Experience as an HR Director, HR Manager, HR Business Partner, Talent Acquisition leader, or comparable professional
  • Knowledge of employment law, employee relations, recruitment, benefits, compensation, and HR compliance
  • Experience advising executives and department leaders
  • Strong communication, discretion, and conflict-resolution skills
  • Experience building or improving HR policies, systems, and processes
  • Experience with healthcare workforce challenges and hard-to-fill positions
  • Rural hospital, Critical Access Hospital, FQHC, public hospital district, long-term care, or community healthcare experience
  • A bachelor's degree in human resources, business, healthcare administration, or a related field
  • Relevant certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR may be preferred
  • A collaborative, fair, and relationship-focused leadership style

Why Rural Washington?

Washington's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, islands, and coastlines. These organizations often compete for talent with larger systems while relying on smaller teams to carry broad responsibilities.

Human resources leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to shape culture, strengthen retention, support leaders, and help ensure the organization has the people it needs to continue serving the community.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming human resources leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, location preferences, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Washington communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, workforce needs, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Work Where It Matters.

Are you passionate about building trusted data products that power search, analytics, and AI experiences?

Do you enjoy leading teams, improving data quality, and transforming complex content into valuable customer-facing solutions?

About our Team

Intelligize is the leading provider of best-in-class content, exclusive news collections, regulatory insights, and powerful analytical tools for compliance, transactional and financial reporting professionals. Intelligize offers a web-based research platform that ensures law firms, accounting firms, corporations, and other organizations stay compliant with government regulations, build stronger deals and agreements, and deliver value to their shareholders and clients. Headquartered in New York City, Intelligize serves Fortune 500 companies, including Starbucks, IBM, Microsoft, Verizon and Walmart, as well as many of the top global law and accounting firms.

About the Role

You will lead a team responsible for transforming raw legal and regulatory documents into trusted, structured information that powers Intelligize.

Your team will be responsible for our processes to ingest content, extract and normalize metadata from both structured and unstructured documents, maintain canonical representations of key business entities such as companies, and ensure that hundreds of metadata enrichment processes continue to produce accurate, reliable results as source formats evolve. A strong understanding of SQL and relational data structures will be important for guiding how data is modeled, queried, validated, and improved over time.

You will establish the quality standards, monitoring, and governance needed to ensure that the metadata our products rely on remains trustworthy over time. This includes partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to make sure the data foundation supports customer-facing search and AI experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead offshore and internal teams, including hiring, training, performance management, and employee development.
  • Own execution and reliability for content ingestion, metadata extraction, entity resolution, canonical models, and data quality processes.
  • Establish standards, monitoring, SQL-based validation, escalation paths, and review routines to support search and AI capabilities at scale.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define structured data and metadata needs for customer-facing search, benchmarking, analytics, and AI experiences.
  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, and data quality considerations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • Establish monitoring, quality metrics, and improvement practices to identify regressions, adapt to source-content changes, and improve metadata accuracy and completeness.
  • Plan and deliver data platform enhancements while balancing new capabilities, technical debt, and maintenance priorities.
  • Drive continuous improvement in data quality, reliability, and operational processes.

Requirements

  • Experience leading content engineering, data engineering, information engineering, or similar functions focused on transforming structured and unstructured content into trusted information products.
  • Experience leading and developing teams in a management capacity.
  • Advanced understanding of content ingestion, metadata extraction, entity resolution, data modeling, and information quality.
  • Experience automating metadata extraction, normalization, and enrichment pipelines using appropriate rule-based, machine learning, or LLM-based approaches.
  • Strong understanding of normalized data modeling, canonical entity design, metadata schemas, and provenance.
  • Strong proficiency with relational databases, SQL, and data storage technologies, including investigation, validation, monitoring, and analysis activities.
  • Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with a focus on customer-facing data quality and reliability.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and manage competing priorities.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

jobs.title: Dispatch Operator
jobs.excerpt: About EnPoweredElectricity grids are under more pressure every year.
jobs.description:
About EnPowered

Electricity grids are under more pressure every year. Demand is rising with electrification and reshoring, heat waves push peak usage higher, and more of our supply comes from intermittent wind and solar that rise and fall with the weather. To support our economy as we transition to cleaner energy, grids need flexibility: customers who can store energy when it is plentiful and/or reduce their draw when the grid is stretched.

EnPowered makes that flexibility simple and profitable for businesses. We support hundreds of large commercial, industrial, and institutional businesses in Ontario and the U.S., helping them to avoid costly price spikes. Together they save $50-100M a year, while reducing their demand when the grid needs it most.

We also control the largest fleet of behind-the-meter battery assets in Canada. For industrial sites that need reliable backup power, we install batteries at no upfront cost, then own and operate them in energy markets on the customer’s behalf. The customer gets resilience and lower energy costs without changing how they run their business.

Our vision: Every business and home is actively participating in the electricity grid.

Our mission: Enabling a profitable transition to sustainable energy.

How we work

  • Small team, clear ownership. We are a small team, split into five cross-functional capability teams. The people who build our tools work directly with the people who use them, and everyone knows which outcomes they are responsible for.
  • AI is part of everyone's job. We get a lot done for a team our size, partly because everyone uses AI to solve their own problems. Everyone has access to all of our data and the latest AI models, and is expected to use them to excel in their role.
  • We move fast and improve constantly. We set ambitious goals every quarter, break them into monthly milestones, and check progress as a team every week. We would rather ship something useful this week and improve it next week than wait for perfection. This allows us to learn quickly, adapt on the fly, and move faster than other companies.

The role: Dispatch Operator

Our customers save money by changing when and how they use electricity. As our Dispatch Operator, you will be part of the team owning every market event we manage on their behalf, with one goal: maximize their savings while minimizing disruption to their operations. That covers coincident peaks, demand response, monthly demand charges, and energy arbitrage across IESO, PJM, and NYISO, with more markets coming. More and more, it also means directly controlling batteries in the field as energy markets keep changing.

The companies that win in this market are the ones that adapt fastest, so you will be expected to use AI to stay at the cutting edge. Our peak calling agent already analyzes forecasts, weather, and grid conditions, recommends decisions, and drafts customer notifications. You will run tools like this in live events, challenge their recommendations, and keep improving them so we keep beating the market for our customers.

What you'll do

  • Manage market events from start to finish. Monitor market conditions, decide when and how customers should respond, and run each event from the first alert to the all clear. You will start as part of the team making these calls and grow into the primary decision-maker.
  • Call coincident peaks. Identify likely peak days and hours in IESO (Ontario 5CP), PJM, and NYISO using forecast models, weather data, and grid operator reports.
  • Run demand response events.
    • Assess IESO capacity auction events and the growing number of utility demand response programs.
    • Decide what to pass on to customers, and manage activations through to settlement.
    • Keep registrations, bids, and auction submissions on track.
  • Manage unique, customer-specific opportunities. Each site has its own equipment, operating limits, and savings opportunities. Find them, build a plan for each customer, and carry it out using batteries and flexible loads, without compromising the commitments we've made to that customer.
  • Control assets through our energy management system (EMS). Dispatch batteries directly, set and monitor operating limits, and work with our engineering team to improve these tools over time.
  • Keep customers informed. Make sure every event notification is accurate, on time, and tells customers exactly what to do.
  • Train our AI tools. Review the agent's recommendations and drafts, correct them, and record your reasoning so they improve. Test them against historical events and suggest new data they need.
  • Review results and find new opportunities.
    • After every event and every season, compare decisions with outcomes and turn what you learn into better procedures and tools.
    • Track new programs, rule changes, and market opportunities, and bring recommendations to the team.

What you bring

Required

  • Two to five years in the energy sector, such as utility operations, grid or system operations, dispatch, or energy services.
  • A solid understanding of electricity markets and commercial electricity bills, including wholesale prices, capacity, coincident peaks, demand charges, and demand response.
  • Comfort making decisions from forecasts, weather data, and probabilities rather than certainties.
  • Calm, decisive judgment under time pressure.
  • Precise written communication, because customers act on what you send.
  • Daily use of AI tools, the habit of checking their output, and an interest in building your own.
  • Availability for early mornings, evenings, and some weekends during peak seasons.
  • A drive to become a recognized expert in market operations. This role grows in depth and responsibility rather than in people management.

Nice to have

  • Dispatch experience with batteries, generators, or other distributed energy resources.
  • Experience with an EMS or SCADA system.
  • Knowledge of Ontario's renewed market (day-ahead market and OZP), PJM, or NYISO.
  • Experience with the IESO capacity auction or Ontario's Industrial Conservation Initiative (Class A).
  • Python or SQL for working with price, forecast, and interval data.
  • A background in meteorology or weather forecasting.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you understand the markets and programs we operate in, the operating limits of our customers' sites, and how our AI tools reach their recommendations. You have shadowed events and run the full notification sequence on test events.
  • First 90 days: you are running events in at least one market as part of the decision team, with AI-drafted notifications that need only minor edits. You have made at least one improvement to our procedures or tools.
  • First 12 months: you are the primary decision-maker for most events across our markets. Battery dispatch through the EMS is routine, and you have brought at least one new market opportunity to the team.

What we offer

  • Rewarding work that directly shapes how Ontario's grid uses flexible energy.
  • A competitive salary and stock options.
  • Health benefits.
  • Flexible schedules,a work-from-home environment, and a generous vacation policy.
  • Regular team events, including quarterly team onsites.

How to apply

Tell us briefly about a time you made an important decision with incomplete information, and how it turned out.

EnPowered is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005, accommodation will be provided by EnPowered throughout the recruitment, selection, and assessment process to applicants with disabilities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000
