jobs.excerpt: Travefy is at the center of operations for modern travel agencies.
jobs.description:
Travefy is at the center of operations for modern travel agencies.

More than 50,000 travel agencies and advisors run their business on Travefy. They design stunning trips and itineraries, manage clients with our CRM, market their brand, and handle the back office, from invoices and forms to commissions, all in one place. We bring together everything an agency needs to grow, so advisors can look like pros and spend more time wowing their clients.

A new generation of advisors is entering the industry, and the opportunity to shape how leisure travel is sold has never been greater. Join us in building the tools that power an industry.

About the Role

As our Implementation Lead, you’ll own the execution and operational excellence that takes partners and agencies from a signed contract to successful launch. This role levels up the onboarding and implementation experience for our customers, plays a critical role in their success, and puts you at the center of many of Travefy’s largest and most pivotal projects.

This is a high-agency role, with broad exposure. You will run enterprise, host agency, API/white-label and business development partner rollouts (such as insurance and booking providers) end to end: the plan, the data migration, the technical setup, the onboarding and the go-live. We want someone we can trust to truly own an implementation, deliver it at a high standard, and turn every rollout into a repeatable playbook.

For your first six months, you’ll focus on onboarding our largest host agencies. From there, the role grows to cover data migrations and processes for agencies of every size, plus the technical onboarding of partners such as travel insurance providers and API users. This is an operational role: our Strategic Accounts team owns the customer relationship, and you own getting the customer live and adopting.

How you’ll be measured: time from signature to live, adoption against each partner’s ramp target, and partner CSAT.

What You’ll Own

Implementation project management

  • Be a key point of contact for a defined group of new customers alongside their account manager, running each agency, host agency and enterprise rollout end to end: kickoff, migration, parallel testing, key training and go-live
  • Set timelines and milestones with each customer, follow up to keep them moving, and drive activation so customers complete the activities that show they’re adopting Travefy, not just attend training
  • Run the weekly partner status meeting and own the risk list, escalating major concerns early and keeping internal stakeholders updated
  • Say “no” or “not yet” to partners when needed, and advocate internally for what each rollout needs
  • Manage the full implementation cycle end to end, from contract handoff through onboarding, launch, and adoption
  • Collaborate closely with account management and Travefy leadership on goals and customer relationships; this role works directly with company leadership

Technical setup and API expertise

  • Be a Travefy Expert. Understand our API and system architecture with sufficient depth to answer partners’ technical questions alongside a CX team that keeps building its own technical capabilities, and know when to escalate to Engineering or Account Management
  • Coordinate the technical onboarding of partners such as travel insurance providers and API users, translating between their IT teams and ours
  • Own data migration and field mapping (contacts, duplicates, bookings), and coordinate bulk account, team, billing and subscription setup with the account manager
  • Handle SSO troubleshooting, day-to-day technical questions from partners, and the technical admin requests from Account Management that land in Product Triage today

Training and enablement

  • Design, and where necessary, lead initial client and team onboarding training, with a view to hand ongoing sessions to our CX trainers
  • Run partner staff trainings, agent webinars, and office hours, especially on the back office (commissions, reconciliation)
  • Write clear agent communications for rollouts reaching thousands of advisors, and coordinate with RevOps on routing and welcome emails for bulk launches

Playbooks and services

  • Build a standard implementation playbook (kickoff, data mapping, parallel testing, training plan, agent comms, go-live checklist and handoff), including our API and white-label process, and adapt or add tools to support it
  • Define handoffs and SLAs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Strategic Accounts and CX, with the materials those teams use after go-live
  • Help build our services portfolio, starting with migrations

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days. You know the product deeply, especially the back office and the API. You have built in-depth historical knowledge of our largest rollouts, and you are helping lead the way on our next major host agency implementation.

First 60 Days. You are running that implementation end to end through testing and cutover, and supporting a recent partner through its first back-office payroll. You own bulk partner setup and are driving small to mid-size implementations on your own.

First 90 Days. You own a defined group of new customers end-to-end, with timelines set and customers actively adopting Travefy. You have delivered a standard implementation playbook and defined the handoffs and SLAs from Sales and into Strategic Accounts and CX. Product no longer fields routine API questions, and you are actively improving our processes. You are empowered to put ideas from your past experience to work and you’re proactively finding opportunities to do so.

What We’re Looking For

You’re a high-agency generalist who’s run B2B SaaS implementations from kickoff to go-live, and is ready to own them, and the playbook behind them, at a growing company.

Must-Haves

  • 2+ years as a technical implementation specialist, technical account manager or technical project manager at a SaaS company, including project management of implementations or onboarding
  • Hands-on experience with integrations and APIs, data migration, field mapping, bulk setup, SSO and admin tools
  • You’re not afraid of complex projects with multiple moving parts and multiple teams involved
  • A process builder who creates standardized playbooks and processes
  • Strong cross-functional coordination and risk management; you surface major concerns early and get buy-in across teams
  • Confident presenting and training customers, and calm and credible with agency leadership
  • Organized, clear in writing and customer-oriented: you document everything and build the trust that carries a relationship through a “no” or a delay

Nice-to-Haves

  • Travel industry experience, especially with host agency operations and back-office systems (commissions, reconciliation, advisor payroll). This is a major advantage: it means a faster ramp-up
  • Experience implementing API or white-label partnerships, or building a services offering such as data migrations
  • Experience writing customer communications for large user bases

How You Work

Ownership mindset. You take full accountability for your implementations, from kickoff to the day the customer is live and adopting. You identify what needs to happen and make it happen, without waiting to be asked. When a rollout needs help, you raise it early, with a recommendation in hand.

Critical thinking and problem solving. You get to the root of an issue and find a path forward, even when the answer isn’t documented. You weigh the tradeoffs, make sound calls on your own, and know when a question needs Engineering or Account Management. You spot risks before they become problems.

Is a craftsperson. You bring deep skill to your work, take pride in it and keep getting better. If you haven’t been trained on something, you go learn it. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and turn partner requirements into clear plans.

Cross-functional fluency. You build trust with Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps and CX, and you are comfortable advocating for what a rollout needs. You bring the right people in at the right time and keep everyone aligned on the plan. You work through disagreements directly, so customers never feel the seams between teams.

Shows up for teammates. Your teammates can count on you. You do what you say you’ll do, share what you know, and step in when someone needs a hand. When something’s off, you say so directly and kindly and work on the fix together, and you celebrate the wins with them.

Compensation & Details

  • On Target Earnings: $90,000 – $100,000 depending on experience ($75,000 – $85,000 base plus performance compensation).
  • Location: Remote anywhere in the United States, or hybrid from our Lincoln, NE, Omaha, NE or Pennington, NJ office.

Why Join Travefy

Impact. At Travefy, our mission is to power travel professionals' success. Your work directly supports thousands of travel advisors who are building businesses doing what they love—crafting unforgettable travel experiences.

Innovation + Ownership. We’re a fast-moving company where team members have real ownership and influence. Your ideas will shape how our organization operates and scales.

People are our Priority. We believe in kindness, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, celebrate wins together, and support each other through challenges.

Growth & Learning. As we scale, you’ll scale with us. You’ll have the autonomy to expand your scope, tackle new challenges, and shape your role as the company evolves.

Flexibility & Balance. We support both remote work and strong office cultures in Nebraska and New Jersey. Whether you’re collaborating in person or working from home, we’re focused on creating an environment where people can do their best work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive cash compensation
  • Flexible Time Off + Annual Travel Stipend
  • Health, Dental & Vision insurance for you and your family
  • 401(k) with automatic company contribution
  • Annual team retreats to exciting destinations
  • Technology, learning budgets, and more!

At this time, we’re not considering applicants who need any immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States.

Travefy does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 OTE

jobs.title: Chief Technical Officer (CTO)
jobs.excerpt: Vimec srl, azienda leader nel mondo dell'accessibilità e appartenente al gruppo internazionale Innovalift AB, è orgogliosa di offrire prodotti sempre innovativi che soddisfano le esigenze dei propri clienti.
jobs.description:
Vimec srl, azienda leader nel mondo dell'accessibilità e appartenente al gruppo internazionale Innovalift AB, è orgogliosa di offrire prodotti sempre innovativi che soddisfano le esigenze dei propri clienti. Per migliorare il livello di innovazione del nostro portafoglio prodotti, il/ la CTO deve, in collaborazione con il Managment team, sviluppare e pianificare il portafoglio futuro, condurre la ricerca e sviluppo per nuovi progetti, prodotti e processi, nello stesso tempo supervisionando lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione dei progetti, mantenendo l'accuratezza tecnica e coordinando il lavoro con altri manager e personale.

Nello specifico, il/la CTO ha la responsabilità della gestione e controllo delle seguenti funzioni aziendali:

· Ufficio Ricerca e Sviluppo prodotti verticali, inclinati e mobili relativamente alla progettazione meccanica ed elettrica/elettronica

· Ufficio sviluppo commesse

· Ufficio Product Management

· Ufficio Project Management relativamente allo sviluppo nuovi prodotti (NPD)

Principali Responsabilità

- Supervisionare e coordinare le attività relative alle funzioni sopra indicate.

In particolare:

- Supervisionare e coordinare le attività relative alla funzione di project management con specifico riferimento ai progetti relativi a nuovi prodotti, con l’obiettivo di garantire il successo degli stessi in termini di costi/qualità/tempi.

- Essere responsabile della Gestione Portafoglio Prodotti; garantire che il portafoglio in essere mantenga la competitività sul mercato e che il portafoglio futuro sia in linea con gli obiettivi strategici della società:

o posizionamento nel mercato, analisi e comparazione concorrenza dal punto di vista tecnico/commerciale/economico,

o upgrade delle caratteristiche tecniche e funzionali,

o gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto

o Ottimizzazione costo, performance,

o Aggiornamento tools e documentazione

o Razionalizzazione della gamma prodotti

- Garantire che tutta la documentazione tecnica di prodotto ( come: specifiche tecniche di prodotto, istruzioni di assemblaggio, montaggio, check list di collaudo a fine montaggio, istruzioni di installazione, istruzioni di uso e manutenzione) sia sempre aggiornata rispetto l’evoluzione del prodotto, delle tecnologie adottate per produrlo e in linea con le direttive tecniche e legislative in vigore nel paese di destinazione del prodotto.

- Supervisionare la fattibilità, progettazione e sviluppo di commesse speciali.

- Guidare il proprio team al miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle performance (Qualità/tempi) degli stessi, in particolare attraverso:

- Implementazione e manutenzione dei software necessari allo svolgimento delle attività

- Digitalizzazione processi (PDM/PIM etc.)

- Aumento della modularità sulla componentistica e le soluzioni utilizzate.

- Creare la cultura del Value Analysis Value Engineering nella propria funzione così come in tutta l’azienda; lanciando periodici programmi VAVE focalizzati sui prodotti in essere al fine di garantirne la competitività sul mercato;

- In collaborazione con le altre funzioni aziendali (quali Sales, Marketing ed IT):

  • Supervisionare la definizione della struttura dei listini di vendita (prezzi esclusi) definendo gli allestimenti base, quelli standard e quelli opzionali chiarendo le possibili combinazioni disponibili alla vendita

  • Sovraintendere alla definizione delle regole e specifiche tecniche di prodotto che regolamentano il funzionamento del configuratore commerciale assicurandosi che vengano correttamente implementate e testate.

  • Autorizzare, in accordo con la Product Manager, il rilascio degli aggiornamenti tecnici al configuratore commerciale

- Coinvolgimento e collaborazione con altre aziende del Gruppo, condivisione best practice tecnologiche e di processo

- Rappresentare Vimec nelle associazioni di categoria (Anacam, Epsa, ecc..) e in UNI

Qualifiche/competenze del/della CTO:

- Forte leader di dipartimento con competenze in pianificazione strategica, definizione degli obiettivi, sviluppo dei processi, definizione del budget e creazione di opportunità di sviluppo professionale all'interno dei team tecnologici.

- Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, leadership e pensiero strategico con attitudine al problem-solving.

- Solida comprensione delle tendenze tecnologiche generali e capacità di allineare l'innovazione agli obiettivi aziendali.

- Forte comunicazione con capacità di trasmettere argomenti tecnici in termini aziendali di facile comprensione e lavorare in collaborazione con team interfunzionali e partner esterni.

- Intelligenza strategica, inclusa la capacità di identificare nuove opportunità, favorire chiarezza, creare concentrazione e prendere decisioni difficili in contesti complessi e dinamici.

- Capacità di tracciare e identificare nuove tecnologie per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi.

Requisiti di istruzione ed esperienza:

- Laurea triennale in ingegneria, (preferibilmente laurea magistrale).

- Precedente esperienza come CTO, direttore o ruolo di leadership simile.

- Esperienza precedente come leader tecnico senior che supervisiona l'architettura e l'ingegneria per piattaforme tecnologiche a livello aziendale e piattaforme tecnologiche SaaS leader.

- Ampia conoscenza dell'ingegneria del software: linguaggi, framework, tecniche e tendenze del settore.

- Esperienza nella guida di cambiamenti e iniziative importanti e complessi; capacità dimostrate nella gestione del cambiamento a livello organizzativo e interpersonale; esperienza nell'integrazione di team di più unità aziendali e nella gestione di una forza lavoro geograficamente dispersa.

- Esperienza nella progettazione e gestione di un quadro di governance IT efficace nell'intero spettro della fornitura di servizi IT.

Vimec offre la possibilità di inserirsi in un contesto internazionale, il cui denominatore comune è il Teamwork, offrendo un ambiente stimolante, dove ci si può cimentare in progetti sfidanti e dinamici, tutti nel rispetto dei valori aziendali, ovvero Passione, Integrità e Impegno.

Vimec crede fortemente nel valore delle proprie persone e offre importanti opportunità di crescita.

Non perdere l'occasione di unirti a noi e portare la tua carriera al livello successivo!

Le persone interessate possono inviare la propria candidatura con autorizzazione ai sensi del dlgs. 196/2003.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso.

Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

About the team

About the role

The Senior Accountant - Revenue applies advanced accounting knowledge to perform complex operational activities, ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records, and support timely, compliant reporting. This role partners closely with Finance and cross-functional teams to improve processes, resolve issues, and provide insights that help leaders make sound business decisions.


You will:

  • Lead the preparation, review, and analysis of journal entries, account reconciliations, and schedules to ensure the completeness and accuracy of financial results.
  • Perform month-end and quarter-end close activities for assigned areas, identifying root causes of variances, resolving discrepancies, and recommending process improvements.
  • Analyze trends and key drivers in assigned accounts, preparing clear summaries and explanations for management reviews and internal reporting.
  • Collaborate and cultivate relationships with Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, and business partners to provide accounting insights, answer operational questions, and support initiatives that impact the general ledger.
  • Support system and process changes (such as new tools, integrations, or workflows) by defining accounting requirements, testing outcomes, and validating data integrity.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance standard operating procedures, controls, and documentation for key accounting processes to support compliance and audit readiness.
  • Continuously pursue optimization and automation of existing processes to scale with the growth of the business efficiently.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional accounting experience in public accounting, industry (technology, advertising, media), or a mix.
  • Active CPA license (strongly preferred), with a foundation in public accounting and strong technical accounting knowledge.
  • Experience performing and reviewing period-end close activities and variance analysis in a high-volume or multi-entity environment.
  • Experience working with modern ERP, financial systems, and tools such as Alteryx Designer or Databricks to manage data and improve accounting workflows.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Google Gemini in accounting and/or finance environments.
  • Advanced Excel skills with an interest and aptitude for working with large datasets.
  • Ability to work with a high sense of urgency while maintaining outstanding attention to detail.
  • Capable of prioritizing conflicting responsibilities and independently driving toward deadlines in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving, and data driven organization.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Research Scientist – GPU Native Numerical Algorithms
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing.  Today, we are building software, systems, and research platforms that help scientists and engineers solve problems that were once out of reach.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing. Today, we are building software, systems, and research platforms that help scientists and engineers solve problems that were once out of reach. We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist to join our computational engineering applied research team! In this role, we will work together to design GPU-native numerical methods that make engineering simulation faster, more reliable, and easier to use across NVIDIA platforms, while providing the numerical foundations for emerging AI-native engineering algorithms. You will explore solver algorithms, build research prototypes, compare approaches on representative workloads, and help move promising ideas into software used by researchers, engineers, and partners. The goal is not simply to port established CPU algorithms, but to rethink methods around massive parallelism, hierarchical memory, reduced synchronization, mixed precision, tensor-core computation, and multi-GPU systems.

This role connects numerical analysis, accelerated computing, production-minded software engineering, and the co-design of future AI-native engineering methods. We are interested in candidates who enjoy working across math, code, hardware, and real engineering applications. Come help us shape the future of simulation on GPUs!

What you'll be doing:

We work as a team, and you will help us:

  • Invent and reformulate numerical algorithms whose mathematical and computational structure is co-designed for modern NVIDIA GPU architectures, including implicit and explicit engineering simulation.

  • Develop linear and nonlinear solver approaches, including Newton-Krylov methods, multigrid and AMG, domain decomposition, matrix-free algorithms, mixed precision methods, sparse iterative and direct methods, and preconditioning strategies.

  • Investigate when established CPU-oriented numerical methods should be reformulated or replaced for GPU architectures, including new approaches to synchronization-avoiding Krylov methods, GPU-native multigrid and domain decomposition, matrix-free implicit methods, mixed-precision algorithms, and sparse direct/iterative hybrids.

  • Evaluate algorithms on workloads in mechanics, contact, thermal-fluid systems, electromagnetics, semiconductor process and device simulation, EDA, multiphysics, and related CAE domains.

  • Collaborate with CUDA-X, Warp, solver engineering, NVIDIA Research, universities, and industry partners to move useful research from prototype to NVIDIA software capabilities.

  • Help shape the long-term applied research roadmap for GPU-native numerical methods and their evolution toward AI-native computational engineering.

What we need to see:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational mechanics, applied mathematics, scientific computing, computer science, aerospace, mechanical, civil engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of relevant work/research experience.

  • Research or engineering experience with PDE discretization, finite element, finite volume, discontinuous Galerkin methods, nonlinear solvers, sparse linear algebra, preconditioning, or high-performance computing.

  • Experience writing numerical software in C++ and Python, plus experience developing or optimizing CUDA or GPU code.

  • Experience using profiling, benchmarking, numerical validation, or performance analysis to improve algorithms on GPU or multi-GPU systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate across research, engineering, product, and partner teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with implicit structural dynamics, nonlinear mechanics, contact, CFD, electromagnetics, multiphysics, semiconductor simulation, EDA, CAE, or CAD-connected engineering workflows.

  • Contributions to or practical experience with PETSc, Trilinos, MFEM, libCEED, OpenFOAM, NVIDIA Warp, CUDA-X, cuSPARSE, cuSOLVER, or related computational science frameworks.

  • Experience with industrial simulation, EDA, semiconductor, CAE, or CAD ecosystems, including Ansys, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Siemens Simcenter, Dassault SIMULIA, Altair, Cadence, Synopsys, COMSOL, MathWorks, or comparable internal solver and design platforms.

  • Experience with distributed solvers using MPI, NCCL, asynchronous methods, or performance analysis on GPU clusters.

  • Publications, patents, open-source work, or deployed software in computational science venues or communities such as SC, SIAM CSE, SIAM SISC, CMAME, IJNME, JCP, AIAA, USNCCM, WCCM, or related areas.

Scope of Position

The Manager of Inpatient Coding is responsible for managing systems and operations for efficient coding of inpatient medical record information. The manager monitors ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM/PCS code assignments for inpatient and rehabilitation prospective payment systems (MS-DRGs and APR-DRGs). Monitors computerized medical record information systems, i.e., IHIS and 3M Encoder. In this role, the Inpatient Coding Manager serves as a liaison and coordinator for special projects regarding the coding of medical records. The accuracy of the coding of diagnoses and procedures and the timeliness of their provision to the billing system will determine if the hospital will receive the full and proper payment from Medicare, Medicaid, CHAMPUS, and other third party payers. About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

About the Role:

10

Sales Compensation Analyst – Commercial Modelling & Governance Automation


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

This is a role for someone who sees a manual compensation process and immediately knows how to automate it. As the analytical and engineering engine behind S&P Global Market Intelligence's sales compensation function, you will convert complex commercial deal structures, multi-tier incentive plans, and governance controls into automated, audit-ready data models — building the infrastructure that makes accuracy scalable and compliance systematic. If you combine deep technical fluency in SQL, Python, and Power BI with a genuine understanding of how enterprise compensation works, this role offers the scope, the complexity, and the leadership exposure to match.

  • Translate and engineer complex commercial deal structures — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic and standardised business rules within the compensation calculation engine, eliminating manual offline adjustments and ensuring downstream calculation readiness.
  • Model and simulate the financial impact of proposed changes to compensation plans and crediting rules — running Python and SQL scenario analyses on historical payout data and partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and commercial accuracy.
  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation engines using Python, Alteryx, and SQL — cross-comparing ledger revenues, CRM bookings, and calculated commissionable revenue, and engineering variance detection models that automatically surface anomalies including revenue double-counting, territory misalignment, unassigned account credits, and clawback mismatches.
  • Design and maintain governance control frameworks — building systematic tracking mechanisms for all manual adjustments with full origin, justification, and approval trails; directing comprehensive quarterly and annual SOX audit documentation; and running automated control test queries to demonstrate end-to-end calculation traceability.
  • Architect and maintain enterprise Power BI reporting suites — developing advanced data models using DAX and Power Query M to visualise sales performance, attainment distributions, and compensation trends; building real-time Data Health and Anomaly monitoring dashboards; and presenting variance summaries, root cause analyses, and actionable insights directly to Finance and Commercial leadership.
  • Standardise operations and advise stakeholders — converting fragmented legacy workflows into structured SOPs with clear SLAs; serving as the senior technical point of contact for Commercial and Finance stakeholders by translating complex data logic and calculation outcomes into plain-English explanations; and conducting technical peer reviews of queries, code updates, and configuration changes prior to production deployment.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales compensation analytics, financial modelling, or commercial data governance within a multinational organisation.
  • SQL and Data Modelling: Advanced SQL proficiency for data modelling, validation, and complex multi-table reconciliation across ledger revenues, CRM systems, and compensation engines.
  • Automation and Scripting: Hands-on experience using Python/Pandas or Alteryx to build automated reconciliation workflows, variance detection models, and data pipeline scripts.
  • Power BI Development: Advanced Power BI expertise including data modelling, star schema design, complex DAX measures, and Power Query M transformations for enterprise-level reporting suites.
  • Governance and SOX Controls: Proven experience operating within SOX-compliance frameworks — designing audit-ready controls, running automated control test queries, and producing end-to-end calculation traceability documentation.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within B2B SaaS or subscription-based sales compensation environments, including enterprise crediting rules, quota structures, and multi-tier incentive plan mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting complex data logic, calculation methodologies, and compensation model outcomes to Finance and Commercial executive leadership in clear, non-technical language.
  • Experience translating complex commercial contract mechanics — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic within enterprise compensation calculation engines.
  • Experience partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and downstream compensation calculation readiness.
  • Experience building real-time data health and anomaly monitoring dashboards that surface unmapped accounts, missing credit assignments, adjustment volume trends, and pipeline integrity issues.
  • Experience designing and maintaining standardised adjustment protocols with systematic approval trail tracking for manual compensation overrides.
  • Proven experience conducting technical peer reviews of SQL queries, automation scripts, and configuration changes prior to deployment in production compensation environments.

Right to Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.


Return to Work — Restart

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Production Estimator

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong structural steel estimating fundamentals who enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with drafting, production, and project teams.

The role is approximately 60% estimating and 40% coordination/project support, including exposure to drafting and project coordination. While experience in modular construction is advantageous, we are happy to train candidates with solid structural steel estimating experience.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating (60%)

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and quantity take-offs from structural, fabrication, architectural, and engineering drawings.
  • Review project documentation and identify scope gaps, risks, and cost considerations.
  • Interpret shop drawings and fabrication details to develop commercially competitive estimates.
  • Prepare and manage tender submissions within required timelines.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Maintain accurate pricing records and estimating documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and pricing accuracy.

Coordination & Project Support (40%)

  • Coordinate with drafting, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure smooth project handovers.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding project scope, timelines, and technical requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing drawings and project documentation to ensure constructability and commercial accuracy.
  • Proactively raise questions, clarify project requirements, and identify potential issues before pricing.
  • Support project delivery by coordinating changes, variations, and documentation throughout the estimating process.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of estimating experience within structural steel, fabrication, construction, or related industries.
  • Strong experience preparing quantity take-offs and BOQs.
  • Ability to interpret structural, fabrication, and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using AutoCAD and/or Bluebeam.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Able to manage multiple estimates simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Drafting experience.
  • Experience supporting modular or prefabricated construction projects.
  • Exposure to CostX or similar estimating software.
  • Experience working on international or global construction projects (Australian experience is advantageous but not required).

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Proactive and naturally curious.
  • Comfortable asking questions and challenging unclear project information.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Detail-oriented with strong commercial awareness.
  • Collaborative and enjoys working across multiple teams.
  • Eager to learn new systems and processes.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote work setup
  • Company-issued laptop and phone
  • HMO from Day 1
  • Christmas Shutdown Leave (SIL)
  • Opportunity to work with an established Australian engineering company
  • Training and development in modular construction and company-specific estimating processes

Working Hours

  • Monday–Thursday: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM (AU Time)
  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM (AU Time)
  • 38 hours per week

jobs.excerpt: As a Cost Consultant at Turner & Townsend, you will be responsible for delivering cost planning and commercial management services across a range of workplace, retail, manufacturing, and technical projects for leading enterprise clients.
jobs.description:
As a Cost Consultant at Turner & Townsend, you will be responsible for delivering cost planning and commercial management services across a range of workplace, retail, manufacturing, and technical projects for leading enterprise clients. Drawing on your contractor-side experience in estimating, bid evaluation, and change management, you will provide an informed owner’s perspective, establishing robust cost positions, challenging commercial assumptions, and delivering clear, evidence-based advice that supports effective decision-making. Working under the guidance of a Senior Cost Consultant or Director, you will progressively take ownership of project cost plans and commercial strategies, developing the expertise and confidence to manage the commercial position throughout the full project lifecycle.


Responsibilities:

  • Prepare cost estimates and cost plans from concept through close-out for tenant improvement, remodel, and new build projects, including quantity takeoffs in Bluebeam and pricing in CSI MasterFormat structures.
  • Build and maintain parametric and hybrid cost models under senior direction, contributing clean, consistently coded data to the team's benchmarking library.
  • Lead bid leveling and GC and subcontractor bid analysis: qualify scope, normalize exclusions and allowances, and present a clear recommendation with the basis stated.
  • Test contractor pricing against takeoff-based estimates, historical data, and market intelligence, and explain variances rather than accept them.
  • Support value engineering by identifying scope and specification alternatives with quantified cost and schedule impact.
  • Administer the commercial position on assigned projects: review change orders for entitlement, scope, and pricing against the contract documents and field conditions, and recommend approve, reject, or negotiate.
  • Maintain the change, purchase order, and pay application registers, and reconcile pay applications to approved values and work in place.
  • Prepare cashflow, accrual, and estimate-at-completion forecasts aligned to the project schedule, and flag commercial exposure early.
  • Form and state a view on cost and risk with the reasoning visible: what the data supports, what it does not, and what you would need to be more certain.
  • Present cost and risk positions to client project teams in an observational, evidence-first voice, and escalate to senior colleagues when a position needs to be held under challenge.
  • Contribute project-level data and insight to portfolio capital planning and program reporting.
  • Keep register-driven templates, WBS, and cost code structures clean and consistent so program-level reporting and AI tooling can rely on them.
  • Identify repeatable analysis in your own work and, with senior colleagues, turn it into reusable templates and checklists.
  • Document methods, assumptions, and lessons so your outputs are reproducible by others.
  • Support onboarding and review for analysts, and model disciplined, well-organized delivery.
  • Apply client contract provisions and financial policies consistently, including SOX controls where applicable.
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, architectural engineering, quantity surveying, or a related field preferred, with three to six years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience in construction estimating and commercial administration, including quantity takeoffs, subcontractor bid leveling, subcontract and change order review, and submittal and procurement log management. Contractor-side experience on tenant improvement and renovation projects is directly relevant.
  • Working knowledge of CSI MasterFormat, change order mechanics, contingency, and basic cashflow forecasting; willingness to develop fluency in GMP reconciliation, escalation, and AACE estimate classification.
  • Ability to read and apply contract documents, including subcontract and general contractor contract provisions, and to verify proposed changes against drawings, specifications, and field conditions.
  • Proficiency in Bluebeam and Excel, including formula-driven estimates; familiarity with construction management platforms such as Viewpoint, Building Connected, or Procore. Interest in Python, BI tools, or AI-assisted analysis is a plus.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable leading meetings and driving follow-up actions with project stakeholders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to bring a question or exposure to a senior colleague.
  • Progress toward a professional designation such as CCP, MRICS, or PMP is encouraged.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $120,000-$150,000 USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our SRE organization in the US. In this role, you will help set the technical direction for how Ethos builds, runs, and scales production systems, from our core AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure to the internal platforms and toolchains that power our AI initiatives.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You will design and build critical infrastructure yourself, lead cross-team initiatives from conception to delivery, and raise the reliability bar across engineering by partnering closely with product teams, up to and including submitting PRs to their codebases. You will work alongside SRE leadership in the US and Bangalore to shape the roadmap, and you will be a go-to technical authority for reliability, scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Set Direction: Define and drive the multi-quarter technical strategy for reliability, infrastructure, and platform tooling, in partnership with SRE and engineering leadership and aligned with company OKRs.
  • Architecture: Lead the design of complex, cross-cutting infrastructure systems. Author and review technical specifications and architecture proposals to ensure consistency, resilience, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence Without Authority: Motivate product engineering teams to adopt reliability best practices, and act as a trusted advisor on production readiness when new services are designed and brought online.
  • Mentorship: Grow the technical skills of SREs across our US and Bangalore teams through design reviews, pairing, and code review, and help raise the hiring bar by participating in interviews.

Reliability & Performance Engineering

  • Service Standards: Establish the framework for how teams define, measure, and act on SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. Help teams instrument and monitor them.
  • Incident Excellence: Serve as a senior technical leader during high-severity incidents. Drive a culture of rigorous, blameless post-mortems and ensure follow-up work actually reduces recurrence.
  • Resilience: Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery, and failure-mode testing so our systems degrade gracefully and recover quickly.
  • Observability: Evolve our monitoring and alerting strategy so failures are detected before they impact customers and on-call is sustainable.

Infrastructure & AI Platform Tooling

  • Scalable Systems: Design, build, and operate our AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis).
  • AI Gateway & Governance: Architect and build governed gateways for AI model routing, including model access controls, audit trails, and secure data connectors (such as MCP) that prevent sensitive data exposure.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure infrastructure, including AI prototyping environments, meets security and regulatory requirements through automated scanning, PII guardrails, and scoped data access.

Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • FinOps: Lead initiatives to optimize cloud spend across the organization, including right-sizing, spot instance utilization, and cost attribution.
  • AI Cost Management: Design metering and budgeting for LLM token usage, and build cost-aware routing so workloads use the most efficient model for the job.
  • Visibility: Establish clear cost metrics and partner with engineering teams on architectures that are both performant and cost-effective.

Developer Productivity

  • Paved Roads: Build internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service platforms that make the reliable path the easy path for product engineering teams.
  • Toil Elimination: Identify systemic sources of toil across engineering and automate them away.

Qualifications and Skills:

jobs.title: Director, GTM AI Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Automatically included
    • All Roles: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
    • People Manager Roles: Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Sr. EHS Specialistwithin our EHSteam to help support our UK Spring business. Did you know we have been revolutionizing the sleep industry since 1883? That’s right! In fact, we hold the original patent on a spiral steel coil bed spring, filed way back in 1885. Since then, we have been an industry leader in guaranteeing you get the best sleep possible. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Sr. EHS Specialist you will have the opportunity to support and strengthen EHS’ performance across its European operations. Reporting directly to the Regional EHS Manager, this role works closely with site EHS representatives and site leadership to help improve compliance, reduce risk, support practical EHS solutions, and promote consistent execution of BU and corporate EHS expectations. The role requires strong EHS and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) knowledge, good judgment, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate complex or high-risk matters.

So, what will you be doing as a Sr. EHS Specialist?

  1. Leadership & Strategy
  • Support regional EHS plans and improvement activities aligned with corporate goals, BU priorities, and site-specific risks across Europe.
  • Serve as a regional EHS resource to site leadership teams on regulatory expectations, safety culture, employee engagement, and practical risk reduction.
  • Work independently to assess site needs, prioritize EHS actions, and recommend practical solutions, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Regional EHS Manager as required.
  • Maintain visible field presence during site visits and provide hands-on guidance to local leaders, supervisors, employees, and EHS representatives.
  • Identify EHS capability gaps at assigned sites and help strengthen local ownership, accountability, and execution.
  • Promote consistent adoption of corporate EHS expectations while interpreting country-specific regulatory requirements and operating practices.
  1. Incident Management & Corrective Action
  • Work collectively with site EHS representatives and site leadership to ensure incidents, near misses, and hazards are reported and investigated by the responsible site teams in accordance with company expectations.
  • Assist with incident investigations as needed, particularly for complex, recurring, or higher-risk events, by helping site teams evaluate facts, identify root causes, develop corrective actions, and consider the hierarchy of controls.
  • Analyze incident trends and recurring findings to identify systemic prevention opportunities and recommend practical process improvements.
  • Share lessons learned and support preventive actions across assigned facilities.
  1. Compliance & Risk Management
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable EU-level requirements, national implementing legislation, and country-specific environmental and occupational safety and health requirements.
  • Conduct and support site inspections and assessments related to workplace conditions, work equipment, machinery safety, chemical management, dangerous substances, occupational exposure risks, emergency preparedness, and EHS program implementation.
  • Interpret internal and external compliance challenges and recommend best practices to improve EHS processes, controls, and site-level execution.
  • Develop practical action plans to close regulatory, program, and risk-control gaps and monitor progress through sustainable completion.
  • Provide technical guidance for environmental compliance activities, including waste management, hazardous substances, air and water requirements, permits, regulatory reporting, sustainability data, and related inspections or records.
  • Support implementation of ISO 14001, ISO 45001, REACH, CLP, ATEX, machinery safety, work equipment, and other applicable EHS requirements where relevant to assigned operations.
  • Support emergency response plans, first aid, fire prevention, procedures, drills, and preparedness activities based on local site risks and regulatory expectations.
  1. Training & Development
  • Provide guidance/assistance to sites in coordination of required EHS training, including new hire orientation, annual compliance training, regional program rollouts, and site-specific safety topics.
  • Evaluate training needs based on incident trends, compliance findings, risk assessments, operational changes, worker feedback, site leadership input, and emerging regulatory expectations.
  • Coach site leaders and EHS representatives on safety communication, hazard recognition, worker engagement, accountability, and practical risk control.
  • Help strengthen site-level EHS knowledge and capabilities through education, coaching, technical guidance, and practical support.
  1. Performance Monitoring
  • Track, evaluate, and communicate leading and lagging EHS indicators, including injuries, near misses, hazard observations, inspections, audit findings, corrective actions, and training completion.
  • Analyze EHS performance data to identify trends, recurring risks, and improvement opportunities that may affect compliance, operations, projects, or service objectives.
  • Prepare routine and ad hoc reports that communicate trends, priorities, risks, and recommended improvement actions to site, BU, and corporate leadership.
  • Partner with site managers to develop measurable action plans, assign clear ownership, and monitor progress through completion.
  • Maintain accurate EHS documentation, records, reports, and system entries in accordance with company and regulatory expectations.
  1. Audits & Program Management
  • Lead periodic EHS audits and assessments to evaluate compliance, risk-control implementation, and program effectiveness.
  • Lead or support functional EHS projects with moderate risk or complexity, including regional program rollouts, corrective action initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts within assigned operations.
  • Help implement corporate EHS programs, tools, standards, and improvement initiatives in a way that fits regional and site-specific needs.
  • Follow up on audit findings and program gaps to ensure timely closure, effective verification, and sustainable improvement.
  1. Stakeholder Engagement
  • Partner with HR, Operations, Legal, Engineering, Maintenance, site leadership, worker representatives, safety committees, and external agencies to support EHS initiatives and practical risk reduction.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive EHS/OSH topics clearly and professionally, while helping build agreement on required actions.
  • Influence leaders and cross-functional partners to improve compliance, reduce risk, and strengthen EHS execution.
  • Support site engagement with workers, worker representatives, and applicable safety committees in accordance with local consultation and participation requirements.
  • Represent Leggett & Platt professionally during regulatory inspections, agency interactions, customer inquiries, and industry forums.
  • Support customer sustainability inquiries related to finished goods by coordinating EHS, environmental, and product-related information as needed.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Relevant Environmental, Health & Safety qualification, certification, or equivalent regional credential preferred, such as a NEBOSH, NVQ Level 5/6, or comparable qualification; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive EHS experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment with multi-site, regional, or cross-functional exposure.
  • In-depth practical knowledge of applicable EU-level EHS/OSH requirements, national implementing legislation, country-specific regulations, standards, and compliance expectations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of EU OSH principles and applicable environmental, chemical, machinery safety, work equipment, occupational exposure, waste management, and emergency preparedness requirements is preferred.
  • Demonstrates ability to identify known, potential, and emerging workplace hazards and recommend sustainable risk-reduction solutions.
  • Experience assisting with incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action development, and verification of corrective action effectiveness in partnership with responsible site teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex or sensitive EHS information, prepare reports, communicate expectations, and influence others without direct authority.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, languages, and geographically dispersed operations.
  • Ability to travel regularly within Europe as business needs require.
  • Specialized EHS expertise with strong field presence and the ability to build trust with site leadership and employees.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing operations, EHS controls, business priorities, and how EHS execution impacts operational performance.
  • Ability to guide others through complex problem solving using data, judgment, technical experience, and multiple sources of information.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, build agreement, influence action, and reinforce accountability across functions and cultures.
  • Ability to balance hands-on site engagement with broader regional priorities, project leadership, and sustainable program execution.
  • Ability to respond calmly and professionally to emergencies, regulatory inquiries, and changing priorities.

Things we consider a plus:

  • Experience with manufacturing-related EHS programs such as ergonomics, machinery safety, work equipment, contractor safety, chemical management, and occupational exposure controls.
  • Experience using cloud-based EHS/EMS software platforms such as Enablon, Benchmark Gensuite, or similar systems.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands-on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. What You’ll Be Doing:
