About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

As Manager, Sales Engineering, you will lead, coach, and scale a distributed team of Sales Engineers across multiple countries to drive technical wins and accelerate JumpCloud’s international revenue growth. You will bridge people leadership, commercial strategy, and technical judgment to solve complex identity, access, and unified device management challenges for modern IT environments. By establishing rigorous business and technical discovery, value-based demonstrations, and focused Proofs of Value (POVs), you ensure predictable deal progression and eliminate technical friction throughout the sales cycle. Additionally, you will optimize SE resource allocation across qualified opportunities and partner with Professional Services and Customer Success to ensure seamless implementation handoffs and long-term customer retention.

Employee Value Proposition

  • Purpose: Lead JumpCloud's front-line technical engagement, empowering global IT and security leaders to modernize identity and device infrastructure in an AI-driven era.

  • Growth: Expand your leadership footprint across multi-country technical operations, defining presales methodologies, coaching frameworks, and cross-functional strategies across Sales and Post-Sales organizations.

  • Motivators: High-autonomy leadership role at a hyper-growth open directory platform, shaping team culture, driving strategic enterprise deals, and influencing product evolution.

Major Performance Objectives

    Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

    1. Team Development & Quota Ramp: Onboard, coach, and develop a distributed multi-country SE team through structured call reviews and individualized development plans (IDPs), achieving 100% team ramp and quota attainment within the first 6 months.

    2. Technical Win Rate Improvement: Increase regional technical win rates by standardizing outcome-focused discovery, value-based demonstrations, and deal qualification criteria.

    3. Proof of Value (POV) Efficiency: Shorten average POV completion through agreed mutual technical success criteria and proactive blocker resolution.

    4. Multi-Country Resource Optimization: Design and roll out an SE resource allocation model across international territories, balancing technical complexity, language/regional requirements, and deal tiering to maximize capacity.

    5. Cross-Functional Alignment & Asset Reusability: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Product to achieve seamless handoffs, and introduce reusable demo assets and AI-assisted win/loss analysis to continuously elevate team effectiveness

Critical Subtasks

    1. Establish a recurring coaching cadence with weekly 1-on-1s, Gong call reviews, and demo simulations focused on business discovery and technical outcome articulation.

    2. Partner with Sales leadership to review pipeline health, assess technical risks early in the sales cycle, and ensure commercial alignment before technical progression.

    3. Develop a standardized POV execution framework featuring pre-agreed evaluation scopes, customer milestones, and formal technical sign-offs.

    4. Implement a dynamic SE assignment and scheduling workflow that accounts for time zones, regional nuances, and specialized product capabilities.

    5. Directly participate in high-value deal reviews, technical escalations, and executive customer discussions to secure strategic technical wins.

    6. Formalize seamless handoff documentation and technical validation reviews with Professional Services and Customer Success to guarantee smooth post-sales implementations.

    7. Analyze team performance metrics and win/loss data to identify curriculum gaps, institutionalize competitive battlecards, and adopt thoughtful AI tools for team productivity.

Required Skills and Experience

    Must-have functional skills:

  • Presales People Leadership: Demonstrated success in coaching, developing, and managing Sales Engineers or technical solutions professionals in a fast-paced environment.

  • Technical Discovery & POV Strategy: Proven expertise in coaching value-based discovery, solution design, and guiding structured Proofs of Value with agreed business outcomes.

  • Commercial & Resource Strategy: Strong ability to partner with Sales leaders on pipeline qualification, deal risk identification, and strategic technical resource allocation.


    • Preferred domain knowledge:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory Services (LDAP, Active Directory), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

  • Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) / Mobile Device Management (MDM) across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android ecosystems.


    • Tools or systems knowledge:

  • Industry Platforms: JumpCloud, Microsoft Entra/Intune, Okta, Omnissa (Workspace ONE), or Jamf.

  • Sales & Coaching Tech: Salesforce, Gong/Chorus, demonstration automation software, and modern generative AI productivity tools.


    • Behavioral or power skills:

  • Distributed Team Leadership: Exceptional ability to motivate, align, and maintain team cohesion across multi-country, remote environments.

  • Executive Communication: High-impact verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details and business outcomes.

  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: High-conviction operational mindset with the resilience to thrive in a high-growth, changing SaaS environment.

  • Years of Experience: 5+ years of presales sales engineering or technical solutions experience in B2B SaaS/IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of formal people management or technical team leadership.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of England. You must be located in and authorized to work in the England to be considered for this role.
Language:
JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

About the Role

Green Ocean Property Management is looking for an experienced Remote Maintenance Manager to lead and manage day-to-day maintenance operations across our residential and HOA/condo portfolio.

This role is responsible for making sure maintenance requests are handled quickly, vendors are managed well, costs are controlled, and residents, owners, and property managers receive clear updates.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, solve maintenance problems, build strong systems, and keep a large number of work orders moving without losing track of details.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily maintenance workflow from initial request through completion.
  • Review, assign, prioritize, and follow up on maintenance work orders.
  • Lead and support remote Maintenance Coordinators.
  • Coordinate with technicians, contractors, vendors, property managers, tenants, owners, and HOA teams.
  • Handle escalated or complex maintenance concerns.
  • Review maintenance requests and help determine the right next step before sending a vendor.
  • Monitor emergency and urgent maintenance issues.
  • Make sure vendors respond and complete work within expected timelines.
  • Review vendor quotes, estimates, invoices, and scopes of work.
  • Compare pricing and help control maintenance costs.
  • Build and maintain a reliable vendor network.
  • Track vendor performance, response time, quality, and communication.
  • Follow up on delayed or overdue work orders.
  • Keep maintenance records, notes, photos, estimates, and invoices organized.
  • Make sure residents and internal teams receive regular updates.
  • Identify repeat maintenance problems and recommend long-term solutions.
  • Create and improve maintenance SOPs, workflows, and escalation procedures.
  • Track maintenance KPIs such as open work orders, completion time, vendor response time, aging tickets, and cost.
  • Support after-hours and emergency maintenance processes.
  • Work closely with Property Management, HOA, Leasing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Provide regular maintenance reports and updates to leadership.

Qualifications

  • At least 3–5 years of property maintenance, facilities management, property management, or maintenance coordination experience.
  • At least 1–2 years of leadership or team management experience.
  • Strong understanding of residential property maintenance.
  • Experience managing a high volume of maintenance requests or work orders.
  • Experience working with vendors, contractors, technicians, and residents.
  • Good understanding of common property issues involving:
    • HVAC
    • Plumbing
    • Electrical
    • Appliances
    • Roofing
    • Water leaks
    • Mold or moisture concerns
    • General repairs
    • Preventive maintenance
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Excellent organization and follow-up skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple urgent issues at the same time.
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

  • Experience with property management software such as Property Meld, Buildium, AppFolio, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
  • Experience creating maintenance SOPs and workflows.
  • Experience reviewing vendor pricing and negotiating service costs.

  • Your experience managing and negotiating with vendors.

  • Faster maintenance response and completion times.
  • Fewer overdue work orders.
  • Better communication with residents and property managers.
  • Stronger vendor accountability.
  • Better cost control.
  • Clear and organized maintenance records.
  • Stronger systems and processes as the company grows.

Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Director of Clinical Psychiatric Operations at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is seeking an experienced, innovative, and operationally-minded Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) to lead our Psychiatry Practice Management team.

This role sits at the intersection of clinical operations, quality assurance, compliance, clinical excellence, provider operations, and product innovation. As a senior clinical leader supporting BetterHelp's psychiatric provider network, you will help shape how the daily behind-the-scenes operations evolve and how psychiatric care is delivered at scale through technology–keeping quality, safety, and regulatory compliance top-of-mind.

You are an experienced psychiatric clinician who understands both the realities of direct patient care and the opportunities technology creates to improve access to mental healthcare. You are obsessed with operational efficiency, systems that scale, and creating a white-glove work environment for our providers. You are equally comfortable consulting on complex clinical situations, analyzing operational data, improving processes, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and coaching team members.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace ambiguity, and are excited by the opportunity to build and scale psychiatric operations as BetterHelp continues expanding its behavioral healthcare services.

This role offers the opportunity to influence psychiatric care delivery for hundreds of providers and thousands of members while helping define the future of telepsychiatry.

What will you do?

Clinical Quality & Compliance

  • Lead a team who conducts documentation and quality audits, quality assurance initiatives, and support investigations involving provider performance, prescribing concerns, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance.
  • Help your team provide actionable, constructive, and clinically informed feedback to psychiatric providers.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Credentialing, and Patient Safety teams to ensure adherence to applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Stay current on evolving telehealth, prescribing, and psychiatric practice regulations and communicate relevant changes throughout the organization.
  • Identify trends impacting psychiatric providers and recommend operational improvements.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage and develop Psychiatry Operations team members, including Clinical Operations Managers, Quality Assurance Specialists, and Psychiatry Support Specialists.
  • Establish team priorities, workflows, performance expectations, and operational goals.
  • Coach and mentor team members through complex clinical and operational scenarios.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and development as the Psychiatry Operations function scales.

Operational Excellence & Provider Engagement

  • Monitor key performance indicators, quality metrics, provider engagement data, and operational trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Use data-driven decision making to optimize provider experience, member outcomes, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives involving psychiatric care delivery, provider support, quality assurance, and risk mitigation.
  • Help develop scalable operational processes to support future growth and expansion of psychiatric offerings.

Product & Innovation

  • Serve as a key clinical subject matter expert for psychiatric care delivery and medication management workflows. Partner with Associate Medical Director for thought-partnership.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, AI, and Clinical Operations stakeholders to identify opportunities for platform enhancements.
  • Provide clinical guidance on new products, tools, workflows, and technology initiatives impacting psychiatric providers and members.
  • Support implementation and adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled workflows and quality initiatives.

External Representation

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, and Public Relations teams as needed.
  • Participate in provider-facing webinars, training events, educational content, and media opportunities.
  • Represent BetterHelp's commitment to safe, ethical, and accessible psychiatric care.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain a small caseload of psychiatric clients on the platform (approx 2-3 clinical hours per week) to understand the lived experience of our providers.
  • Support insurance and payer-related quality initiatives as BetterHelp expands its healthcare offerings.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst About the role We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst


About the role


We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.


This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in SAP SD who enjoys understanding how a business works, talking to users, solving problems and finding practical ways to make processes better.

You’ll work closely with both business users and technical teams, helping to understand what people need from SAP and turning those needs into effective solutions. You’ll be involved in everything from day-to-day support and troubleshooting through to configuration, testing, process improvements, and new developments.


You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious, willing to learn and keen to broaden their SAP knowledge into other Logistics areas over time.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you'll be doing

  • Working with business users to understand their requirements, challenges and day-to-day processes.
  • Using your SAP SD knowledge to identify practical solutions that meet business needs.
  • Helping to map current processes and design improved AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
  • Configuring SAP and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
  • Supporting the resolution of SAP SD issues, working closely with both users and technical colleagues.
  • Helping to identify opportunities to improve existing processes and make better use of SAP.
  • Creating and carrying out test scenarios to make sure changes work as expected.
  • Supporting users through changes, including providing training and guidance where needed.
  • Working with colleagues and sharing your knowledge to help others develop their SAP skills.
  • Contributing to projects, enhancements and other SAP-related initiatives.
  • Being open to learning and supporting other areas of SAP and Logistics functionality as your experience develops.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Relevant hands-on experience working with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
  • Experience in business analysis, business solutions or a similar role.
  • A good understanding of business processes and how SAP can support and improve them.
  • Experience supporting users through business process changes or improvements.
  • Experience working with both business and technical teams to resolve issues.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to listen, ask the right questions and turn business requirements into practical solutions.
  • Experience creating and executing test scenarios.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical audiences.
  • A willingness to learn, develop and broaden your SAP knowledge.

An SAP certification would be great, but it isn't essential. We're also happy to support someone who is keen to work towards certification.


A degree or equivalent experience is preferred.


The kind of person who will enjoy this role

You’ll enjoy this role if you like getting to the bottom of a problem rather than simply fixing the symptom.

You’ll be comfortable speaking with different people across a business, from end users to technical specialists, and enjoy understanding what they need and finding a way to make things work.


We’re looking for someone who is approachable, curious and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership while knowing when to ask for help.


Things don't always go to plan in SAP, so being able to manage changing priorities, stay calm when there are competing demands and work through problems logically is important.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and grow with the role, rather than someone who already knows everything.


Where you'll work

This is primarily a work-from-home role, giving you the flexibility to work remotely while remaining closely connected with the wider team and client.

There may be occasional travel to client sites for meetings, workshops or other business requirements.

From time to time, there may also be a requirement to work outside standard hours, including occasional weekends, depending on client and project requirements.


Why join us?

This is more than a role focused purely on keeping SAP running. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with users, understand real business challenges and see the impact of the solutions you help deliver.


In addition, DXC offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


You'll also have the opportunity to develop your SAP skills, gain exposure to wider Logistics functionality, and build your experience across both functional and business-facing areas.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. jobs.excerpt: About the teamAs an SEO Product Manager on Zillow's Traffic team, you'll join the group that owns search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) across Zillow Group brands, including Zillow, Trulia, and HotPads.
jobs.description:
About the team

As an SEO Product Manager on Zillow's Traffic team, you'll join the group that owns search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) across Zillow Group brands, including Zillow, Trulia, and HotPads. Our mission is to protect and grow the organic visits that bring millions of people to Zillow every month, in traditional search results and in AI-generated answers alike. Senior product managers on the team own the strategy for each major area, and we partner closely with engineering, analytics, content, and marketing to find what moves visibility, prove it through rapid experimentation, and ship it at scale.

About the role

The SEO Product Manager turns the team's strategy into shipped, measurable results. You'll own a defined set of SEO surfaces and experiments within the Traffic portfolio, decide what to tackle first based on impact, and get it built, often by building it yourself with AI coding tools. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves to ship, wants to learn how every part of Zillow's organic growth engine fits together, and is looking for a clear path to grow into larger ownership.

You will get to

  • Own and grow a defined space within the Traffic portfolio (for example, new construction search visibility, landing pages, and calculators), prioritizing the work with the biggest impact on organic visits and AI visibility.
  • Run SEO experiments at a steady cadence, including internal linking tests and page-type experiments, and turn the results into clear recommendations and rollouts.
  • Build and ship with AI coding tools (for example, Claude Code): stand up landing pages, calculators, prototypes, and experiments directly, and partner with engineers when the work needs to go further.
  • Scale programmatic and community-driven pages, such as agent and professional directory pages with reviews and insights, forums, and local highlights.
  • Partner with our content lead on long-form content production and optimization, including automating the data inside content so it stays accurate and current.
  • Work with engineering to translate SEO requirements (crawling, rendering, indexing, structured data, and internal linking) into clearly scoped work, and verify that what ships does what was intended.
  • Measure what you ship using search, analytics, and AI visibility data, and share results and trade-offs in clear, concise updates.
  • Support teammates across the Traffic team where help is needed most, building a working knowledge of the whole system.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $128,600.00 - $205,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $122,200.00 - $195,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of related experience in SEO, growth, product management, or a closely related field (or 3+ years with a Master's degree), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Solid SEO fundamentals across both technical SEO (crawling, rendering, indexing, structured data, internal linking) and content SEO.
  • Working knowledge of generative engine optimization: you use AI search tools yourself and can explain what you have tested to get a brand surfaced in AI-generated answers.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding and building tools, used to ship real pages, tools, or experiments (not only to draft documents).
  • Experience designing and running experiments, such as A/B tests or SEO split tests, and measuring outcomes with tools like Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
  • A track record of owning work end to end: you can state the goal, the metric, what you shipped, and what happened.
  • Strong prioritization skills: you can pick the few things that matter most from a long list and explain why.
  • Clear, concise communication in writing and in person; you lead with the answer and make complex ideas easy to follow.
  • A people-first approach to SEO: you favor helpful content and sustainable practices over shortcuts.
  • Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Preferred skills

  • Experience at a large marketplace, aggregator, or publisher with a large programmatic page footprint (for example, real estate, travel, local discovery, jobs, or e-commerce).
  • Comfort with SQL and/or Python for analysis and automation.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and how modern websites render.
  • Experience with enterprise SEO platforms and AI visibility tracking tools.
  • Real estate or home-related domain knowledge.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Job Description

As a Senior Verification Engineer on the ASIC & Networking team, you support TeraWave's first in-house silicon program, which comprises a high-throughput modem and a DSP-intensive digital beamformer with first tapeout targeted for 2027. Verification strategy, methodology, and infrastructure are being defined now, and you help define them.

The work spans IP, subsystem, and full SoC verification, including CPU subsystems, performance-critical interconnects, security, high-speed peripherals, modem datapath and PHY layers, DSP and beamforming compute, and mixed-signal interfaces. You own a subset of this scope aligned to your background.

The team treats constrained-random simulation, formal methods, and processor-driven SoC testing as equal first-class tools, and is building an AI-enabled verification platform that includes LLM-assisted stimulus and testbench generation, automated regression triage and failure clustering, and data-driven coverage closure. Because none of this is inherited, the engineers who build these capabilities will own them — and grow with the program as it scales.

Background in wireless communications, modem, baseband, and DSP verification is welcome but not required. Architects and modeling engineers support your ramp, and verification judgment and system-level thinking are weighted above domain background.


Responsibilities:

  • Own verification planning and execution for complex blocks and subsystems, from test plan through sign-off.
  • Translate design specifications into verification strategies, measurable coverage goals, and early identification of high-risk scenarios.
  • Select verification methods for each problem, including constrained-random simulation, formal analysis, and directed testing.
  • Develop verification environments, reference models, scoreboards, protocol monitors, coverage components, and assertions.
  • Drive functional coverage closure, regression health, and sign-off readiness across simulation and formal results.
  • Build verification infrastructure, regression and CI systems, and reuse strategy across IP, subsystem, and SoC levels.
  • Apply and build AI-assisted verification capabilities for stimulus generation, regression triage, and coverage analytics.
  • Review testbench architecture and debug methodology, and mentor junior engineers in verification methodology.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum five years of professional experience in ASIC or SoC functional verification.
  • Hands-on expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM or formal testbench development and maintenance.
  • Experience with metric-driven verification for planning, assertions, and functional coverage closure.
  • Experience verifying complex digital control and datapath logic, including RTL and system-level debug.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in space-based communications, wireless communications, or modem, baseband, or DSP hardware.
  • Experience verifying LDPC, FEC, framing, or beamforming logic using bit-accurate reference models and fixed-point analysis.

jobs.title: Director, Global Market Access Strategy – Oncology
jobs.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary:

At Illumina, we are advancing the future of cancer care by unlocking the power of the genome. As the Director of Global Market Access Strategy –Oncology, you will lead global strategies to ensure patients worldwide have access to our transformative oncology testing solutions. Spanning hereditary risk testing, solid and liquid tumor profiling and monitoring, your work will help shape the future of precision oncology. This includes Market Access strategies for emerging oncology testing applications and indications (e.g. WGS, MRD, and early detection).

This is a high-impact, strategic leadership role that requires deep expertise in oncology diagnostics, payer engagement, and global reimbursement landscapes. You will collaborate across regions and functions to shape the value narrative, secure reimbursement, and drive adoption of our technologies in diverse healthcare systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead global market access strategies for Illumina’s oncology diagnostic solutions, including comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP), liquid biopsy, and companion diagnostics including unmet needs and evidence gaps. This includes both research kits and in vitro diagnostic Illumina products.
  • Partner with regional and country Teams to secure reimbursement and access in key markets, addressing diverse payer requirements and Health Technology Assessment processes. This includes participation in coalitions and industry groups to progress testing access.
  • Deeply collaborate with regional Government Affairs, Commercial, Medical Affairs and Marketing Teams to align and execute strategies to gain, protect and expand access to genomic solutions and emerging applications.
  • Define and communicate the clinical and economic value of diagnostics through compelling value propositions, evidence generation studies, and payer engagement.
  • Support and partner with the Global Health Economics and Outcomes Team on evidence generation strategies, including clinical utility studies, real-world evidence, and health economic and costing models tailored to oncology.
  • Monitor global policy trends, HTA requirements, and payer expectations related to oncology to inform strategic planning and product development.
  • Develop and update global value dossiers, reimbursement toolkits, and payer engagement materials to support local execution.
  • In collaboration with regional Market Access, build and maintain relationships with external stakeholders, including payers, HTA bodies, advocacy groups, and policy makers.
  • Maintain positive working relationships across key channels including customers, distributors, and core laboratories. Support Commercial and Marketing in engagements including meetings, conferences, and symposiums.
  • Provide strategic input into product development, launch planning, customer channel considerations and lifecycle management to align with access and commercialization goals. Provide guidance on realization of value of emerging Illumina technologies.
  • Lead Illumina product coding and pricing with appropriate regional and coverage segment bodies in collaboration with Product Management and other Illumina functions.
  • Ensure compliance with company, international regulatory, legal, and ethical standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (GC, MBA, MPH, PhD, or related) strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in clinical setting, market access, reimbursement, or health economics, with a strong focus on oncology.
  • Proven success in developing and executing global market access strategies in diagnostics, biopharma, or the payer setting.
  • Understanding of international reimbursement systems, HTA processes, and payer decision-making across major markets.
  • Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS), liquid biopsy, or companion diagnostics in oncology.
  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • Ability to manage budgets, vendors and consultants.
  • Passion for improving cancer outcomes through access to genomic innovation.

Our data intelligence team builds the data platform that meters and bills Akamai Cloud compute. We turn raw usage from compute instances, GPUs, storage, networking and AI inference into accurate/auditable billing data that customers/finance teams trust.

Partner with the best

You will join the Netstats Engineering team, which runs the large-scale usage and billing pipelines behind Akamai's products. In this hands-on engineering role, you will design pipelines, write production code, and own the correctness of data, directly driving revenue.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow, including backfills, late-arriving data, retries and SLA monitoring

  • Writing clean, tested, well-documented code; review others' work and raise the team's engineering standards

Do what you love

  • Demonstrate great programming skills in Python; ideally experience in Java or Scala
  • Have hands-on experience building large-scale pipelines with a modern data framework such as Apache Spark or Apache Flink
  • Have production experience orchestrating pipelines with Apache Airflow
  • Possess deep SQL experience: complex joins, window functions, query tuning, and data modeling for analytics

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role:

SoFi’s ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed.

As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise.

Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application-specific use cases and serving paths.

What you will own:

  • Data Trust architecture and strategy: Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long-term impact.
  • Declarative enforcement primitives: Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle.
  • Semantic context for analytics and AI: Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model-development function.
  • Reliability across batch and streaming data: Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka-based ingestion, and other batch or low-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery.
  • Mission-critical operational rigor: Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control.
  • Cross-organizational technical leadership: Drive multi-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar.

What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:

  • A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability.
  • Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement.
  • The platform provides production-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low-latency environments.
  • Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases.
  • Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence-gathering are measurably reduced.
  • Engineering and partner teams have adopted reusable standards and capabilities rather than creating isolated point solutions.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience & Education: 15+ years of software or data engineering experience (or 13+ years with a Master’s degree) with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating distributed data platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Platform Architecture Expertise: Deep experience designing horizontal, multi-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost.
  • Data Trust & Governance Depth: Practical, battle-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end-to-end lineage, and fine-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC).
  • Batch & Streaming Mastery: Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You know how to govern data in motion just as effectively as data at rest.
  • Hands-On Engineering: Mastery of one or more core programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing production-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD).
  • Cross-Organizational Leadership: A history of successfully driving multi-team, cross-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives.
  • Operational Rigor: Experience managing Tier-0/mission-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes.

Nice to have:

  • FinTech / Regulated Industry Experience: Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • AI Infrastructure Exposure: Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data.
  • Open Source Contributions: Contributions to relevant open-source data or metadata projects (e.g., Apache Iceberg, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Amundsen).

Position Summary

The Space, Cyber and Directed Energy Segment Vice President of Engineering serves as the senior engineering authority for the segment and is responsible for establishing the technical vision, engineering rigor, and product development discipline required to support a rapidly scaling portfolio of defense and national security programs.


This leader oversees a diverse mix of engineering services and product-based businesses, balancing lightweight governance for mature service programs with rigorous systems engineering, execution oversight, and technical risk management for high-priority product development efforts.

The role partners closely with the business leadership, CTO, program management, manufacturing, and growth teams to ensure engineering excellence, product commonality, rapid deployment capability, affordability, and successful transition from development into scalable production.


The Vice President of Engineering will help mature the segment engineering organization over time, including the future establishment and leadership of Chief Engineers aligned to business units and major product lines.


Position Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

  • Serve as the senior engineering authority across the segment portfolio.
  • Establish engineering standards, technical review processes, and development rigor appropriate for both services and product organizations.
  • Ensure technical execution aligns with customer mission requirements, affordability targets, schedule commitments, and long-term product strategy.
  • Drive engineering best practices across systems engineering, software, hardware, integration, test, cybersecurity, reliability, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Lead independent technical assessments and support executive decision-making related to technical risk, investment priorities, and program execution.

Product Development & Productization

  • Support the transition from bespoke engineering efforts to scalable, repeatable product solutions.
  • Ensure engineering organizations are structured to move rapidly while maintaining technical discipline and mission assurance.
  • Promote modular architectures, common product frameworks, reuse strategies, and product commonality across programs.
  • Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to improve producibility, reliability, and lifecycle affordability.
  • Drive engineering alignment with enterprise initiatives focused on speed, agility, commercialization, and rapid deployment.

Partnership with CTO & Enterprise Engineering Alignment

  • Partner directly with the CTO to flow enterprise engineering strategies, processes, tools, and governance into the segment.
  • Support implementation of common engineering frameworks, digital engineering approaches, model-based systems engineering, and enterprise product development standards.
  • Ensure engineering organizations adopt enterprise technology roadmaps and modernization initiatives where appropriate.

Talent Strategy & Organizational Development

  • Support engineering workforce planning, hiring strategies, succession planning, and capability development across the segment.
  • Monitor engineering staffing requirements against strategic growth objectives.
  • Help shape future engineering organizational structures, including eventual establishment of Chief Engineer roles aligned to business units or product portfolios.
  • Foster a culture centered on accountability, innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and mission focus.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Business Unit leaders
  • Program Management
  • Manufacturing & Supply Chain
  • Quality
  • Finance
  • Growth & Capture
  • Security and Contracts

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within defense, aerospace, space, directed energy, RF systems, autonomous systems, or related national security sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering organizations supporting both development and production environments.
  • Strong background in systems engineering, product development, and transition to manufacturing.
  • Experience operating within high-growth, fast-paced technology organizations.
  • Ability to balance technical rigor with speed and execution urgency.
  • Experience collaborating across enterprise engineering and business leadership organizations.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, customers, and technical teams.
  • Top Secret/SCI Clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance

Other Qualifications and Desired Competencies

  • Experience supporting defense acquisition programs, rapid prototyping efforts, and productized defense systems.
  • Familiarity with digital engineering, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and modern product development environments.
  • Experience scaling engineering organizations following acquisition or integration activities.
  • Background supporting products transitioning from R&D into operational deployment and production scale-up.

Leadership Expectations

  • Dedicated to Customers

About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry is seeking a Staff Product Manager to drive the cross-functional vision, strategy, and execution for our Mobile App (iOS & Android) within the Activate product organization. Your mission will be to evolve our Ancestry mobile app as a primary pathway for customer acquisition, conversion, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of DNA and Family History.


You will join a passionate, cross-functional team of PMs, designers, mobile engineers, data scientists, and user researchers. This role offers high organizational visibility and significant potential to impact company-wide conversion, subscription growth, and active engagement metrics.


What You Will Do...

  • Execute Strategic Mobile Priorities: Lead the cross-functional product roadmap for the Mobile App under the Activate team’s strategy, focusing on converting DNA-first customers into Family History subscribers and streamlining early user conversion flows.
  • Bridge DNA to Family History (FH): Build and refine intuitive, high-converting "Bridges" experiences (such as connecting DNA Matches and Origins to family tree building and record exploration) that capture user curiosity and drive conversion during key high-intent moments.
  • Modernize the Mobile Tech & Conversion Stack: Support the building and delivery of a native, frictionless mobile subscription and checkout architecture to improve user experience and lift conversion rates.
  • Drive In-App Subscriptions & Retain Early Users: Increase In-App Mobile GSA conversion volume, repeat 30-day product usage, and long-term retention by removing complexity and providing clear guidance for new registrants.
  • Lead Strategy & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish a clear product vision and 18-24 month roadmap for native mobile experiences. Align senior product leadership, engineering, design, marketing, analytics, and adjacent product teams (e.g., Engage, Preserve & Share, DNA Science) around shared outcomes and priorities.
  • Define & Monitor KPIs: Establish quantitative success metrics (In-Product Sign-ups, Repeat Usage, UX Score) and guardrail metrics to continuously evaluate and optimize native app performance.
  • Champion Customer Empathy & Continuous Testing: Leverage foundational user research, A/B testing, and behavioral data to solve core user pain points, eliminate cognitive friction for novice explorers, and advocate for the voice of the mobile customer.

Who You Are...

  • Experience & Scope:5+ years (or equivalent) of Product Management experience in consumer-facing (B2C) digital products, with proven experience building and shipping features for native mobile applications (iOS/Android).
  • Mobile Monetization Experience: Hands-on experience improving native mobile onboarding, paywall, or subscription flows to drive conversion.
  • Growth & Optimization Focus: Track record of optimizing conversion funnels, running experiments, and guiding users across multi-product portfolios or freemium/trial experiences.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Proficient with data analytics tools, defining feature-level KPIs, setting up A/B tests, and synthesizing quantitative data with qualitative research to inform roadmap prioritization.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated capability to collaborate effectively with engineering, design, and analytics partners, navigating technical dependencies and clearly communicating progress to product management leadership.
  • Technical Understanding: Good understanding of the native mobile development lifecycle, app store release processes, mobile UX patterns, and agile workflows.
  • Passion: Curiosity and passion for genomics, personal identity, storytelling, and family history.

Why Ancestry?

Join a dedicated team working to connect millions of people with their past and enrich their futures. At Ancestry, you will play a role in pioneering legal solutions that shape the consumer genomics industry. Your contributions will help foster and protect our workforce that is dedicated to helping our customers tell their own stories, while supporting a brand recognized and trusted around the world. We offer a collaborative workplace, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference.


Compensation

As a signatory of the ParityPledge in Support of Women and the ParityPledge in Support of People of Color, we are pleased to share the base salary range for this position: $140,000 - $157,000, with eligibility for bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision. Description du poste

Alphanumeric recrute un Spécialiste bilingue du service client dans le secteur pharmaceutique (anglais/français) - CDI à temps plein (télétravail au Canada)pour travailler à distance et soutenir l’une des plus grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques au monde. Vous fournirez du soutien relativement à des produits liés au diabète, à l’obésité, aux maladies rares ainsi qu’à la santé cardiovasculaire et hépatique.

Il s’agit d’un centre de contact à volume élevé, et les candidats sont sélectionnés pour offrir une expérience de service à la clientèle optimisée et personnalisée. Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et aux parties prenantes internes, en fournissant des réponses exactes, rapides et empathiques, tout en respectant les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité, de conformité et d’éthique.

La personne retenue répondra aux questions fréquemment posées et fournira des renseignements généraux conformes à l’indication approuvée. Elle devra également reconnaître les demandes d’information médicale et les acheminer au service approprié. Le poste exige également de savoir reconnaître les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes potentielles relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP), aux fins de documentation et de signalement.

Veuillez noter que nous ne pouvons embaucher que des personnes résidant déjà au Canada et disposant de documents entièrement légaux et valides les autorisant à y travailler.

Veuillez soumettre votre CV en anglais, puisque les gestionnaires responsables de l’embauche ne sont pas établis au Québec. En plus du français, la personne titulaire du poste doit maîtriser l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit, car elle communiquera avec des parties prenantes, des gestionnaires et des clients situés à l’extérieur du Québec, dans un environnement qui exige l’usage de l’anglais. Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes résidant dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou dans un fuseau similaire.

Conditions/offre:

  • Emploi: poste permanent à temps plein
  • Mode de travail: entièrement à distance au Canada, de préférence dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou un fuseau voisin.
  • Salaire : 50 000 $CA brut par année
  • Heures de travail: 40h par semaine
  • Quarts de travail: du lundi au vendredi, entre 9:00 et 20:00 dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est — quarts de 8 h comprenant une pause-repas d’une heure
  • Avantages sociaux : assurance maladie, soins dentaires et assurance vie après la période d’essai
  • Formation: 3 semaines de formation + 1 semaine de certification, soit 4 semaines
  • Horaires de formation: du lundi au vendredi 8:00-17:00 EST
  • Vacances: 2 semaines de vacances payées
  • Équipement: entièrement fourni par l’entreprise; aucun achat d’équipement n’est requis.
  • Il est obligatoire de résider au Canada et de disposer de documents entièrement légaux et valides (permis de travail, résidence permanente et NAS). Veuillez noter que nous n’offrons pas de parrainage.

Exigences:

  • Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais et du français (il est obligatoire de parler couramment les deux langues)
  • Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes possédant au moins 2 ans d’expérience dans le soutien de centres d’appels pharmaceutiques ou biotechnologiques, ou dans un environnement médical ou commercial
  • Une expérience préalable avec des produits pharmaceutiques dans un centre d’appels pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est souhaitée
  • Une expérience préalable avec Salesforce et Vonage est souhaitée
  • Une expérience antérieure en centre de contact constitue un atout
  • Passion pour le service à la clientèle, excellentes aptitudes relationnelles au téléphone et volonté d’exceller
  • Capacité à s’épanouir dans un environnement innovant et au rythme soutenu, tout en faisant preuve de souplesse, d’initiative, d’ingéniosité et d’efficacité

Qualités clés et responsabilités:

  • Répondre aux appels entrants généraux, aux clavardages et aux courriels des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des parties prenantes internes, de manière professionnelle et empathique
  • Répondre aux demandes générales des consommateurs et/ou des professionnels de la santé
  • Naviguer sur les sites et aider les utilisateurs à y naviguer
  • Utiliser différents sites et contenus afin que le consommateur ou le professionnel de la santé reçoive un service à la clientèle rapide, complet et professionnel
  • Traiter les demandes et les mises à jour concernant les excursions de température (p. ex., origine de l’excursion de température)
  • Reconnaître et signaler les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP)
  • Consigner les notes de dossier dans le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)
  • Soutenir le contrat, agir comme agent de liaison et représenter le client
  • Possibilité de quarts rotatifs et de soutien en dehors des heures normales

Compétences et aptitudes requises:

  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à établir et à maintenir des relations importantes avec les principales parties prenantes, par téléphone, clavardage ou courriel.
  • Excellente capacité d’écoute et empathie manifeste envers la personne aidée.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer et à distinguer différents types de questions liées aux demandes commerciales
  • Volonté d’apprendre à reconnaître les événements indésirables ou les plaintes relatives aux produits, ainsi qu’à les documenter et à les signaler
  • Capacité à traiter tous les canaux de travail : appels, clavardages et courriels
  • Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe, approche axée sur le service à la clientèle et orientation vers les solutions
  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement à utiliser de nouveaux systèmes et de nouvelles technologies

Compétences techniques:

  • Systèmes d’exploitation : Windows, jusqu’à la version actuelle
  • Outils Microsoft Office
  • Environnement matériel informatique : ordinateurs portables, ordinateurs de bureau et imprimantes
  • Outils de téléphonie, de courriel et de clavardage pour centre de contact — souhaité
  • Connaissance d’un système de gestion de la relation client — souhaitée

Autres exigences:

  • Capacité à rester assis pendant de longues périodes
  • Connaissances informatiques et matérielles de base permettant d’installer un poste de travail à distance
  • Connexion Internet filaire offrant une vitesse minimale de 15 Mbit/s en téléversement et de 15 Mbit/s en téléchargement
  • Disposer d’un espace de bureau privé et calme, sans interruptions, afin de mener des appels professionnels au nom d’un client.

jobs.description:
About Okendo

We believe happy customers make the best marketers.

That’s why we built Okendo – the customer marketing platform that creates stronger connections between consumers and the brands they love.

Using Okendo, Shopify brands can grow faster and more efficiently by cultivating brand advocacy and maximising lifetime value.

Our unified platform and unique suite of products for Reviews, Referrals, Quizzes, Loyalty, and Surveys is trusted by 19,000+ Shopify brands to turn one time shoppers into revenue-driving Superfans.

Position Summary

As an Enterprise Onboarding Manager, you will set Okendo's most strategic brands up for long-term success. You will own each launch from the moment the deal closes to the handoff to Customer Success: turning the brand's goals into a clear launch plan, guiding them through setup, integrations, and go-live, and making sure they see value quickly.

This is an individual contributor role. You will pick up the momentum Sales has built, and you will work hand in hand with Solutions Engineering, Support, Customer Success, and Account Executives. The first impression you create sets the tone for the whole relationship.

How you'll create impact:

Own the enterprise launch from kickoff to go-live

  • Be the dedicated lead for each new enterprise brand, from sales handoff to go-live, keeping the plan, timeline, and expectations clear
  • Turn each brand's goals into a launch plan across Reviews, Loyalty, Referrals, Quizzes, and Surveys, tailored to their business, tech stack, and retail calendar
  • Run several complex launches at once, clearing blockers early so brands go live on time and on brand

Design programs that deliver value fast

  • Advise each brand on how to set up their programs, and guide them through data migration, theme customization, and integrations with their tech stack, including Shopify, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Google, Meta, and Attentive
  • Work with Solutions Engineering on custom builds and APIs, writing clear requirements so the work lands right
  • Train brand teams to run their programs with confidence, and make sure every brand reaches first value by the go-live date

Partner across the business

  • Work with Sales before close on scope and timelines, and join late-stage calls where trust in our onboarding matters
  • Hand off each brand to Customer Success with a clear summary of goals, stakeholders, and next steps, and flag growth opportunities across the suite
  • Give Product feedback on gaps you see during enterprise launches, and partner with Marketing on customer stories

Keep raising the bar on how we onboard

  • Build templates, checklists, and playbooks for enterprise launches, so what works for you becomes how the team works
  • Become a deep expert on the Okendo platform and the ecommerce tools brands use alongside it, and share what you learn with the team

What we need from you:

  • 5+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management at a B2B SaaS company, ideally with ecommerce brands or marketing and retention tools
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder launches for larger customers, on time and to a high standard
  • Strong project management and organisation: you can plan, track, and prioritise many moving parts across many launches at once
  • Technical comfort: the words CSV, HTML, and APIs do not scare you, they excite you
  • Knowledge of ecommerce tech stacks and metrics, such as conversion, AOV, and repeat rate
  • Confidence working with senior marketing and ecommerce stakeholders, and the assertiveness to drive action plans to completion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and a resourceful, positive, resilient approach when launches get complicated
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify (especially Shopify Plus), Klaviyo, Google Shopping, and headless or custom storefront setups

1-Month Success Markers

  • You've completed onboarding, earned your Okendo Product Expert certification, and can confidently demo all five Okendo products
  • You've shadowed enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live and are running your first launches with support
  • You understand the ecommerce industry and the brands we work with well enough to hold a credible conversation

6-Month Success Markers

  • You've led multiple enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live, on time and to a high standard
  • Every launch has a clear plan, named stakeholders, a go-live date, and a clean handoff to Customer Success
  • You've built strong working relationships with Solutions Engineering, Account Executives, and Customer Success, and contributed templates the team is using

1-Year Success Markers

  • You consistently launch enterprise brands on time, and those brands describe the experience as smooth and well run
  • The brands you launched are healthy, growing accounts, with clear growth plans handed to Customer Success
  • You're the go-to resource inside Okendo for complex enterprise launches, and your playbooks are part of how the team works

Job title: Principle Regulatory Affairs Specialist – DACH

Department: Regulatory Affairs

Location: This role can be based remotely in Germany, with occasional travel to our Darmstadt office
