jobs.description:
Kinetic, a business unit of Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT), is a premier insurgent provider of multi-gigabit fiber internet, whole-home Wi-Fi, internet security, and voice services in 1,400 markets across 18 states in across the U.S.  Additional information about Kinetic is available at www.GoKinetic.com

About the Role:

The Manager – Held Order Management leads a team that manages consumer fiber orders returned from the field when issues prevent the installation team from completing the install. This is an order management and resolution role, not an inbound customer-care or call-center role. The manager ensures every held order is categorized and entered in the system within a 48-hour SLA, then project manages each order to the correct disposition—released to the field, completed, or cancelled. Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce is essential.

Work in this role moves across several connected systems every day. The manager and team use DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce as the primary tools to research, view, modify, and re-sequence orders, and MIROR to track workforce and order activity. They review OFS dispatch results and not-done reasons to understand why an install failed, check EPM for build status, notes, and forecast dates, and confirm completed construction or outstanding field work in Jobtrac. Status, aging, and trend data are pulled from Snowflake and Power BI and shared through Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. The manager makes sure the information in each system matches before an order is released, completed, or cancelled, and escalates conflicts between systems to the right owner. This position can be filled remotely anywhere within the country.

What You’ll Do:

  • Intake & SLA: Own daily intake of returned orders; ensure each is reviewed, categorized by root cause, and accurately entered in DCRIS/Salesforce within 48 hours
  • Order Resolution: Project manage held orders through disposition and closure; prioritize and escalate aging orders; keep customers informed of order status
  • Cross-Functional Accountability: Partner with Field Operations, Construction, Engineering, contractors, and the Operations Control Center to clear blockers
  • Reporting & Improvement: Report held-order volume, aging, and SLA results; identify repeat causes and build standard procedures to reduce held orders
  • People Leadership: Hire, coach, schedule, and develop the team; manage performance, attendance, timekeeping, and policy compliance with HR

Do You Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; 5+ years in telecom order management or service delivery; 2+ years leading people
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and order management/workforce systems such as DCRIS, Kinetic Salesforce and MIROR
  • Strong organization, problem-solving, and communication skills; able to manage high volume against strict SLAs

Even Better:

  • Familiarity with OFS, EPM, and Jobtrac (can be learned on the job); reporting tools such as Snowflake and Power BI
  • Fiber-to-the-home, buried drop, or MDU delivery experience; PMP or Lean Six Sigma certification

Performance Measures:

  • 48-hour SLA attainment
  • Held order volume and aging
  • Time to resolution
  • Order accuracy
  • Employee engagement and retention
  • Future-state (to be established): release-to-field, completion, repeat-hold, and cancellation rates.

Working Conditions:

Primarily office/remote-based with extended computer use; occasional travel and after-hours support during volume spikes. Uniti provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees.

Minimum Requirements:

College degree and 4-6 years professional level experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or 8+ years professional level related experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and professional level related experience required.

jobs.title: Interface Integration Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking a highly skilled Interface Integration Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure integrations between IAM platforms and key external systems, including ID.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a highly skilled Interface Integration Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure integrations between IAM platforms and key external systems, including ID.me, ServiceNow, and the ELK Stack. This role sits at the intersection of API engineering, identity security, and observability, ensuring secure, reliable data flow across identity verification, IT service management, and monitoring platforms in a federal environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement secure integrations with ID.me for identity verification using OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML
  • Develop and maintain ServiceNow integrations using Scripted REST APIs, MID Server, Flow Designer, and Integration Hub
  • Configure and manage ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log ingestion, monitoring, and alerting
  • Build and maintain REST APIs and middleware for cross-platform data exchange
  • Design and implement data mapping and transformation logic (JSON/XML) across systems
  • Manage integrations using iPaaS tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato)
  • Ensure secure data transmission using TLS/mTLS and compliance with federal standards (NIST, FedRAMP, FISMA)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration, API, and data flow issues across systems
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams
  • Collaborate in agile teams supporting development, testing, and deployment activities

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of experience, or a High School diploma or equivalent and 9 years
  • 5 years in integration engineering, API development, or middleware development
  • 2+ years of direct experience integrating IAM or identity platforms (ID.me, Okta, ForgeRock, Ping, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow to include integrations (REST APIs, MID Server, Flow Designer)
  • Experience with ELK Stack to include Logstash pipelines, Elasticsearch indexing/querying, Kibana dashboards & alerting
  • Experience working in agile/scrum environments
  • Experience in REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP protocols, webhooks, API gateways, Postman
  • Experience in Authentication & Security
  • Experience in Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Java, Shell/PowerShell
  • iPaaS Tools proficiency
  • Networking/Security experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with ID.me APIs and identity proofing workflows
  • Familiarity with SIEM tools such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Terraform)
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or Azure Government
  • Prior federal government project experience
  • Agile/SAFe experience
  • ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS-SecOps, CIS-EM
  • Elastic certifications such as Elastic Certified Engineer or Observability Engineer
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CySA+, or CompTIA Security+
  • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Developer, AWS Solutions Architect or relevant Azure certifications

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Pricing Manager
jobs.excerpt: GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management.
jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and operational execution — driving efficiency, scalability, and data integrity across the entire product commercialization lifecycle.

The right candidate brings both operational rigor and transformational vision — someone who can rationalize a complex SKU library, redesign product commercialization operating system using AI-powered automation, and build governance frameworks that enable faster, more precise market entry.Someone who is enthusiastic about managing projects but also willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work. A personable, determined individual who enjoys leading and facilitating cross-functional collaborations will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities:

Commercialization Process Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end commercialization process — from product definition through SKU creation to Launch— in partnership with Product Management, Corporate Systems, Deals Desk, Contract Ops, Order Processing, Revenue Recognition, and Asset Management.
  • Establish and continuously improve SOPs, tooling configurations, and business rules that reduce cycle time, eliminate ambiguity, and scale across GHX's expanding portfolio; maintain the commercialization playbook as the single source of truth for pricing, SKUs, and business rules.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate new offerings into sellable, billable constructs aligned to commercial strategy; serve as cross-functional liaison for complex SKUs and pricing decisions requiring commercial judgment.
  • Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, KPIs, and quality metrics for commercialization activities, delivering executive-ready insights on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on AI and ML capabilities in CPQ; proactively surface forward-looking recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.

SKU Management & Catalog Governance

  • Own the full SKU lifecycle in CPQ (currently Conga) — including creation, testing, release, modification, and deprecation.
  • Lead a structured cross-functional SKU audit; rationalize the catalog and present findings and recommendations to leadership; establish ongoing governance including intake/approval workflows, naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and hygiene reviews.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, and Sales to ensure every SKU maps to a clear commercial purpose, pricing strategy, contractual language, and business rules; develop a change management process that minimizes disruption to active quotes, in-flight contracts, and renewal cycles.
  • Own the AI and automation innovation roadmap for SKU and commercialization processes — identifying high-value opportunities and driving measurable reduction in manual processing time.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product Management and all partner functions, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, FP&A, Corporate Systems, and Revenue Enablement — aligning teams on process, tooling, and commercialization standards.
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and monetization model design; champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into commercialization health.
  • Coordinate launch readiness for new products and pricing changes, ensuring Sales, Deal Desk, and Contract Operations are prepared before market release; act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource for commercialization process questions.

Key Competencies:

  • Translates business objectives into commercialization strategies; anticipates downstream impacts of process, pricing, and catalog decisions on revenue recognition, margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Understands SaaS business models, subscription economics, and ARR/MRR dynamics; connects P&L awareness and process efficiency to growth acceleration.
  • Designs scalable, end-to-end commercialization processes with an automation-first, exception-second bias — comfortable operating from architecture-level design down to hands-on configuration and SOP documentation.
  • Uses quantitative analysis and operational data to identify problems, size opportunities, and evaluate trade-offs; designs reporting frameworks and dashboards that give leadership actionable visibility into commercialization health.
  • Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and communicates status proactively to executive, commercial, and technical audiences alike.
  • Builds trust across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology without direct authority; navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and persistence.
  • Anticipates resistance to change and designs enablement strategies that drive adoption; delivers results with speed and quality in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Actively explores and applies AI and automation to commercialization challenges; evaluates tools critically with attention to limitations, compliance implications, and auditability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in product operations, revenue operations, deal desk, commercial program management, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Conga (Apttus) — including product catalog management, pricing rules, approval workflows, and SKU configuration.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional process improvement or transformation initiatives with measurable business outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, error rate improvement, revenue acceleration)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready documentation, SOPs, and business cases.

  • Project management discipline: ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritize effectively under pressure, and deliver against commitments.

  • Willingness to travel quarterly for team meetings (approximately 10-20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with AI and automation concepts as they apply to commercial operations, quoting, or contract workflows.
  • Experience conducting SKU, product catalog, or similar rationalization audits in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Prior involvement in a quote-to-cash re-platforming or major system migration.
  • Proficiency with BI and analytics tools such as Sigma or Power BI for building commercialization performance dashboards.
  • Any of the following certifications:
    • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Conga CPQ Product Administration Certification (Level 1 or Level 2)
    • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager certification

Estimated salary range: $91,000 - $121,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. To view more details of our benefits, visit us here:

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

  • Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
  • Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
  • Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
  • Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.
This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.

Responsibilities

Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect’s cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.
Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.
Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.
AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.
Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.
DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.
Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.
Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform’s ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.
Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.
Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.
Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.
Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.

About You

You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.
You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Native-level Thai fluency (spoken and written) with professional working proficiency in English.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.
  • Depth in at least one technical domain: cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, or ML/GenAI.
  • Practical FinOps and cloud cost management judgment: the ability to explain cost-versus-performance-versus-reliability tradeoffs to both engineers and finance/leadership stakeholders.
  • Practical observability experience: monitoring, logging, and alerting, and an understanding of tools in the ecosystem such as Datadog, New Relic, ServiceNow, and cloud-native equivalents.
  • An automation mindset with coding or scripting ability, plus hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tooling.
  • Strong data analysis skills and comfort navigating large data sets and spreadsheets to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and reconciliation needs.
  • The ability to take complex pieces of technology and explain them in a simple, easy-to-understand way.
  • Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive-level prospects and customers.
  • Comfort working in a metric-driven environment, reporting on and improving business performance against monthly KPIs.
  • Experience working in an account-team model across multiple functions (AE, CSM, AM, TAM) and time zones.
  • Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Bonus Points

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Machine Learning) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.
  • Prior experience working with or alongside AWS partner programs (MAP, WAFR, GenAI accelerators) or within an AWS Partner / MSP / SI.
  • Background in FinOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
  • Experience with cloud cost management or cloud intelligence platforms such as DCI.
  • Datacenter and hypervisor experience (e.g. VMware) in the context of migration to cloud.
  • Experience with modern technical selling best practices, including trial, demo, POV, and RFP processes.
  • Contributions to open source, public speaking, community leadership, or internal enablement.
  • Track record of success in a fast-growing and scaling business.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ’apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it’s our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Personalized Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Personalized Support Engineer

About the job

The Personalized Support Engineer (PSE) is a member of the Global Personalized support team supporting our top tier customers. They are responsible for handling a variety of Twilio products while also working and collaborating with the Technical Account Managers (TAMs.) The Global PSE team advocates for our TAMs’ customers as if they are their own while providing 24x7x365 coverage, managing specializations and guarding the queue.

This position requires working in a shift, EMEA - 1300-2200 IST. We work 5 days a week, and could include one or both weekend days. (Tue-Sat, Sun-Thur, Mon-Fri etc)

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • BE AN OWNER: Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER SHOES: Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • EMPOWER OTHERS: Collaborate with your teammates, the Twilio Product and Engineering teams including filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Be ready to assist our customers when they need us. This position may require working an irregular shift, including the weekend/holidays (Shifts are subject to change based on evolving team and customer needs).

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Fluent in English language (both oral and written)
  • 2+ years’ experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Experience working with top tier customers.
  • Supporting customers with service level agreements (SLAs) of 3 hours or less, utilizing a ticket system such as Zendesk.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Advanced time management skills and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.

Desired:

  • Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products
  • Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, Airtable and other project tools.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues
  • Prior telecom (Carrier, SIP, PBX) including reviewing PCAPs/using Wireshark or messaging platform experience

Location

This role will be remotely based in India(Karanatka, Telangana, Delhi, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra)

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Product Commercialization Manager
jobs.excerpt: GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management.
jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and operational execution — driving efficiency, scalability, and data integrity across the entire product commercialization lifecycle.

The right candidate brings both operational rigor and transformational vision — someone who can rationalize a complex SKU library, redesign product commercialization operating system using AI-powered automation, and build governance frameworks that enable faster, more precise market entry.Someone who is enthusiastic about managing projects but also willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work. A personable, determined individual who enjoys leading and facilitating cross-functional collaborations will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities:

Commercialization Process Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end commercialization process — from product definition through SKU creation to Launch— in partnership with Product Management, Corporate Systems, Deals Desk, Contract Ops, Order Processing, Revenue Recognition, and Asset Management.
  • Establish and continuously improve SOPs, tooling configurations, and business rules that reduce cycle time, eliminate ambiguity, and scale across GHX's expanding portfolio; maintain the commercialization playbook as the single source of truth for pricing, SKUs, and business rules.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate new offerings into sellable, billable constructs aligned to commercial strategy; serve as cross-functional liaison for complex SKUs and pricing decisions requiring commercial judgment.
  • Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, KPIs, and quality metrics for commercialization activities, delivering executive-ready insights on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on AI and ML capabilities in CPQ; proactively surface forward-looking recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.

SKU Management & Catalog Governance

  • Own the full SKU lifecycle in CPQ (currently Conga) — including creation, testing, release, modification, and deprecation.
  • Lead a structured cross-functional SKU audit; rationalize the catalog and present findings and recommendations to leadership; establish ongoing governance including intake/approval workflows, naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and hygiene reviews.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, and Sales to ensure every SKU maps to a clear commercial purpose, pricing strategy, contractual language, and business rules; develop a change management process that minimizes disruption to active quotes, in-flight contracts, and renewal cycles.
  • Own the AI and automation innovation roadmap for SKU and commercialization processes — identifying high-value opportunities and driving measurable reduction in manual processing time.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product Management and all partner functions, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, FP&A, Corporate Systems, and Revenue Enablement — aligning teams on process, tooling, and commercialization standards.
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and monetization model design; champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into commercialization health.
  • Coordinate launch readiness for new products and pricing changes, ensuring Sales, Deal Desk, and Contract Operations are prepared before market release; act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource for commercialization process questions.

Key Competencies:

  • Translates business objectives into commercialization strategies; anticipates downstream impacts of process, pricing, and catalog decisions on revenue recognition, margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Understands SaaS business models, subscription economics, and ARR/MRR dynamics; connects P&L awareness and process efficiency to growth acceleration.
  • Designs scalable, end-to-end commercialization processes with an automation-first, exception-second bias — comfortable operating from architecture-level design down to hands-on configuration and SOP documentation.
  • Uses quantitative analysis and operational data to identify problems, size opportunities, and evaluate trade-offs; designs reporting frameworks and dashboards that give leadership actionable visibility into commercialization health.
  • Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and communicates status proactively to executive, commercial, and technical audiences alike.
  • Builds trust across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology without direct authority; navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and persistence.
  • Anticipates resistance to change and designs enablement strategies that drive adoption; delivers results with speed and quality in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Actively explores and applies AI and automation to commercialization challenges; evaluates tools critically with attention to limitations, compliance implications, and auditability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in product operations, revenue operations, deal desk, commercial program management, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Conga (Apttus) — including product catalog management, pricing rules, approval workflows, and SKU configuration.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional process improvement or transformation initiatives with measurable business outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, error rate improvement, revenue acceleration)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready documentation, SOPs, and business cases.

  • Project management discipline: ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritize effectively under pressure, and deliver against commitments.

  • Willingness to travel quarterly for team meetings (approximately 10-20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with AI and automation concepts as they apply to commercial operations, quoting, or contract workflows.
  • Experience conducting SKU, product catalog, or similar rationalization audits in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Prior involvement in a quote-to-cash re-platforming or major system migration.
  • Proficiency with BI and analytics tools such as Sigma or Power BI for building commercialization performance dashboards.
  • Any of the following certifications:
    • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Conga CPQ Product Administration Certification (Level 1 or Level 2)
    • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager certification

Estimated salary range: $91,000 - $121,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. To view more details of our benefits, visit us here:

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

  • Energetic and self-motivated; a team player who is also a proactive and creative problem solver

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce
  • Due to this role’s involvement in FedRAMP, all applicants must be a “US Person”

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara’s solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process
  • Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred
  • Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies
  • 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Fluency in English and German (spoken and written) is a mandatory requirement for this position

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Change management delivery experience
  • Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

Role Summary

The Provider Support Coordinator supports the Practice Access Management (PAM) team at the intersection of data quality and provider engagement. This role is equally operational and customer-facing: Provider Support Coordinators execute data and administrative workflows in Salesforce in addition to conducting structured outbound outreach to provider offices on behalf of BlinkRx.

PSCs are often the first point of contact a provider office has with BlinkRx, and play a critical role in establishing the foundation for PAM-led growth. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and process-driven, with strong communication skills and confidence engaging professionally with provider offices.

Data Quality & Account Management

  • Clean up records by fixing duplicate accounts and contacts, correcting associations, reassigning holding-account contacts, and ensuring proper account hierarchy.

  • Monitor automated workflows and alerts; investigate and resolve issues flagged by systems or the PAM team.

Provider Engagement & Outreach

  • Recognize when a provider shows interest or requires follow-up during outreach and document relevant context.
  • Ensure clear, timely handoffs to the PAM team with accurate notes to support successful engagement.
  • Reach out to existing accounts at key points in the relationship lifecycle to surface growth opportunities and keep account data current ahead of PAM follow-up.
  • Triage and resolve inbound requests from the pharmacy team that require direct outreach to HCP offices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred)

Preferred

At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Team

You will be joining the Fundraising Team, one of the most highly visible and client-facing parts of our application. We are responsible for the Omnigive donation form—the absolute bread and butter of our company. Because this form is highly interactive and critical to our non-profits' success, we rely heavily on vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, powered by a robust Ruby on Rails backend. We operate with a flat hierarchy, a fully remote team, and a deliberate choice to keep our tech stack simple, reliable, and powerful.

The Role: Engineer II — The "Task Finder"

At Donorbox, our engineers in this role are what we call "Task Finders." At the Engineer II level, you own a feature end-to-end under review, surfacing the work the ticket didn't spell out — as we put it internally: "Given I was asked to do this, I'll also need to do that." We don't just hand you a ticket and expect you to act as a pure order-taker — you directly contribute to our team's goals for the year.

What You Will Do

  • Drive the Omnigive Form: Build and maintain complex, highly interactive UI components using vanilla JavaScript, while seamlessly connecting them to our Rails backend.

  • Apply the "Omakase" Mindset: Solve problems with the framework rather than around it. You will write idiomatic Ruby on Rails code using ActiveRecord, controllers, and ViewComponents.

  • Champion Product Sense: Analyze requirements through a "Jobs-to-be-Done" lens. Before writing new code, you will ask, "Can the user already do this?" and actively consider edge cases and error states.

  • Collaborate and Ship: Balance the desire to ship quickly with the need to ship quality. You will review peers' pull requests with care, communicate blockers proactively in async channels, and default to safely shipping value to users.

  • Steward our Knowledge: Help maintain our institutional memory by writing clear PR descriptions, logging non-obvious decisions in commit messages, and updating internal documentation when you spot something stale.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong JavaScript Skills: Deep comfort with vanilla JavaScript, as it is critical for our main donation form.

  • Rails & PostgreSQL Proficiency: Ability to ship features in Rails without close supervision, including writing SQL beyond simple queries (joins, aggregations, and catching N+1 problems in PostgreSQL).

  • Quality & Testing: A strong habit of writing useful automated tests (we use Minitest) by default, including tests that would catch the specific bugs you just fixed.

  • Pragmatic Frontend Focus: Experience using semantic HTML, global CSS (via design tokens), and Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus) to build out interfaces where custom JavaScript isn't strictly required.

  • Independent Problem Solving: A track record of taking a well-scoped feature and driving it to completion, surfacing the adjacent work needed for a polished final product.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Ruby, Ruby on Rails

  • Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, Hotwire (Turbo/Stimulus), Semantic HTML, CSS (Design Tokens)

  • Database: PostgreSQL, Relational Databases, SQL

  • Testing: Minitest, Fixtures

  • Mindset: "Omakase" Rails, MVC, Object-Oriented Programming

Details

  • Fully remote based in Latin America
  • Salary: $52,200-$58,000 USD, depending on experience and location
  • This is an Engineer II role on our internal career framework — leveling here reflects scope and impact, not tenure

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included 🎉), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

The Application Process

We have 5 stages:

  1. Apply here and fill out our questions to tell us about you!
  2. Prescreen Call with the Talent Team
  3. Technical Interview with Hiring Manager
  4. Panel/Final Interview
  5. Background & Reference Checks

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply today and let us know why. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO)

Backpack Healthcare | Hybrid/Remote | Preferred: MD, GA, IL, MI, or VA

Build the Operating and Financial Engine Behind the Future of Behavioral Healthcare

Backpack Healthcare is on a mission to make high-quality mental healthcare more accessible to children, adolescents, young adults, and families who have historically been left out of the system.

We are a Medicaid-first, venture-backed behavioral health company delivering whole-family telehealth care across Maryland, Virginia, Georgia, Michigan, and Illinois. With 170+ clinicians, 219 employees, and more than 100 payer relationships, we are growing quickly while building a clear path to profitability.

We are looking for a Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO) who is ready to help build what comes next.

This is not a role for someone who wants to sit on the sidelines, analyze what happened, and prepare reports.

You will run the operating and financial engine of Backpack Healthcare.

You will own the numbers, own the outcomes, and lead the teams responsible for delivering both. You will work directly with our CEO and leadership team to turn data into decisions, decisions into execution, and execution into measurable results.

If you are energized by complexity, move quickly, love solving hard problems, and want to have a direct impact on the trajectory of a growing healthcare company, this could be the opportunity for you.

What You'll Do

💰 Own Financial Performance & Profitability

You will be accountable for Backpack's financial performance and the plan that gets us to sustainable profitability.

  • Own budgeting, forecasting, monthly close, financial reporting, and GAAP-compliant financial operations.

  • Build and manage the company's operating model, unit economics, and financial planning processes.

  • Translate financial data into clear operating decisions and actionable priorities.

  • Establish the financial discipline, visibility, and accountability required to scale.

  • Serve as a primary financial voice to our board and investors.

  • Present company performance, forecasts, risks, opportunities, and the path to profitability with confidence.

  • Partner with the CEO on fundraising, including financial modeling, investor materials, diligence, and financing negotiations.

💵 Own Revenue Cycle & Payer Economics

Revenue cycle isn't something you'll review from a distance. You'll own the results.

  • Take executive ownership of billing, collections, and revenue cycle performance across all states and payers.

  • Drive measurable improvements in clean claims, denials, days in A/R, and cash collections.

  • Analyze payer performance, reimbursement trends, and operational leakage.

  • Partner with Growth and Partnerships on Medicaid and MCO pricing, bids, and rate negotiations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve reimbursement, margin, and cash flow.

🤝 Make Every Direct Contract Work

Every contract needs to make business sense.

  • Model the economics and expected margin of direct contracts before they are signed.

  • Build the operational and financial plan required for successful implementation.

  • Establish staffing, onboarding, billing, and KPI requirements before launch.

  • Track actual performance against projected economics after launch.

  • Conduct post-launch reviews and take action when contracts miss targets — whether that means fixing operations, repricing, or renegotiating.

⚙️ Lead Business Operations

You will connect the dots across the organization and ensure our systems actually work together.

Your scope will include business operations, PMO, strategy and operations, credentialing, and care coordination.

  • Establish clear KPIs for each function and review performance on a consistent cadence.

  • Hold leaders accountable for measurable outcomes.

  • Build scalable processes that support multi-state growth.

  • Help prepare the organization for new market launches and expansion.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and eliminate them at the system level.

  • Ensure that referrals, hiring, credentialing, scheduling, billing, contracts, and cash work together as one operating system.

👥 Lead People & Administration

  • Provide executive oversight of the HR function, including talent, compensation, benefits, and workforce planning.

  • Partner with leadership to ensure we have the right people, structure, and accountability to support growth.

  • Manage critical vendor relationships and contracts.

  • Build an environment where leaders understand their numbers, own their outcomes, and follow through.

🛡️ Own Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational and financial compliance with Medicaid requirements, state regulations, HIPAA, and applicable accounting standards.

  • Identify risks before they become problems.

  • Bring solutions and action plans — not simply flags.

  • Build processes that make compliance sustainable as Backpack scales.

The Kind of Leader Who Will Thrive Here

We are looking for an operator, not simply an executive with an impressive résumé.

You act.

You see a problem on Monday and have a plan moving by Tuesday. You don't wait for perfect information or endless consensus.

You hold people accountable.

You establish clear expectations, inspect results, have direct conversations when targets are missed, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

You live in the KPIs.

You know the daily, weekly, and monthly metrics that drive the business. You use them to make decisions — not decorate PowerPoint slides.

You operate with urgency.

In healthcare, delays have consequences. A slow hire, delayed credentialing, missed claim, or inefficient workflow can affect both the company's financial performance and a family's ability to access care.

You're relentlessly curious.

You don't make assumptions. You ask why until you understand the root cause.

You are willing to get into the claims data, understand payer mix, examine workflows, and pressure-test the economics of a contract yourself before making a recommendation.

You think in systems.

This is a requirement.

You understand how referrals connect to intake, how hiring connects to capacity, how credentialing connects to revenue, how scheduling connects to utilization, and how billing connects to cash.

You don't patch symptoms. You fix systems.

You are an AI-native operator.

You see technology and AI as force multipliers.

Your first instinct is to ask:

Can we automate this? Can we build it? Can AI do this faster or better?

You use AI yourself to move faster, analyze information, and make better decisions. Backpack is building an AI-enabled data environment where leaders can access and interrogate company data through simple prompts — and we expect this role to take full advantage of it.

You can move between the weeds and the big picture.

One day you may be digging into a claims report or contract margin. The next, you're presenting a profitability strategy to the board.

You are equally comfortable doing the analysis yourself and stepping back to determine the strategic move.

You can keep up.

You'll work alongside a CEO who understands clinical operations, recruiting, forecasting, revenue cycle, growth, and the data connecting them.

You will be expected to bring answers, challenge assumptions, move quickly, and continuously raise the bar.

You are comfortable in the investor room.

You can confidently represent the business to our board and investors.

You know the numbers. You understand the story behind them. You can defend the plan, answer difficult questions, communicate risks honestly, and build confidence in where the company is going.

You don't take direct feedback personally.

This is a high-accountability environment.

You will receive direct feedback and be expected to give it in return. You can separate ego from outcomes, absorb tough feedback without becoming defensive, push back thoughtfully with data, and keep moving forward.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • MBA or CPA strongly preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive finance and operations leadership experience, including at least 5 years in healthcare.

  • Hands-on experience with Medicaid reimbursement and revenue cycle management; behavioral health experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated success helping a growth-stage or venture-backed company move toward profitability.

  • Experience presenting directly to boards and investors.

  • Experience supporting at least one institutional fundraising round.

  • Multi-state healthcare operations experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated success redesigning financial and operational processes end to end.

  • Proven ability to build cultures of accountability and consistently hit measurable targets.

  • Strong financial modeling, analytical, strategic, and operational skills.

  • Genuine commitment to expanding access to behavioral healthcare for underserved children and families.

What We Offer

Base Salary: $225,000–$300,000 annually

Plus:

  • Performance bonus tied to measurable KPI outcomes

  • Exceptional equity package

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Opportunity to directly influence the growth and trajectory of a venture-backed healthcare company

  • The chance to help expand access to behavioral healthcare for children and families who need it most

Why Backpack?

At Backpack Healthcare, we believe everyone carries an invisible backpack filled with experiences, stress, trauma, and challenges that others may not see.

Our job is to help make that backpack a little lighter.

As our COFO, you'll have the opportunity to build the systems, financial foundation, and operational infrastructure that allow us to reach more families — while helping build a company that is financially strong enough to serve them for the long term.

If you're looking for a traditional CFO seat, this probably isn't it.

If you're looking for a role where you can build, operate, challenge, solve, and make a measurable impact every day, we'd love to meet you.

Join Backpack Healthcare and help keep the financial foundation strong behind the work we do every day. 🎒

Backpack Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that the strength of our care depends on the diversity and wellbeing of our team. We celebrate differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other traits that make each person unique. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply for any position for which they are qualified and to bring their unique perspectives, experiences, and talents to our team.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of platform engineering and developer experience (DevEx). jobs.description:
Remote, U.S.-based · $90,000 OTE ($60,000 base + $30,000 variable) · Launch your sales career

Most sales calls sell software. Yours will help protect students. The Securly safetyOS™ keeps 20M+ students safe across 20,000+ schools and is credited with helping save 2,400+ student lives, and every district we reach starts with a conversation a BDR opened. If you love the phone, thrive on activity, and want work that matters, this is the role.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: you'll connect schools with the platform that keeps their students safe online, in class, and in the halls
  • A real ramp: structured onboarding and weekly coaching, built for experienced SDRs and career-changers alike
  • Room to grow: we promote from within, and many of our Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leaders started as BDRs
  • Strong pay and benefits: $90,000 OTE, top-tier health coverage, unlimited PTO, and a $1,000 learning stipend
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere in the U.S. with a team that's 82% engaged

The role

You'll own the top of our sales funnel: finding, qualifying, and starting conversations with school districts through cold calls, email, and LinkedIn. You'll introduce district leaders to the Securly safetyOS™, the gold standard for K-12 digital safety and critical IT infrastructure, and hand qualified opportunities to our Account Executives.

You'll report to the Director of Business Development and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and RevOps.

What you'll do:

  • Reach out: run high-volume, multi-touch outreach by phone, email, and LinkedIn to K-12 decision-makers
  • Qualify: assess inbound and outbound leads for interest, urgency, and fit
  • Tell the story: share outcomes, customer stories, and market data that show why safetyOS matters
  • Handle objections: listen first and tailor each conversation to what the district cares about
  • Keep it clean: track your work in Salesforce and Outreach.io, using GovSpend and AI Gems for research
  • Hand off well: pass qualified meetings to Sales smoothly, in partnership with Marketing and RevOps
  • Keep improving: use coaching, data, and your peers to get sharper every week

What success looks like

You'll get a structured ramp with coaching at every stage. The milestones below show what the work typically looks like as you build up.

First 30 days

  • Learn the Securly safetyOS™, who we sell to, and how we talk about it, with hands-on coaching
  • Start daily outreach: typically 50–100 calls and 50–200 emails
  • Research your territory and add new prospects to Salesforce every week

Days 60–90

  • Hold 10–25+ meaningful conversations a week with K-12 decision-makers, such as Directors of Technology, IT leaders, superintendents, and district and school administrators
  • Book qualified meetings consistently each month as your pipeline builds
  • Create 8–15+ new sales opportunities a month

By the 6-month mark

  • Run and sharpen outbound prospecting across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Use coaching, peer feedback, and your own metrics to keep improving

12 months

  • Consistently meet or exceed your pipeline ($) and quota goals
  • Share what works and help onboard new BDRs
  • Start mapping your next step toward AE or another role in Sales, Customer Success, or adjacent teams

Milestones are typical examples, not fixed requirements. Specific goals are set by your manager and may change based on territory, season, and business needs.

Who we're looking for

Great backgrounds for this role include:

  • Early-career sales: you've worked as an SDR/BDR or in another high-activity outbound role and want to grow in K-12 EdTech. SaaS or EdTech experience is preferred.
  • K-12 educators moving into sales: you're a teacher or school staff member who wants to learn sales and has done sales or sales-like work, ideally with high-volume phone outreach.

Whatever your background, you'll bring:

  • Comfort with high-volume phone calls and outreach, and the drive to keep going after a no
  • Active listening and the ability to ask good questions to engage and qualify prospects
  • The organization to manage a daily cadence and keep clean records (Salesforce and Outreach.io experience is a plus)
  • Curiosity to research prospects and personalize your outreach
  • K-12 education and/or EdTech experience, strongly preferred

What sets you apart:

  • Communication: clear, confident, and adaptive, both verbal and written
  • Growth mindset: you're coachable and treat every call as a chance to get better
  • Prioritization: strong time management and focus on what moves pipeline
  • Rapport: the ability to build trust with IT leaders and K-12 educators
  • AI fluency: comfort using AI tools to research prospects and personalize outreach
  • Mission: a passion for student safety and wellness

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. If you have the drive and the core skills, we want to hear from you.

A realistic look at the job

This is a high-volume, phone-first role. Most days are a steady rhythm of calls, emails, and LinkedIn touches, and many of those won't connect or will end in a no. The reps who thrive here treat that as part of the game, track their numbers, and use coaching to get a little sharper every week. When it clicks, you're booking meetings with district leaders who make decisions about keeping students safe.

This role is fully remote and U.S.-based, No Travel, not offering Visa sponsorship

Where this role leads

We promote from within, and many of our Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leaders started as BDRs. From here, the typical path is Account Executive, with options in Customer Success and other adjacent teams.

Compensation and benefits

Total compensation: $60,000 base + $30,000 variable = $90,000 OTE

  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO plus a paid year-end shutdown
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Free 24/7 confidential mental health counseling and wellness tools
  • $1,000 annual learning stipend
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching

About Securly
