jobs.excerpt: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges.  We challenge our limits.
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Director, Customer Success is accountable for leading a Technical Account Management (TAM) organization, which is responsible for the retention and health of some of NiCE’s largest, most strategic customers by delivering strong post-sale outcomes. Your mission: deliver measurable value, accelerate adoption of our cloud-native, AI powered platform and drive long-term customer success, retention and growth.

Leading a team of 10-15 TAMs, the Director enables the team achieve their goals of consumption and adoption, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), and NPS, while contributing to ARR growth shared with Sales, as well as industry-leading customer satisfaction, reference-ability, and retention.

This is a customer-facing position chartered with engaging customer executives and senior stakeholders as a trusted strategic advisor. The Director will be responsible for both technical and business outcomes including managing customer expectations and satisfaction, coaching and mentoring TAMs, coordinating inter-departmental activities within NiCE (Sales, Renewals, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Billing), ensuring account data in Salesforce and Gainsight is reliable and current, and other tasks related to the success of the team and its customers.

How will you make an impact?

  • Provide leadership to your TAM organization, including managers and individual contributors, through coaching, feedback, development goals, and performance management
  • Own the retention outcome (GRR) for the TAM portfolio: ensure risks are identified early and tracked in Salesforce/Gainsight with a documented path to save and at least weekly updates; ensure TAMs deliver accurate renewal and compression risk forecasts and proactively trigger renewal engagement; and partner with Renewal Managers (RAMs), who own renewal negotiation and execution
  • Own customer satisfaction (NPS) for the portfolio, personally leading the action-plan discussion with the client where poor responses are received
  • Drive consumption, adoption, and value realization across the book of business, ensuring TAMs are equipped with adoption data, solution knowledge, and the required certifications.
  • Enable TAMs to develop and execute strategic success plans in partnership with our clients with clear goals, timelines, and success criteria.  
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers
  • Escalate, resolve, and communicate client risks, blockers, and feedback to relevant NiCE stakeholders. 
  • Manage the assignment of accounts within your book of business
  • Own operating cadence, performance reporting, and forecasting for the organization’s KPIs (consumption/adoption, GRR, NPS, and shared ARR growth), reporting results to executive leadership
  • This position requires travel (up to 25%)

Have you got what it takes?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Information Systems or related field or equivalent work experience required.
  • 10+ years experience in customer success, technical account management, call/contact center and/or service delivery
  • 10+ years of Enterprise (Fortune 500) experience in Customer Success or Service Management
  • 5+ years of experience with NiCE CXone or comparable platforms (Genesys, Five9, Talkdesk, Amazon Connect etc.).
  • 3+ years experience in building high performance remote teams
  • Strong executive presence and a proven ability to build multi-threaded, executive-level relationships and to lead difficult conversations and escalations with composure
  • Strong analytical and data fluency, with experience using consumption, adoption, health, and renewal data (e.g., Salesforce and Gainsight) to forecast retention, manage risk and steer the business
  • Expertise in contact center operations, cloud migration, and AI/automation adoption; ability to connect NiCE capabilities to customer business outcomes, success plans, and quantified realized value / ROI
  • Strong understanding of NiCE CXone architecture, tools (ACD, WFO, WEM, Enlighten AI, Analytics), and integration frameworks. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in matrixed environments and manage multiple competing priorities.
  • A track record of owning measurable retention, adoption, and satisfaction outcomes (GRR, NPS, consumption) and partnering effectively with Sales and Renewals teams

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.

This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

Overview

The Senior Director of AI will be a pivotal leader within our cutting-edge humanoid robotics company, driving the strategic direction and execution of all artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. This role requires a knowledgeable technologist and a skilled manager capable of championing and leading our existing high-performing team to develop the AI foundation for the next generation of humanoid robots. The successful candidate will be instrumental in defining the AI architecture, ensuring ethical implementation, and delivering robust, real-time AI capabilities that enable our robots to interact intelligently and safely with the world.

Core Responsibilities and Deliverables

Strategic Leadership and Vision

  • Define and champion the overall AI strategy and roadmap in alignment with the company's product vision and business goals.
  • Lead the selection and integration of advanced machine learning models, algorithms, and deep learning techniques relevant to embodied AI (e.g., perception, manipulation, natural language understanding).
  • Foster a culture of innovation, rigorous research, and responsible AI development that supports the team's ongoing success.
  • Ensure that all AI systems adhere to the highest standards of safety, privacy, and ethical guidelines.
  • Partner with Hardware and Robot Software leadership to ensure the sensor suite and embedded compute are optimized for current and future AI model architectures.

Technical Execution and Development

  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of on-robot and cloud-based AI systems, leveraging the existing team's expertise.
  • Establish MLOps best practices for efficient model training, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Drive research into novel AI solutions for complex robotics challenges, such as real-time planning, human-robot interaction, and adaptive motor control.
  • Deliver production-ready AI models that meet performance, latency, and reliability requirements for commercial deployment.
  • Spearhead the Sim2Real strategy, utilizing physics-based simulation (e.g., MuJoCo, Isaac Sim) to train robust policies that transfer seamlessly to hardware.
  • Accelerate our data flywheel strategy to combine teleoperation, synthetic data, and fleet learning to expand the fleet performance and reliability.

Team Building and Hiring

  • Champion the existing team's talent and represent their needs to senior leadership.
  • Develop a comprehensive hiring plan to staff and scale the AI team, including defining required roles (e.g., ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Researchers).
  • Lead recruitment, mentorship, and career development for all members of the AI team.
  • Manage the budget allocated for team salaries, equipment, and necessary infrastructure.

Resourcing and Budgeting

  • Forecast and manage the budget for cloud computing resources (GPUs, TPUs) necessary for large-scale model training and experimentation.
  • Secure and allocate funding for specialized datasets and data annotation services.
  • Evaluate and procure necessary software licenses and tools for AI development and simulation.
  • Regularly report on expenditure and resource utilization to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in AI/ML, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying real-time AI solutions for robotics, autonomous systems, or other mission-critical applications.
  • Strong expertise in core AI domains, including computer vision, reinforcement learning, and large language models (LLMs) applied to robotics.
  • Proven track record of managing significant technical budgets and scaling high-performance engineering and research teams.
  • Experience deploying models on resource-constrained edge devices, balancing inference speed, power consumption, and thermal limits.

This is a fully remote role with the option to work hybrid if a commutable distance from our Salem, OR, Pittsburgh, PA, or Fremont, CA offices.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Base Salary Range
$257,000—$402,000 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

  • 401(k) Plan:Includes a 6% company match.
  • Equity:Company stock options.
  • Insurance Coverage:100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.
  • Benefit Start Date:Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.
  • Well-Being Support:Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Time Off:
    • Exempt Employees:Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown.
    • Non-Exempt Employees:10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.
  • On-Site Perks:Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.
  • Parental Leave:Generous paid parental leave programs.
  • Work Environment:A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.
  • Growth Opportunities:Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.
  • Relocation Assistance:Provided for eligible roles.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. About the Team

The Data & Analytics team is building Life360's next-generation data platform — powering real-time decision-making, experimentation, ML, and large-scale analytics. We operate at significant scale and complexity in a high-ambiguity environment, and we expect engineers to own problems, drive clarity, and raise the bar across the org.

We're looking for a high-intensity engineer who wants to envision, design, and build high-impact data products with cutting-edge tools — all while keeping our members ahead of the metrics. You'll become the go-to person for data products across the business, joining a collaborative team that communicates openly, celebrates wins together, and is committed to helping everyone do their best work.

About the Job

At Life360, we collect a lot of data: tens of billions of unique location points, tens of billions of user actions, billions of miles driven every single month, and so much more. As a Senior Data Engineer II, you will enhance and maintain our data processing and storage pipelines for a robust and secure data lakehouse. We're looking for a strong engineering background — and just as important, a genuine desire to take ownership and make our data systems world class.

The US-based salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,500. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, distributed data pipelines and systems — from ingestion through ELT to storage — supporting streaming and batch processing for real-time analytics, ML, and experimentation.
  • Automate, test, and harden data workflows to ensure reliability at scale.
  • Architect logical and physical data models that meet evolving business needs.
  • Build and maintain features for ML models.
  • Collaborate with product, analytics, and data science teams to turn data into value.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience working with high volume data infrastructure.
  • Deep expertise with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform (Databricks preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar also considered) on a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Proficient in Python and SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt.
  • Experience with large-scale data processing using Spark and/or Presto/Trino.
  • Strong grasp of data modeling, partitioning strategies, storage formats, and analytical workload optimization.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging LLMs for code generation, analysis, and related work — including reviewing AI-generated output with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, and owning it as your own.
  • Experience with modern data engineering tooling — orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, DABs).
  • BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering (Computer, Electrical, or Software), or a related quantitative field.

AI-Native Expectations

  • The team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing — owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with an experimentation framework.
  • Experience designing and maintaining real-time streaming architectures.

Our Benefits

  • Competitive pay and benefits
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Flexible PTO, 12 company-wide days off throughout the year
  • Winter and Summer Weeklong Synchronized Company Shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership for your preferred circle
  • Free Tile Products

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

  • Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.
  • Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.
  • Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.
  • Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.
  • Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.
  • Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).
  • Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.
  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.
  • A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.
  • Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.
  • Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.
  • A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

Bonus:

What exceptional looks like
You can enter an unfamiliar programme, understand the system quickly, identify the real constraints and establish a credible technical route forward.
You can design the solution, build its most difficult components, integrate models and tools, implement the necessary controls and explain your decisions to a senior client. You make good engineers better and leave behind stronger systems, practices and teams.
You combine the depth of a principal engineer, the breadth of a full stack engineer, the practical capability of an AI engineer and the judgement of a trusted technical consultant.
If you still love building software, want ownership of genuinely difficult engineering challenges and care about delivering systems that work in the real world, we would like to hear from you.

We do not recruit around a rigid stack. You may have experience with technologies such as Go, Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, relational databases, event-driven systems, open-weight models, vector search or agent orchestration frameworks.
Depth, adaptability and engineering judgement matter more than matching a checklist.

What makes this role different
You will have the opportunity to:
• Shape technically ambitious programmes from discovery through to production.
• Work across modern software engineering, cloud, AI and agentic AI.
• Solve complex problems without being constrained to a single technology stack.
• Test new technologies and approaches against real delivery challenges.
• Influence engineering standards, reusable patterns and technical strategy.
• Work directly with senior client stakeholders and become a trusted technical adviser.
• Mentor strong engineers and build high-performing engineering teams.
• Deliver systems with meaningful impact across major government and enterprise services.

What you’ll do
• Lead the design and delivery of secure, resilient and production-grade applications.
• Remain hands-on across frontend, backend, APIs, data, integration, cloud and deployment.
• Build AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows that connect models, tools, data and enterprise systems.
• Design agent orchestration, retrieval, context, state, memory, permissions and human oversight.
• Establish robust approaches to AI evaluation, security, reliability, observability and cost.
• Solve difficult problems across architecture, performance, scalability and production operations.
• Make pragmatic technical decisions based on evidence and clearly explain the trade-offs.
• Lead teams through ambiguity and complex delivery rather than waiting for perfect requirements.
• Raise engineering standards through practical leadership, mentoring and constructive challenge.
• Work closely with clients, architects, product teams and delivery leaders.

What we’re looking for
You will be an outstanding software engineer who has developed into a technical leader without moving away from engineering.
You will bring:
• Exceptional and recent hands-on software engineering experience.
• A record of personally delivering complex, production-grade systems.
• Deep understanding of how modern systems operate end to end.
• Strong system-design and architecture capability backed by the ability to implement and validate your decisions.
• Broad experience across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud platforms.
• Experience diagnosing difficult issues across application, infrastructure and runtime boundaries.
• Genuine technology independence and the ability to master unfamiliar tools and platforms quickly.
• Strong judgement across security, performance, reliability, maintainability, observability and cost.
• Experience leading and mentoring excellent engineers while remaining technically credible.
• The confidence to challenge weak assumptions and defend better technical approaches.
• Excellent communication and client-facing skills.
• Experience working in government, regulated or complex enterprise environments.
• Eligibility and willingness to obtain SC clearance.

AI and agentic AI capability

You will have practical experience taking AI beyond demonstrations and into secure, supportable production environments.
We are looking for experience in areas such as:
• Building applications using large language models or other modern AI models.
• Designing agentic workflows involving tool use, structured outputs and external system integration.
• Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, grounding and context management.
• Agent orchestration, state, memory, permissions, error recovery and human-in-the-loop controls.
• Evaluation of quality, reliability, safety and measurable business outcomes.
• AI security, including prompt injection, data protection, access control and auditability.
• Hosted, private, open-weight, sovereign or disconnected deployment patterns.
• AI-assisted software engineering, with rigorous validation of generated code and designs.

Just as importantly, you will know when AI is the right solution and when conventional deterministic software is the better engineering choice.

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the job

Neo4j Technical Onboarding Engineers play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a Technical Onboarding Engineer, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

Sitting at the heart of our customer-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
  • Hands-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
  • Hands-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
  • Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
  • Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
  • Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.

Responsibilities

  • Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
  • Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
  • Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
  • Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
  • Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Support Engineering at GitLab isn’t just a title - you will be embedded within the Engineering department and will truly operate in an environment where Support and Engineering meet. You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. In the space of a day, you might be doing behind the scenes work of a Linux administrator troubleshooting performance problems by using strace on a particular process, interacting with the Product team to ensure that steps in a bug report are reproducible, or interacting with the Engineering team itself by diving deep into our codebase and putting together a merge request to actually fix a customer issue.

That’s not all though - you’d equally be invited to contribute to the source code, improve our documentation, and help build out more efficient support processes in our issue tracker. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.

Some examples of our projects:

  • A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
  • A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
  • A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
  • A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do

  • Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers and resolve their issues via Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email and video conferencing
  • Collaborate with our Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success and Sales Teams to build new features and fix bugs, define and shape the product goals, roadmap, priorities, and strategy
  • Create and update documentation based on customer interactions
  • Collaborate with Support team members (through Pairing Sessions) and other GitLab team members (for example: as a Support Stable Counterpart)
  • Participate in regular rotations for weekday and weekend on-call coverage (daytime only), providing emergency support to our Self-managed and SaaS customers, or working with our SaaS Production team to coordinate incident communications
  • Participate in our hiring processes by reviewing applications and assessments, and by participating in interviews.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in, and passion for managing customer facing cases throughout the entire support lifecycle from initial customer inquiry to triage and reproduction, writing bug reports for hand off to the development team, and case resolution
  • Excellent Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent knowledge)
  • Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash), and MVC frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails)
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD
  • Expertise in writing support content
  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics to customers and coworkers of varying technical skill level
  • Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and technologies like Serverless and Kubernetes
  • Understand a range of different GitLab implementations, and how service interruptions impact the customer.

About the team

The Support team is distributed all over the world across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. Support Engineers work on Support Tickets and helping GitLab’s customers, but they also dig into the code and logs to find out why something is not working as expected. The Collaboration here at GitLab is extraordinary and exciting - Support Engineers solve complex problems together and participate in regular pairing sessions and 1:1s, as well as coffee chats and Slack conversations that help them stay connected. Team members are given the ability to structure their shift the way it best suits their private life while maintaining our ability to address customer issues.

Thanks to our Transparency value, you can see what we are working on in our Support Team page. Additionally, you can see our company roadmap and listen to some of our meetings.

  • All remote, asynchronous work environment

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.


Why This Role Matters

At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is not an abstract mission. It is real, urgent, and growing. Our ICAP product is a proven, high-impact solution that is trusted by customers who depend on us to secure their most critical systems. We are now ready to take ICAP to the next level.

This Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICAP, including the evolution toward a next-generation Proxy, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. If you are energized by building success, driving innovation, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.

What You Will Be Doing

As Director of AI Product Management, you will be the end-to-end owner of ICAP’s product strategy and growth trajectory.

You will:

  • Set and own the ICAP product vision and roadmap, including the strategic evolution into a Proxy-focused solution.
  • Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
  • Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, and customer adoption.
  • Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with a close partnership with our Vietnam-based teams.
  • Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring ICAP continues to deliver reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
  • Represent ICAP with confidence to customers, partners, and internal leadership.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:

  • A clear, compelling ICAP roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
  • Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
  • Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.

jobs.excerpt: SummaryYelp connects people with great local businesses.
jobs.description:
Summary

Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.

The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.

As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
  • Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
  • Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
  • Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
  • Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

  • Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.
  • Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking.
  • Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required.
  • Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact.
  • Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions.
  • Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components.

Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Als erfahrener Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) im Bereich SAP SCM bei Körber Supply Chain Consulting übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Vertriebsteam.

  • Du repräsentierst Körber auf Branchenveranstaltungen, Messen und Kundenevents und beobachtest dabei Markttrends und identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder im SAP Supply Chain Umfeld.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige erfolgreiche Vertriebserfahrung im Umfeld SAP, IT-Beratung oder Supply Chain Management mit.

Eine reibungslos funktionierende Lieferkette von Waren - end-to-end - ist das, was die Welt von heute am Laufen hält. Hier ist Deine Chance, Teil dieser Herausforderung zu werden. Wir bringen Supply-Chain-Intelligenz und fortschrittliches digitales Fachwissen ein, das wir in vielen Projekten erworben haben. Wir sorgen für eine nahtlose Integration in die gesamte IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden, bis hin zur Steuerung von Automatisierungstechnologien auf der Hardware-Ebene.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be. We believe that mobility is the gateway to opportunity—connecting people to housing, education, employment, commerce, and care. By making transportation more accessible, affordable, and sustainable, we empower communities to thrive and unlock economic and social prosperity.

Our mission is to revolutionize transit with a solution that delivers high capacity, exceptional user experiences, unmatched affordability, and minimal environmental impact.

The Glydways system is a groundbreaking network of carbon-neutral, interconnected transit pathways powered by standardized autonomous vehicles on dedicated roadways. Operating 24/7 with on-demand access, it offers personalized and efficient mobility—without the burden of heavy upfront infrastructure costs or ongoing taxpayer subsidies.

With Glydways, we’re building more than a transportation system; we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere, has the freedom to move.

Meet the team:

The Developer Platform team as a part of Software Foundations and Architecture is responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure that enables all developers to track, build, deploy and operate our software. From the build system everyone uses, to AI and local developer tools, to the tools used to submit and deploy changes, to the cloud infrastructure they use to operate it - we support the entire development experience. The Developer Platform team forges the tools that empower the entire software engineering organization while working with engineers from almost every team.

Glydways vehicles carry passengers, so a meaningful part of our codebase is safety-critical and must be developed to SIL-4 under the CENELEC railway standards (EN 50128 / EN 50716). Our job is to develop the tools and processes that make that provable. This role builds those mechanisms, working closely with our Safety and Systems teams to turn certification requirements into automation.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and launch the tooling that keeps our SIL-4 code classified, reviewed, and provably signed off.
  • Develop lightweight web-based applications and reports that show our safety posture to engineers and auditors.

  • Prototype new approaches and take successful solutions through to stable production use.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation and promote knowledge sharing across teams.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

  • Act as a bridge between art, engineering, and production.

  • Collaborate with distributed teams and external development partners.

  • Support technical planning, estimation, and prioritization of technical art initiatives.

  • Proactively improve workflows and remove recurring production bottlenecks.

You'll grow into an engineer who can own an entire system, developing depth in cloud, security, data, and agentic engineering alongside senior engineers who remain hands-on in the code with you.


The Work:


You'll work as part of a client-embedded engineering team, taking real features from design through production. You will be handed problems to solve, and you will be expected to ask precise questions, make progress under ambiguity, and put working software in front of stakeholders quickly.


Build Across the Stack

  • Build and ship production features across front end, APIs, backend services, integration, and data, taking a feature end to end across every layer it touches.
  • Read and debug unfamiliar code, trace a problem across application, data, and infrastructure boundaries, and fix the underlying cause.
  • Build and Run on Cloud-Native Platforms
  • Develop, containerize, and deploy services on a major cloud platform using Docker, Kubernetes or serverless, and managed cloud services.
  • Apply infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm, or equivalent), and take part in keeping your services healthy, observable, and recoverable in production.
  • Work Inside the Delivery Pipeline
  • Work within automated CI/CD pipelines, writing the automated tests, resolving pipeline failures, and taking your own changes through to production.
  • Apply secure engineering practices as you code, including identity and access fundamentals, secrets handling, dependency hygiene, and input validation.

Work With Data and Context:


  • Design and implement the data access your features need across relational and non-relational stores, APIs, object storage, and event platforms.
  • Build the retrieval and context layers AI features depend on, including knowledge sources, embeddings, metadata, and context management, applying data quality, access, and privacy controls as you go.

Build AI Features and Agent Workflows:

Engineer With AI Every Day:

Grow and Contribute:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If You Have:

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the TeamLawyers bill in six-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time & Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre-bills and invoices, payments, e-billing, and a two-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team.

About the RoleLitify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time & Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible.

We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn’t required: if you come from Java, C#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform.

AI-assisted development is how this team works. We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

How we work:We value speed and follow-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here.

  • We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers
  • We work in two-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team
  • We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
  • Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release
  • We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment
  • We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI
  • Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices
  • Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time-capture partners
  • Help build, test, and ship our releases
  • Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX
  • Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases

To be successful in this role, you have (required):

  • 4+ years of experience with a typed back-end language (for example Java, C#, TypeScript)
  • Front-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling
  • Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales
  • A habit of writing tests
  • Daily, hands-on experience building software with AI coding assistants
  • An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones

Nice-to-have:

  • Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications
  • Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review
  • Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write-downs, and LEDES e-billing
  • Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product
  • Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries

Where you can grow:

  • Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers
  • Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications
  • Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release
  • Help shape the team’s AI practices and grow into leading them
  • Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within

Disclosure:

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.

The estimated base salary for this role is $115-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.excerpt: What You Can ExpectJoin Zoom's Security Operations Centre team in India, where your work directly shapes how we detect, respond to, and recover from threats across a complex, global technology environment.
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

Join Zoom's Security Operations Centre team in India, where your work directly shapes how we detect, respond to, and recover from threats across a complex, global technology environment. You'll operate at the intersection of SIEM engineering, incident response, and threat hunting, bringing analytical rigor to ambiguous situations and building the detection capabilities that keep Zoom secure. At this level, you're expected to lead investigations from triage through resolution, collaborate across cloud, identity, and product security disciplines, and continuously improve the processes and tooling that power our SOC. If you're energized by fast-moving threat landscapes and thrive in a team that values both depth of expertise and open collaboration, this role offers real scope to grow and make an impact.

About the Team

Our SOC India team sits at the heart of Zoom's global security operations, working alongside detection engineering, IT, cloud security, and product security teams to protect a platform trusted by hundreds of millions of people worldwide. The team covers the full spectrum of security events, from phishing and identity threats to cloud misconfigurations and product security incidents, operating with a follow-the-sun model. We value clear thinking, rigorous documentation, and a shared commitment to continuously strengthening Zoom's security posture.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across SIEM, EDR, email security, identity, and cloud platforms using CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Splunk, and related tooling.
  • Lead incident response from initial triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Partner with the Incident Response team to address security incidents and provide timely support.
  • Work proactively with Cyber Threat Intelligence to gather actionable intelligence and respond effectively to incidents.
  • Collaborate closely with the Detection Engineering team to develop new detection and reduce false positives.
  • Create, tune, and manage detection rules and alerts in CrowdStrike NGSIEM and Splunk, reducing false positives and maintaining clear documentation of logic and coverage.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate incident analysis, summarize investigations, and support detection development, validating all outputs before acting on them.
  • Investigate phishing and email threats using Proofpoint, and analyze suspicious files and URLs through sandbox platforms such as Joe Sandbox.
  • Investigate identity-based threats and suspicious authentication activity in Okta, and analyze cloud security events across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI to identify misconfigurations and attacker behavior.
  • Handle PSIRT cases related to product security, coordinating with engineering and cross-functional teams to assess impact and track remediation.
  • Read and interpret PowerShell and Python scripts, and apply scripting and automation to streamline investigation, enrichment, and reporting workflows.
  • Document incidents, detections, and playbooks to a standard that supports handover, audits, and continuous improvement, and contribute to shift handovers, metrics reporting, and SOC process improvements.

About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with clients. Ask the right questions, find the real constraints and turn a rough idea into a clear solution design
  • Design the system architecture for web, mobile and AI products. Services, data model, hosting and how the pieces talk to each other
  • Write the technical parts of proposals and scopes of work. Modules, user flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and estimates the team can stand behind
  • Design integrations with third-party APIs and vendors. Plan for retries, queues, webhooks and monitoring, and keep a clean way to swap a provider later
  • Plan multi-tenant and white-label setups with proper data isolation and access control
  • Build security and privacy in from day one. Encryption, audit logs, consent, data residency and the evidence clients need for an outside audit
  • Design AI and LLM features for client products, including model choice, retrieval (RAG), guardrails and the evaluations that prove quality in production
  • Plan in phases. Ship a lean MVP first and keep the design ready for the full build without a rewrite
  • Work with sales and project managers on scope, timelines and risk. Push back early when something will not fit
  • Review the dev team's code, pull requests and technical approach. Catch drift from the design early and explain what to change
  • Guide and unblock engineers, set technical standards, and own technical quality through delivery and handover
  • Keep the architecture docs current so anyone on the team can pick up the context

  • Hands-on AI architecture. You've designed LLM or RAG features with evaluation for production client products, and you know what they change about cost, latency and testing

  • Comfortable running client-facing technical calls. You can explain a trade-off to a non-technical founder in plain words
  • You write clear technical scopes with estimates the team actually hits
  • AI-augmented workflow. You use AI tools every day in your own design, review and writing work
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Clients read your documents and hear your voice directly
  • Available for live client calls during US Eastern business hours

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed.

We are a technology consultancy, and our own people are technical. They expect internal technology to be fast, well designed, and secure by default. This role reports to the CISO and leads a small team, with latitude to shape that team as the work grows. You will own the function end to end budgeting, vendors, hiring, the internal platforms our people build on, and a named set of security and compliance controls.

Who You Are

Prowess Consulting is hiring a dynamic and forward-thinking IT Manager to lead our internal technology operations.
To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please.

The Role and Responsibilities
  • Leadership of the help desk function for a distributed workforce across two primary sites (Washington, USA and Ahmedabad, India) and remote workers around the world, including service expectations the business can hold us to.
  • Microsoft 365 administration: Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, Intune, Purview and Defender.
  • Identity and access administration: on/offboarding, access changes, group and role design, privileged access controls.
  • Endpoint fleet: procurement, build standards, configuration, patching, recovery and disposal.
  • Vendors, contracts, licensing and assets: renewals, third-party risk review, and a clear picture of what we own and what it costs.
  • Business continuity for internal systems: backup, restore testing, documented recovery expectations.
  • Security operations: vulnerability monitoring and remediation, logging, and an incident response process you have rehearsed, not just written.
  • Projects and documentation: upgrades, improvement initiatives, and standards that let someone else run this without you.

What makes this role different

Technology delivered as a service. Internal requests are merging licensing needs with DevOps-style resource design and allocation. We are looking for someone who has experience of executing with that type of a platform-centric mindset.
  • Infrastructure as code, version control and repeatable deployment as normal practice.
  • A safe, documented path for teams to run what they build, and a reasoned no when it does not fit.
Security and compliance as your own work. We hold ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, work under HIPAA obligations, and handle data in scope for GDPR. Several of the controls behind those certifications live in internal technology, and this role owns them by name rather than supplying evidence for someone else to assemble.
  • You must have fluency with at least one formal control framework, and the judgement to tell a control's intent from its paperwork.
  • You should be able to demonstrate identity-centered thinking: least privilege, scoped access, risk minimization.
Fluency with AI. Utilizing AI is a key part of Prowess' current strategy and a critical part of our trajectory. Internal technology must respond to this with appropriate control of access, permissions and acceptable use, and we expect this role to take on a growing share of how internally built AI tooling is supported and governed. Furthermore, in contrast to prevailing business environments where risk-averse IT attenuates AI adoption, we expect IT to be a facilitator, enabler, and accelerator of wise organizational adoption of AI, AI-based tools, and knowledge worker-created AI-created apps and systems.

Much of that work runs on an internal platform we are building to serve the help desk and IT side of the organization as well as the people building on it. The technology side of it belongs to this role: who may call what, which credential each connection acts as, and what is allowed to run unattended. A key function of the role is using this platform to enable end users to work in the “Frontier” style, very quickly building and operating their own apps and rolling them out to their teams securely. This role will also have a hand in where the platform goes next.
  • You must have a hands-on familiarity with modern AI tooling, and an active interest in how fast it is developing.
  • The role will be frequently faced with requests that carry risk, so you must possess the instinct to describe what safe would look like rather than to refuse it or wave it through.

Technology and Tools

Tools change faster than the thinking behind them, and we are more interested in methodology and judgement than specific vendors or tool stacks.
Expect to talk about:
  • A technical decision you would make differently now, and what changed your mind.
  • How you decide whether to buy something, run it yourself, or decline the request.
  • An internal tool that needs to reach a real system on someone's behalf. What would safe look like, and how would you decide?
No years-of-experience figure: the role suits someone who has run technology operations and a small team somewhere with real compliance obligations. If your experience is uneven but your reasoning is strong, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Our environment

  • Entirely cloud-hosted, with only minimal lab hardware.
  • A Microsoft organization: Azure and Entra underpin identity and infrastructure.
  • ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA obligations, GDPR in scope.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field highly desired.
  • The person for this role will have progressively responsible IT experience.
  • This IT Manager will have experience managing small teams, vendors, projects, and technical teams.
  • Experience supporting corporate IT infrastructure and business applications.
  • Experience leading system implementations, migrations, upgrades, and operational improvements.
  • Experience with M365 administration, ISO, SOC, and GDPR required.
  • Experience implementing generative AI or automation solutions.
Additional Details
  • The offered pay range for this position is $140,000 - $185, 000 per year depending on experience.
Prowess Consulting is an equal-opportunity employer, and diversity is a core value for us. We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Prowess Consulting, we are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. We provide a well-rounded benefits package including health insurance, flexible spending account, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan investing. jobs.description:
Position:MULESOFT INTEGRATION ARCHITECTLocation:ELIZABETHTOWN, KY or REMOTE (US ONLY)Salary:$120-130k
We are hiring a MuleSoft Integration Architect to design how data flows between Department of Defense (DoD) customer systems and Salesforce. You will use MuleSoft's Anypoint Platform to connect external systems, APIs, and data streams to Salesforce securely and reliably. You will set integration standards and work closely with the Salesforce Architect and development team.

US Citizenship Required and this is 100% remote role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design the integration architecture connecting Salesforce with government and third-party systems using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
  • Apply API-led connectivity (system, process, and experience APIs) to build reusable, well-governed integrations
  • Choose the right integration pattern for each need: real-time APIs, event-driven messaging, batch, or Change Data Capture
  • Build and lead development of Mule applications, API specifications (RAML or OAS), and DataWeave transformations
  • Design for security, including authentication, encryption in transit, API policies, and protection of CUI
  • Plan for reliability with error handling, retries, monitoring, alerting, and logging
  • Establish integration standards, governance, and CI/CD pipelines for Mule applications
  • Work with system owners to define interface agreements and data mappings
  • Document integration designs and data flows to support ATO and RMF packages
  • Troubleshoot and tune integration performance in production

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Systems thinking: You understand how data moves across many systems and what happens when one fails.
  • Technical leadership: You set integration standards and guide developers to follow them.
  • Security mindset: You treat every interface as a potential risk and design accordingly.
  • Clear communication: You work with system owners and agencies to agree on interfaces and data definitions.
  • Pragmatism: You pick the simplest pattern that meets the need.
  • Ownership: You stay accountable for integrations from design through production support.

EXPERIENCE


Required
  • 7+ years of enterprise integration experience, including 4+ years with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
  • Designing and building APIs with RAML or OpenAPI and transformations with DataWeave
  • Integrating with Salesforce using REST, SOAP, Bulk, and Streaming APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture
  • Messaging and event-driven patterns (e.g., Anypoint MQ, JMS, or Kafka)
  • API security: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, and API policies
  • CI/CD for Mule applications (e.g., Maven, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps)

Nice to Have
  • Experience with MuleSoft Government Cloud or other FedRAMP environments
  • Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud Plus or Government Cloud Plus – Defense (IL4/IL5)
  • Experience on DoD or other federal programs
  • Familiarity with RMF, ATO packages, and CUI handling
  • Runtime Fabric or hybrid deployments
  • Salesforce development experience (Apex)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS


Required
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Platform Integration Architect (formerly MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect – Level 1)
  • CompTIA Security+ or another DoD 8140-qualifying certification (or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire)

Nice to Have
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Platform Architect
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer or MuleSoft Developer II
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Integration Architect
  • Salesforce architect certifications:
    • Platform Data Architect
    • Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect
    • Platform Integration Architect
    • Platform Identity and Access Management Architect
    • Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect

    Where this role sits

    • Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) own the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs.

  • Build and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud-native data, LLM-based, and agentic AI solutions).

  • A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside FDE and FDX

  • A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them

  • Remote-friendly culture

  • Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance

  • Career growth; we actively develop our engineers

  • Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions

  • Long-term B2B collaboration

  • Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs

  • Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays

  • Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work

    1. Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions.

    2. Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant

    3. HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations

    4. HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible
